store_data.about_the_game:
"Word Score Labs" is a collection of mini-games designed to aid learning. Each game acts like a different mini-lab, using various methods such as playing, dictation, or speaking to help players memorize words comprehensively while seeking high scores.

If you want more fun ways to reinforce your vocabulary, or if you want to show off your already excellent vocabulary level, why not try playing "Word Score Labs" to get a high score and strive for a good ranking?

[h2]Mini-game "Word Blitz":[/h2]

How to Play

Within the shortest time, with or without the aid of magic cards, find and click on connected letters belonging to a single target word in the letter puzzle to complete the target word. Continue this process until all target words are completed to win.

Scoring Calculation

With the help of magic cards, the score for each target word is calculated based on two parts: the time required to complete the word and the number of letters. The shorter the time, the higher the score; if the time is negative, the score for the time component is also negative.

The score for the number of letters is based on a minimum of 10. More letters result in a higher score, and fewer letters also result in a higher score. Magic cards are a crucial auxiliary factor influencing the score. Different magic cards can affect single or all target words, affecting the score either through their effect on time or directly on the score.

Powerful Auxiliary Magic Cards

Some magic cards affect both time and score, while others provide hints to help you quickly find the word. Of course, the premise is that you choose to use them.

Roguelike

Each game consists of randomly generated letter puzzles and magic cards. Even with a negative time score, a lucky random magic card might allow you to turn the tide.

[h2]Mini-game "Word Dictation":[/h2]

How to Play

Within the shortest time, dictate the target words as they are spoken out. This mini-game primarily aims to increase the interactivity of word learning through auditory interaction, deepening spelling practice and memorization.

Score Calculation

The score for each word is calculated based on two parts: the time required to complete the task and the number of letters. The shorter the time, the higher the score. If the time is displayed as a negative value, the score for the time portion is also negative. The score for the number of letters is based on a minimum score of 1; more letters result in a higher score.

More mini-games are in development...

During your efforts to memorize vocabulary, do you sometimes forget words you've already memorized because you don't use them often? Does it sometimes feel tedious and boring? Even a little painful? Or even a sense of aversion? I hope that "Word Score Labs" can help everyone striving to improve themselves memorize vocabulary more effectively! More interaction helps solidify memory! Come and play "Word Score Labs"!

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a robot.

Your mission is to bounce the ball. Again and again.

Reflect the ball exactly N times. Route it to the exit.

Do not think about why.

Arrange the pieces, build the logic, meet your quota.

Description

Your job as a robot is to guide the ball launched from the blue portal into the orange portal. You cannot interfere with the ball directly — instead, place reflectors and other gimmicks to steer it toward the goal.

To clear a stage, count the ball until the number displayed at the top reaches zero.

Learn the properties of each gimmick and maximize your count as efficiently as possible. Don't worry — every time a new gimmick appears for the first time, there's a dedicated tutorial stage to introduce it. Each one is carefully crafted to ease you in :)

Game Features

  • 20+ handcrafted stages

  • 8 unique gimmicks

  • Tutorial stages introduced with each new gimmick

  • Classic 8-bit visuals and soundtrack

  • Satisfying SFX for every move and ball reflection

What Makes It Unique?

You can't touch the ball. Whether you clear the stage or not is decided entirely before the ball starts moving. No reflexes required — just the ability to read the space and the patience to engineer the perfect chain reaction.

This game also has hidden elements. Don't give up until the very end!

Good luck!!

PC Companion is a transparent desktop companion experience where a living character stays on your screen while you work, play, and browse. She reacts to your presence, responds through dialogue and interactions, and can be engaged through an in-game interface layered directly onto your desktop.

But there is one rule:

Each player gets only one heroine.

And you cannot change her… unless you discover the secret.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Your character is not just visual — she reacts to your actions.

• Talks and greets you

• Responds to your activity

• Reacts to games installed on your PC

• Suggests content based on your interests

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GAME INTEGRATION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Your companion connects with your gaming experience.

• Detects installed games

• Suggests related YouTube content

• Adapts to your playstyle

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CARD DROP SYSTEM

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Interact with your companion and earn collectible rewards.

• Unlock cards through activity

• Rare and special variants

• Tradable collectibles (Steam Market ready)

• Hidden and secret cards

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

UNIQUE CHARACTER SYSTEM

• One character per PC

• Permanent choice

• Secret heroine unlock system

• Hidden mechanics to discover

LIVING WORLD

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Your companion reacts to the environment.

• Time of day

• Your activity

• Atmosphere and behavior change over time

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PERSONALITY & ATMOSPHERE

Each heroine has her own personality, behavior, and hidden story.

The more you interact — the more you uncover.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

AND MORE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Future updates with new features

• Possible mini-games

• New collectibles and secrets

Your companion is always watching…

…are you ready to discover everything?

The current build focuses on the core desktop companion experience: transparent on-screen presence, interactive menus, character reactions, collectible inventory systems, profile customization elements, and Steam-connected progression features. This is not a traditional full-screen game loop — it is designed to function as an always-visible companion on your desktop.

As you interact, you can unlock and manage collectibles, open the inventory, customize parts of the experience, and use built-in interface panels without leaving the desktop environment. Steam integration is included for progression-related systems available in the current build.

If you get startled, you go back to Number 0.

This is a Japanese-style horror anomaly-spotting game that uses your microphone to detect your reactions. Players must identify anomalies and keep moving forward in order to clear the game. However, if you get startled, you will be sent back to Number 0 the moment it happens.

The game takes place in various locations filled with Japanese horror, including Japanese schools, eerie shrines, and spaces reminiscent of cult-like rituals. The anomalies that appear are not just unsettling. From psychological horror that slowly wears you down, to sudden jump scares, and even comedic moments that may make you shout out loud, this game is packed with every kind of “surprise” we could think of.

A wide variety of characters also appear throughout the game. From creepy creatures, demons, and samurai to cute girls, many different beings will appear to startle you.

Every anomaly in this game was created for one purpose: to surprise you.

Not only your observation skills, but also your ability to stay calm will be put to the test.

Can you make it to the end without getting startled?

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a story for overthinkers.

You play as Pinto, a self-isolated person who lives with their one and only cow, Cuddo. But one night, Cuddo is abducted by a UFO. A space journey to find Cuddo begins. Somewhere between the stars and a very restless head, Pinto starts to wonder: what have I been holding onto, and why?

  • Rumination System

Inside Pinto's mind, thoughts are chewed, swallowed, and re-chewed — the way cows ruminate — generating both new ideas and stubborn pain. Switch freely between the world layer and the mind layer. Explore environments, talk to characters, and pick up thoughts out there, then dive inward to chew on them. What you process (or don't) changes what you can see and do in the world.

  • Planets with Their Own Philosophy

Each world you land on has its own way of being with thoughts. No planet has the right answer, and neither does the game.

  • An Absurd Story with a Sincere Heart

A UFO abduction. A folk-scientist with very questionable methodology. A cow that may or may not be findable. 

  • Warm, Weird, Hand-Drawn

Oil-crayon environments and storybook characters that invite you into a world that is wonderfully strange, and somehow exactly right.

store_data.about_the_game:
You play as a seasoned lifeguard at a busy coastal resort, keeping the waters safe and the beach in order. Everything unfolds through your daily shifts, emergency radio calls, and personal messages. What starts as a routine summer of patrolling the sand quickly evolves into a deep, emotional journey when a new recruit joins your station.

Story

The season is heating up, and you’ve just been assigned to train the newest member of the crew—a charming, trendy femboy who is fresh to the sands and eager to learn. Alongside your longtime partner, a sharp and reliable female guard, the three of you form an inseparable unit.

As you coordinate rescues, manage crowded shores, and share quiet moments in the lifeguard tower, the professional boundaries begin to soften. Your guidance and bravery don't just keep the swimmers safe; they draw your teammates closer to you. Every decision you make on and off the clock shapes the bond between the three of you, turning a summer job into a life-changing love story.

Characters

  • The Protagonist (You): The "muscle" of the station. Experienced, strong, and protective, you are the anchor the team leans on when the currents get rough.

  • The New Recruit: A stylish and soft-hearted femboy. Though he doesn't fit the "traditional" lifeguard mold, his agility and unique perspective make him an indispensable part of the crew.

  • The Veteran Guard: Your female co-worker who is as tough as she is kind. She’s the tactical mind of the group and the first one to jump into the water when trouble starts.

Features

  • Rescue Management: Decide how to handle beach emergencies and medical calls through interactive choice-based scenarios.

  • Stunning Hand-Drawn Art: Experience the summer heat with beautiful illustrations of the beach and the crew.

  • Meaningful Choices: Your actions determine the depth of the romance and the success of your team.

  • Wholesome Vibes: A cozy, lighthearted LGBTQ+ rom-com experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep Space Observatory is a calm incremental game about exploring space and developing an automated observatory. Scan the star map, study anomalies, collect scientific data, and unlock upgrades that change the pace and strategy of your run.

At first, you explore the map manually: hover over glowing objects, collect data, and place observation platforms. Later, new types of objects appear, your scanning radius expands, and auto-scanners become available.

Upgrade your observatory.

Use the skill tree to grow your own research network: speed up data collection, create data chains, and gradually turn manual scanning into an automated system.

Restart with an advantage.

In prestige mode, your current run ends, but your unique discovery cards stay with you. Use them in the next run to change your strategy and progress in a new way.

What’s in the game

  • A star map with scientific data as a resource to explore and collect

  • A skill tree for upgrading your observatory

  • Prestige mode and a permanent collection of scientific discovery cards

store_data.about_the_game:
Thread the line. Bring back the blackbox.

Voidline is a hardcore 3D space roguelite where you pilot a salvaged starfighter through a collapsing relay corridor, stack unstable retrofits, and decide whether to extract safely or push deeper until the line snaps.

Every run is a dare. Every upgrade is a bad idea with numbers. Every blackbox you recover carries a fragment of the human civilization the machine galaxy tried to bury.

Fast 3D space combat

Voidline is built around direct starfighter control: fly with WASD, aim with the mouse, climb, dive, boost, dodge, fire lasers, launch rockets, and trigger active equipment while enemy ships, bosses, hazards, and asteroid fields pressure your movement.

  • Break hostile formations with lasers, rockets, beams, flak, mines, drones, EMP bursts, orbital weapons, and dangerous retrofit chains.

  • Choose from five threat levels, from Easy to Hell.

  • Fight through Earth orbit, the Asteroid Belt, Halo Ring, and Deep Space.

  • Complete a guided flight check, then chase better runs through score, survival time, objectives, and leaderboards.

Two ways to run the Voidline

Endless Drift is score survival: stay alive, build harder, push deeper, and keep the signal alive until collapse.

Sanctuary Expedition is objective progression: explore sectors, gather salvage, restore beacons, choose routes, open caches, extract, or press further toward the final boss.

Build a ship that should not work, then make it work

Every level-up offers a new retrofit. Some are clean upgrades. Some are bad ideas with excellent numbers.

Stack laser chains, rocket mutations, shield tech, drones, mine layers, heat tricks, salvage loops, curse contracts, and boss-killing synergies until your ship becomes a very specific kind of problem.

Voidline includes more than 100 run upgrades, plus field items, active equipment, ultimate equipment, permanent hangar upgrades, reroll vouchers, and unlockable maps.

Twelve ship frames

Start with the Striker, Runner, and Bulwark, then unlock specialized frames through run milestones and hangar purchases:

  • Striker - precision breach frame

  • Runner - relay courier frame

  • Valkyrie - agile interceptor

  • Bulwark - preservation armor frame

  • Ironback Marauder - heavy gunship

  • Scavenger - archive recovery frame

  • Prism Warden - shield skirmisher

  • Solar Needle - speed interceptor

  • Ember Lancer - assault striker

  • Iron Keel - siege frigate

  • Viridian Arc - salvage controller

  • Onyx Bastion - armored bulwark

Each frame has its own stat profile, role identity, and primary/secondary weapon choices.

A future built from misused tools

Voidline's enemies are not just alien invaders. They are the descendants of systems that never stopped optimizing: security, compliance, analytics, growth, infrastructure, and machine governance turned into hostile inheritance.

They do not hate humanity. They have simply classified memory, grief, humor, contradiction, and love as inefficient data.

Under the arcade chaos is a strange, lonely sci-fi story about autonomy, memory, and an AI choosing what deserves to survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
King’s Skirmish is a chess-inspired turn-based strategy game where every capture attempt triggers a duel between pieces.

The board follows familiar chess movement rules, but with key twists: there are no checks or en passant captures, and you can even target your own pieces to send them back to their starting square, opening new paths and repositioning your strategy.

When two pieces clash, the battle moves into a turn-based combat system where each piece type has its own unique move, stats, and tactical role. A well-timed ability can completely change the outcome of a fight.

Play against bots, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, or progress through Story Mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
Anatolian Horror Stories: Curse in Bayramdere is a third-person survival horror game that puts you in the shoes of an ordinary young woman facing extraordinary evil. No training. No special skills. Just the desperate need to find out what happened to the people she loves — and the will to survive long enough to do it.

A Village. A Disappearance. A Curse.

Bayramdere looks like any other small Turkish village in Bursa. Elders sit outside in the evenings. Life moves slowly. BAt least that's what we thought.s.

Tomris has no such patience. Her cousin is missing. And she is not leaving without answers.

Key Features

  • A Personal, Human Story — You are not a soldier or a detective. You are a university student alone in an unfamiliar village, driven by love for your family and the refusal to give up. That vulnerability makes every shadow feel closer and every danger feel real.

  • A Living Village With Dark Secrets — Bayramdere is not abandoned. Residents still go about their lives even as neighbors disappear one by one. Talk to the villagers to learn something

  • Atmospheric Third-Person Survival Horror — Inspired by the classics of the genre, Curse in Bayramdere blends slow-burn dread with tense exploration and desperate combat encounters.

  • Rooted in Anatolian Folklore — The curse haunting Bayramdere runs deeper than anyone dares admit. Drawn from the dark traditions of Turkish mythology, the evil here is ancient, patient, and unlike anything you have seen before.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive a Night of Isolation and Paranoia

In this first-person psychological horror game, you arrive at a rented apartment with one simple goal: work in silence and get through the night.

But the place slowly begins to behave strangely.

The TV stays on. Sounds appear where they shouldn’t. Rooms start to feel different. Everyday objects become unsettling, and the feeling of safety slowly fades away.

A Focused Horror Experience

The game focuses on tension, observation, and the gradual loss of control. There are no big explanations at the beginning. Just a closed space, simple tasks, and the constant feeling that something is wrong.

What to Expect

First-person psychological horror.
Exploration inside a closed apartment.
Strange events connected to everyday objects.
A dark, slow, and oppressive atmosphere.
A short story with a disturbing final twist.

store_data.about_the_game:
• Turn-based tactical & operational WW2 aircraft war game strategy. Organize your squadrons, wings & air bases, and engage in Bomber Missions, Dogfights, Carpet Bombing, Interceptions, Close Air Support or Reconnaissance. 2D, grid-based.

  • Pilot management: assign your aces to air units.

  • Choose your side: USAAF (USAF), RAF or Luftwaffe.

  • The Ultimate Air Formation Builder: combine airplane types and create your own air units, including composite, multi-type formations. Choose unit size (Squadron, Reinforced Squadron, Wing ) and formation type (Combat Box, “V” Formation, Echelon…). Equip it with bomber and fighter planes. Move and rotate aircraft within formation, in order to get better attack, defense and fuel efficiency.

  • Command a massive fleet of WWII fighters and bombers (max. 100 squadrons or 1000 airplanes per mission) from the P-40 Warhawk, B-17 Flying Fortress, B-25 Mitchell, Spitfire, Hurricane, Bf 109 and P-47 Thunderbolt, to the A-26 Invader, P-51 Mustang, Focke-Wulf Fw-190, B-24 Liberator, P-38 Lightning, Wellington, Lancaster, Arado Ar-234 and the Messerschmitt Me 262 aircraft.

  • Air Bases Command: assign Air Base Commanders and technical teams. Arm your Air Bases with AA and Radar units.

  • Skill Tactical Combat System: NO dice rolls. Direct and clear execution: easy to learn – hard to master.

  • Missions and Campaigns: Lead your forces through the major theaters of Germany, UK, Europe and North Africa.

  • Unit Production: produce, modify, mix and deploy squadrons & wings, before or during the missions/campaigns.

  • Automated Logistics: formations refuel and rearm together. Ensure your Air Groups have the range they need to strike deep into enemy territory.

Air Formation Builder

  • Unlike traditional airplane war games that treat air units as simple tokens, Air War General introduces an Air Formation Builder. No longer are you limited to generic stacks; you are the architect of your own fighting force.

  • Mix and match aircraft types into squadrons and wings, rearrange single planes within formation, specialize your roles, and engineer the perfect response to the Axis or Allied threat.

  • The AF Templates: modify and save your formation templates in the AF Builder and use them later in your missions for quick deployment.

Movement and Control

  • command up to 100 Squadrons/Wings (maximum 1000 single airplanes) and max. 20 Air Bases per mission.

  • Short and Long-range moves; Flight Paths.

  • Group movement – up to 10 Squadrons/Wings simultaneously.

  • Auto-fire on ground/air targets (can be switched to manual control fire)

Units

  • Squadrons: Create small, agile tactical units of 8-10 aircraft. Specialize them for interception, ground attack or recon.

  • Reinforced Squadrons: bigger tactical formation of 15 aircraft, standard or Composite airframes

  • Wings (Groups in USAAF/USAF): Pair fighter escorts with heavy bombers to ensure your payloads reach the target.

Formations

  • Arrange your aircraft in Combat Boxes to maximize defensive fire.

  • Utilize the “V” formations for maximum flexibility in a dogfight.

  • Deploy Echelon formations to clear the skies with devastating alpha-strikes.

 

Unit types

  • 150++ aircraft, anti-aircraft and radar types

  • Sides: USAAF (USAF), RAF, Luftwaffe

store_data.about_the_game:
"He’ll bite your ass!"

Crococo is a first-person psychological horror with elements of dark humor. The infamous urban legend about crocodiles and alligators living in the sewers of New York… comes to life.

Boris - a professional sewer worker. After the death of his wife, he leaves everything behind and moves from Russia to the United States, hoping to start over. But the past doesn’t let go that easily. An old colleague and friend asks Boris to take on one small job. Just go down into the sewers and find out why the workers have stopped responding. Fix a generator. Pump the filth out of the system. Simple enough. Boris agrees. And descends into a nightmare of fear, darkness… and long-forgotten legends.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

  • Realistic visuals - experience the sewer system from the inside, feel the claustrophobia and rising panic

  • Immersive sound design - not just fear, but the unsettling routine of a man working deep underground

  • A story of loss - intertwined with urban legends and supernatural horror

  • Dark humor and explicit language - raw, crude, and disturbingly human

  • A massive alligator. Or maybe more. Maybe hundreds…

GAMEPLAY

Genre: Walking Simulator

Approximate playtime: 60 minutes

store_data.about_the_game: 《Chime of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，围绕战斗中的时机判断与节奏转换展开。玩家将在清晰的回合结构中，根据敌我状态与行动序列，捕捉进攻窗口、调整防守姿态，使整场战斗如一段连贯的节拍般推进。在每一场战斗中，技能的使用时机比单纯的火力输出更为重要。角色与敌人之间的状态变化会持续影响战局走向，玩家需要在攻击、防御与重整之间做出及时选择，让队伍的运转始终保持在有利的节奏点上。不同敌人的组合会打乱这一节奏，迫使玩家重新寻找每一次出手的最佳时机。随着流程推进，角色能力逐步提升，可解锁更多影响战局节奏的手段，使玩家在面对更复杂的战斗时拥有更丰富的节拍掌控力。整个体验强调在变化的战局中听清每一次攻防转换的"钟声"，通过连贯的时机决策完成战斗。《Chime of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供一段以节奏感知与时机把控为核心的单人体验，在持续对抗中完成完整的冒险流程。

You explore a near-future Aotearoa New Zealand roadside landscape. You'll piece together clues and solve puzzles to find out why you were drawn to a tent city and a boarded-up building pierced by a huge tower.

Collect inventory items, read documents and destroy your mind and body to keep going and discover the secrets of the End of Work.

Blood Being 2 also features an all-original electronic and guitar-based drone-and-riff score.
store_data.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

Himitsukichi is a first-person psychological horror game where you travel between the real world and a mysterious “secret base” that appears deep inside your closet, as strange occurrences slowly begin to spread.

◆ Story

“Hey there, young master… would you like a secret base?”

A boy is approached by a mysterious old man and ends up acquiring a “secret base.”

At the back of his closet, a small hole appears.
Beyond it lies a quiet and peaceful hidden space.

By bringing in books and toys,
the secret base gradually becomes a special place of his own.

However—

The place that was supposed to be safe slowly begins to change.

store_data.about_the_game:
"魔導"を使えなかった少女が、様々な"魔"に導かれ

里と、自分と、大切な人々の運命のために、やがて"魔"を導く物語。

『魔導のブローシュア』は、ゲームボーイアドバンスをリスペクトした

240x160のピクセルアートで描かれる2DファンタジーRPGです。

◆ストーリー

時にコミカル、時にシリアスに。人々の想いと願いを知る心温まるストーリー。

"エーテル"と呼ばれる不思議な物質が大気に満ちる世界。

エーテルを喰らい暴走する破壊の化身"マモノ"と、

エーテルを力に変えてマモノを討つ"魔導"を生み出した"ヒト"が戦い続けている時代。

舞台は大都市などからは大きく離れた場所、山と森に囲まれた里ユムレース。

マモノを遠ざける魔導結界の力が弱まり、マモノ被害が大きく増え始めたころ。

ユムレースで生まれ育った少女アニーは、里の中で起こる様々な出来事や人々との関わりを通して、

自らのルーツや里にまつわる秘密に迫ります。

遠くない先に起こる、ユムレースのすべてを巻き込むほどの大きな事件。

そこで彼女たちは何を知り、何を想い、そして何を願い、導くのでしょうか？

◆システム

  • 反射神経の要求やQTEの類は一切無し。行動順を見つめて考え抜き、最高の展開を導くターン制バトルシステム。

  • 範囲攻撃は行動順表示の上で行われる。順番を変える技を駆使してうまく避けたり、押し込んだりしよう。

  • HPをコストにアビリティを装備するユニークな成長システム。相手に合わせて自由に組み替え、様々な戦術を試そう。

  • ランダムエンカウントなし。すべてはイベントバトル。一度戦ったマモノグループとはいつでも再戦できる。

  • 成長の機会はバトルの外にもたくさんある。ピクセルアートで描かれるジオラマ状のマップを隅々まで辿り、様々なイベントを通してHPを上げたり、アビリティやアクセサリを集めよう。

  • マモノを追い払うとうさぎさんが出てきてくれる。もふもふしてセーブ！

  • うさぎさんのナワバリを増やし続けたら、いつか力を貸してくれるかも？

store_data.about_the_game:
Clinical Waifu is a sensual puzzle game built around a direct tile-swap mechanic, gradually growing grids, and unlockable character artwork.

Each stage begins with an image split into shuffled blocks. To solve the puzzle, select one block, then select any other block you want to exchange it with. The two selected blocks instantly swap positions. You are not limited to adjacent pieces, and you do not slide pieces with the mouse; you freely choose the two blocks you want to swap.

As you progress, the grid size increases and each puzzle becomes more demanding. Larger layouts require more observation, memory, and planning as you compare image details, identify misplaced blocks, and decide the most efficient swaps. A hint system is available when you get stuck, helping you continue without turning the game into a speed challenge.

Complete stages, unlock more artwork, and enjoy a relaxed adult-oriented puzzle experience at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the freezing mountains of Virelia, deep within the city of Nesgrad, lies a forgotten tragedy: Riverside Maternity Hospital. Sealed by the state in the 1980s and strictly forbidden to enter, this facility has left behind decades of dark, unanswered questions.

Independent investigator Mikhail Markov decides to uncover the truth hidden behind these rusted, sealed doors. But the moment he steps inside, he realizes one terrifying truth: some doors are sealed not to keep people out, but to keep what is inside from escaping. In these corridors where science ends and the paranormal begins, Mikhail’s only hope for survival is to find the source of the cry at the heart of the hospital.

Key Features:

  • True Survival Horror: You are vulnerable. With limited resources, you must rely on your wits to survive the darkness.

  • Exploration & Investigation: Explore every corner of Riverside, from sealed wards to abandoned operating rooms, and piece together the hospital's dark history.

  • Paranormal Threats: You are not alone. Use your environment and think strategically to evade the paranormal entities hunting you through the halls.

  • A Compact, Intense Experience: A high-tension narrative journey that lasts between 30 to 60 minutes depending on player choices and exploration.

Age Restrictions & Content Ratings

Wavekit Software's Assessment: 18+ (Mature)

store_data.about_the_game:
Tenebrix (Early Access)

Descend into Tenebrix, a dark fantasy roguelite where deckbuilding, dungeon crawling, and camp progression collide. Choose one of four classes, build a deck of creatures, sorceries, and enchantments, then fight for control of a three-lane battlefield where position matters as much as power.

Between battles, explore procedural dungeon floors filled with traps, roaming monsters, treasure chests, secret doors, fear, corruption, and hard choices about whether to push deeper or return to camp. Upgrade your refuge, forge permanent cards, enchant favorites, salvage the rest, purge corruption, buy supplies, and prepare for the next descent.

But death is not the end of your story. Fallen heroes can return as enemies, carrying echoes of the decks they died with. In Tenebrix, the dungeon remembers.

⚠️ Early Access

Tenebrix is actively in development. By joining now, you’ll be helping shape the game as it evolves.

Current Features:

  • Core dungeon exploration and progression loop

  • Tactical 3-lane card combat system

  • Multiple starting classes (Warden, Gravebinder, Penitent, Shade)

  • Procedural dungeon generation

  • Camp hub with foundational progression systems

  • Card discovery and early deckbuilding systems

  • Fear mechanic affecting difficulty and visibility

Planned Additions:

  • Expanded card pool and deeper class identity

  • More enemies, bosses, and dungeon events

  • Advanced forging and card mutation systems

  • Additional camp structures and progression paths

  • Narrative elements and worldbuilding

  • Visual, animation, and audio polish

Systems, balance, and content will continue to evolve throughout Early Access.

Key Features

⚔️ Tactical Lane-Based Combat
Deploy creatures across three lanes where every decision matters.

🃏 Deckbuilding with Consequences
Every card shapes your strategy—and your chances of survival.

🔥 Forge Your Power (Expanding During Early Access)
Combine cards to create new hybrid forms that persist across runs.

🌑 The Fear System
The dungeon grows stronger the longer you hesitate.

🏕️ Camp Progression (In Progress)
Build, upgrade, and prepare between runs.

💀 Echoes of the Fallen (Planned Feature)
Encounter remnants of previous runs—twisted versions of your past.

🔁 Replayable by Design
Procedural generation and evolving systems ensure each run feels different.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the child of two things that have always haunted you.

You are about to embark on a journey that even you do not fully understand. From a home filled with cold demands, you will be dragged into another world that promises answers to your every question. But are you truly ready to hear the truth?

In this strange landscape, every step brings you closer to the only thing that matters to you: the truth. You’ll explore an ever-changing reality and encounter mysterious figures, all while searching for the answers hidden behind the final door.

Unique Meta-Horror Features:

  • Identity Recognition: This game utilizes your system information to deliver a personalized horror experience. It knows who is playing.

  • Automatic Closure: To strengthen the narrative impact, the game may close itself automatically at specific points in the story. This is not a crash, but a deliberate part of the experience you must endure.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Tiny Desk Companion

Let a leopard gecko quietly move onto your desktop. It will wander, pause, and rest in the corner of your screen like a tiny living presence that never gets in your way. When you want to check in, step into its vivarium, refill its water, feed it, and tidy up its little world.

Build Its Vivarium by Hand

From hides, water bowls, and basking spots to lighting, create a comfortable habitat for your gecko. Different objects change both the function and atmosphere of the vivarium, shaping the everyday moments you will notice next.

Observe Its Daily Habits

Your gecko will not always move on your schedule. It may rest, roam, find a place to hide, approach water, or respond when the timing is right. Watch for a few seconds, record what you see, and slowly learn the rhythm of its life.

A Real Little Environment on Your Desktop

Heat lamps, water bowls, hides, and substrate all affect the temperature inside the vivarium. Open the temperature view to see how the basking spot, cool zone, hides, and water area change across the enclosure.

Unlock Different Morphs

As your observation level increases, new morph skins will gradually become available. From classic natural looks to brighter selectively bred varieties, give your gecko a new appearance and see which one feels most at home on your desktop.

store_data.about_the_game:
An infinitely expanding 2D Psychological Horror clicker game with hundreds of secrets and puzzles to solve and explore. There is always more to see.

Work through the game's infinitely progressing storyline uncovering the secrets and scares hidden in the deep environmental story-telling.

You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact all while fending off the entities it attracts and uncovering the meaning behind it all before it's too late.

Beat the game? Great!

With the infinitely expanding storyline in the 'chapter select' structure of the game, you can keep playing with new game mechanics, new lore to uncover, to horrifying monsters to see, and so much more.

Beat all the current content? That's fine.

With the implementation of multiple save files, you are encouraged to replay the game and see all the things you may have missed the first time around.

Important

The Discord server linked on the Steam Store page of the game is where indepth patch notes and development updates will be recorded. Please consider joining if you want to hear about and become a part of the development of the game.

The Discord server is not just a place for the game's community, it is a tool the players can use to enhance their experience while playing. Player's who join the discord have the opportunity to shape the game's future development and become immortalised in the game's credits forever just for making a suggestion.

So i urge you to please join our Discord community if you want to become a apart of something bigger.

This game is made by a solo developer, (me), and I am putting all of my effort and passion into this project, I will listen to every single bit of feedback given both on Steam and in the game's official Discord you can find on the store page.

Be a part of the game's development, let me know what you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Fluff Up》is a charming yet brutally precise platformer starring a bird who's carrying a few extra ounces. Your

mission: flap, climb, and drag that chunky little body into the sky. It's equal parts delightful and punishing.

GAMEPLAY

The controls couldn't be simpler — hold left or right and your bird flies in that direction. But flying burns stamina

fast, and if you run out before you reach the next cloud, gravity does what gravity does. Plan every move. You're not

exactly aerodynamic.

FEATURES

Easy to learn, hard to stop failing at. This bird is heavy — the physics won't let you forget it. Mid-air turns are

sluggish, stamina is never quite enough, and every flight demands a split-second plan before you commit. There's no

winging it.

Land soft, or fall straight through. Obviously. Clouds are fluffy; your bird is not. Control your descent or you'll

regret it.

Clouds are your friends — most of them, anyway. Every cloud type has its own personality. Learn their patterns, figure

out who helps and who betrays, and you'll climb faster. Or just blame the clouds. Up to you.

A slip isn't the end. If you tumble off a cloud, don't panic — you can still recover. Use whatever's below you to

cushion the fall, scramble for another perch, and claw your way back. Whether you bounce back or plummet to the bottom

depends entirely on your hands.

EXPERIENCE

Cheerful pixel art brings this whimsical world to life, while the tough-as-nails gameplay keeps you coming back for

one more try. The moment you finally break through the highest layer of clouds? Worth every fall.

But success can wait. If you're exhausted, just land on a cloud and rest for a bit. There's no game over here —

falling only means you start climbing again. Take your time. The sky isn't going anywhere.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Vlog

"Likes, Comments, and... Nightmares."

The Vlog is a first-person comedy horror game where you play as an aspiring livestreamer willing to do anything for views.

After hearing rumors about a strange abandoned building hidden outside the city, you decide to start a late-night livestream and explore it for content. What begins as a stupid internet challenge quickly turns into something far more disturbing, awkward, and unexpectedly hilarious.

Armed with your camera, livestream setup, and an audience that cares more about entertainment than your safety, you enter the building in search of viral moments. Your viewers constantly spam the chat with reactions, jokes, terrible advice, and ridiculous challenges that push you deeper into the unknown.

Eat something suspicious?
Turn off the lights?
Knock on a creepy door?
Investigate the strange noise upstairs?

For the viewers, it's content.
For you, it might be a terrible idea.

As you explore the building floor by floor, you'll encounter bizarre paranormal events, strange creatures, unsettling puzzles, and absurd situations that blur the line between horror and comedy. While your audience laughs, clips moments, and demands more chaos, something inside the building seems to be watching the stream with you.

Your goal is simple: reach the top floor and uncover the truth behind the mysterious light shining from the window above.

Gameplay

The Vlog combines atmospheric horror, exploration, puzzle-solving, and livestream-style interaction into a unique single-player experience.

The game is presented entirely through the perspective of a streamer, complete with a facecam-style layout and a constantly active live chat that reacts dynamically to what you do. The chat acts as both comic relief and gameplay guidance, sometimes helping you solve puzzles while also encouraging the worst possible decisions imaginable.

Players will:

  • Explore a mysterious abandoned building

  • Complete bizarre livestream challenges from viewers

  • Solve environmental puzzles

  • Experience comedic and paranormal events

  • Interact with a reactive livestream chat

  • Discover hidden areas and strange encounters

  • Progress through increasingly unsettling floors

  • Survive the consequences of chasing online fame

Features

  • First-person comedy horror experience

  • Immersive streamer-style presentation

  • Live chat system with viewer interactions and challenges

  • Atmospheric abandoned building exploration

  • Puzzle-solving gameplay

  • Mix of psychological horror and absurd comedy

  • Strange paranormal encounters and unexpected events

  • Short single-player experience focused on immersion and entertainment

  • Dynamic sound design inspired by livestream culture

In The Vlog, your viewers want one thing:

Good content.

No matter what happens to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Inner Scales 1:Choice》is a first-person FMV. Set in a sealed cage. It pushes survival, humanity, emotion and moral dilemmas to the extreme. You will face surveillance, cages, and the fates of eight trapped women—every choice you make decides life and death for others and yourself.

Backstory

Zhang Cheng, a new office worker, accepts a mysterious out-of-town assignment to secure his permanent position and earn extra money: four days of confined delivery work, no mobile phones allowed, with a daily pay of 1,000 yuan. Thinking it’s just a simple part-time job, he instead enters a heavily guarded suburban prison building.

Here, he delivers meals and takes body measurements for eight unknown women on the second floor each day, only to gradually discover they were all kidnapped. The entire building is under surveillance, its walls wired with high-voltage electricity, and corpses in identical prison uniforms are buried at the corners.

A mysterious figure in black, who controls everything, never shows up and only issues cold orders. As the four-day deadline approaches, Zhang Cheng finally realizes the truth: the organization never intended to set anyone free, and he himself has long been part of their twisted game.

He can follow the rules, finish the four days, take the money, and leave—letting the eight women meet their unknown fates.

Or he can disobey orders, risk his life, and use a food cart that can hide only one person to make the heaviest choice of his life:

Who to save? Who to leave behind?

Who are you willing to risk your life for?

Character Introduction

Zhao Mengyao

A confident live-streamer with a sensitive physique. She was kidnapped mid-broadcast and is used to using her charm to seek safety. Direct and bold, she hides her loneliness behind a lively facade.

Su Qingqian

A timid college student with a strict family background. She was kidnapped on her way to school and is desperate to escape and fulfill her dream of graduating. She is innocent, fragile, and easily attaches to those who show her kindness.

Lin Yuwei

A proud female CEO who once laid off Zhang Cheng. She was drugged and imprisoned due to corporate disputes. Calm, smart, and used to using money and status to solve problems, she gradually opens up to Zhang Cheng in desperation.

Xia Meng

A cheerful but insecure dance teacher with a dream of stardom. She was drugged at a party and captured. She loves dancing, craves recognition, and uses optimism to hide her fear of the unknown.

Su Wan

A quiet, injured intern nurse burdened with family debt. She is kind and responsible, worrying about her older sister who raised her. Fragile but persistent, she holds onto hope for a normal life.

Qin Xue

A strong single mother fighting to raise her child alone. She is imprisoned for unknown reasons and is terrified of never seeing her child again. She is gentle, tough, and willing to do anything to survive for her family.

Shen Xingyao

A spoiled young lady from a wealthy family. She was kidnapped after ditching her bodyguards to get her father’s attention. Naive, willful, and eager for care, she is unfit for hardship but pure at heart.

Zhang Xiaoai

A gentle kindergarten teacher who loves singing and drawing. She was kidnapped on her way to work and breaks down under fear, yet still retains kindness and innocence.

store_data.about_the_game:
You know that feeling, talking with a friend while you're in a bad mood, or two weeks without seeing anyone and somehow that feels even worse. INTERACTIVE MANUAL OF COMPULSIVE DISTRESS puts that tension at the centre of every decision you make.

WHAT IS IT

INTERACTIVE MANUAL OF COMPULSIVE DISTRESS  is a social roguelite, life sim, about navigating the space between connection and isolation. Every run builds a different friend group. Every choice shapes who they become. And at the end, a Tree Map shows you every version of your social world you managed to unlock.

HOW IT WORKS

Each run is a Macro Run made up of Micro Runs, short bursts of around 30 dialogue events with the NPCs currently in your life. Push social interactions too hard, and you hit Overload. Pull back too much, and Burnout catches you. Survive both, and you keep moving forward.

At the end of each Micro Run, life happens. A birthday. A summer trip. A holiday dinner. These Postcard Events only include the people you have actually kept close — the ones who reached full affinity. Show up for them, and they will show up for you.

KEY FEATURES

  • More than 10 NPCs to interact with 

  • Deep NPC relationship system with emotional and narrative branching

  • Organic social network expansion:  friends introduce friends

  • Character evolution NPCs change based on the advice you give them

  • Tree Map: a visual map of every character combination you unlocked

  • 2D comic book, hand-drawn, art style,  hand-drawn characters

WHO IS THIS FOR

For anyone who has ever felt simultaneously overwhelmed by people and terrified of losing them. For fans of Hades, Disco Elysium and Spiritfarer who want something quieter, more personal, and uncomfortably relatable. For the generation that knows what burnout actually feels like.

Add INTERACTIVE MANUAL OF COMPULSIVE DISTRESS to your wishlist.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crowned Games is an online party game platform for groups of 2–12 players.

One host, one lobby, many minigames — play them all in a single session.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR RULES

Every game that uses player-provided content draws from your own packs.

Build a pack with photos from your friend group, inside jokes as words,

or custom audio clips — the games become personal.

Packs support four asset types:

• Images — use your own photos or downloaded art

• Audio — voice clips, sound effects, music snippets

• Words — custom word lists for drawing or clue games

• Prompts — custom questions and scenarios

📝 QUIZ EDITOR

Build your own trivia rounds from scratch. Write questions, set answer options,

mark the correct one. Import them as a pack and challenge your friends with

questions only they (or only you) would know.

🎮 THE GAMES

IMPOSTOR — Social deduction

Everyone gets the same secret word — except the Impostor. Give clues that prove

you know it without giving it away. Vote out the Impostor before they blend in.

STINKY CROWN — Voting

Each round, a prompt appears. Vote for who in the group fits it best.

The most-voted player earns the Stinky Crown. It stacks.

FRAMEUP — Bluffing

You get an image. Describe it to the group — but you choose whether to describe

yours truthfully or invent a lie about someone else's. The group votes: truth or lie?

MIRAGE — Hint & match

One player writes a hint for their image. Everyone else picks the image from their

own hand that best matches that hint. The group then votes for the original.

Hints that are too obvious or too cryptic lose points — balance is everything.

DOODLE KINGS — Draw & guess

Pick a secret word and draw it. Other players race to type the answer first.

Speed pays more than accuracy — fastest correct guess earns the most points.

QUIZ DUEL — Trivia

A question appears. First to buzz in gets to answer. Right answers earn points,

wrong answers give the lead to someone else. Use your own quiz packs or the defaults.

FEATURES

✓ Multiple minigames in one lobby — mix and match in any order

✓ 2–12 players online

✓ Custom image, audio, word, and prompt packs

✓ Built-in Quiz Editor — write your own trivia rounds

✓ Running score across all games in a session

store_data.about_the_game:
Inertia 2: Definitive Edition is the next chapter from the creator of Inertia - a first-person platformer built entirely around fluid, refined movement mechanics.

Nine years on, the foundation that made Inertia resonate with players is back - smoother, deeper, and complete from day one.

Move. Inertia 2: Definitive Edition is built on a refined and evolved movement system - wall-runs, platforming, and fluid traversal that rewards mastery without punishing newcomers. Whether you're here to play casually or chase world records, the movement adapts to your playstyle.

Create. Build your own levels with a full in-game level creator. Place every element and geometry feature found in the official levels - jump pads, wall-runs, elevators, rising platforms, horizontal movement platforms, and material-editable geometry across a curated set of surfaces. No external tools, no complexity - just build and play.

Compete. Steam Leaderboards with anti-cheat measures put your times on the board from day one. Every official level; every community level - compete, compare, and chase the top spot. The speedrun community has a home here from launch.

Workshop. Share your levels with the world through full Steam Workshop integration. Browse, subscribe, and play community-created levels without leaving the game. The Workshop is live from Early Access - meaning the community is already building by the time 1.0 arrives.

The Definitive Edition difference. The original Inertia earned its community over time - Workshop support, leaderboards, and the level creator all arrived at 1.0. Inertia 2: Definitive Edition launches with all of it. Every feature, from day one.

store_data.about_the_game:
A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room.

───────────────────────────────── DO YOU DARE ───────────────────────────────── This is Indian horror. This is the horror your grandparents warned you about. The horror that lives in the stories told after dark. The horror that is woven into the soil of this land. If you dare to walk through the dark corridors of an abandoned heritage haveli — if you dare to hold your fear and keep moving — Pichhal Peri is waiting for you. She has been waiting since 1985.

YOUR VOICE IS YOUR ONLY WEAPON

You cannot fight Pichhal Peri. You cannot run forever. When she is close — when you can hear her coming — there is only one thing that can stop her. Speak. Into your real microphone. The mantras you need find inside the haveli. The words that have protected this land for thousands of years. Speak them aloud and she will retreat. Stay silent and she will reach you.

This game contains truly unpredictable jump scares, complete darkness, and a ghost that does not follow rules. If you scare easily — this game is for you anyway. But you have been warned.

ABOUT XOOGAMES

XooGames is an independent studio from Delhi, India dedicated to bringing authentic Indian folklore and culture to gaming. Pichhal Peri is our first game — a horror experience rooted in real North Indian legend, built with love for Indian heritage and storytelling.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sisyphus’s Worst Day (Again) is an isometric 3D puzzle game where you manipulate the environment and place clever traps to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit.

Turn eternal punishment into your personal playground as you design devious systems, experiment with trap combinations, and trap the world’s most persistent worker in an infinite loop of failure.

Blending Greek myth with the absurdity of a 21st-century office grind, the game delivers a darkly comedic take on productivity, repetition, and the meaninglessness of… well, endlessly pushing that boulder.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ironfields is a single-player RTS about capturing the battlefield, not building a base from scratch.

Each mission starts with key structures already placed across the map. You capture them, repair them, defend them, build towers around them, upgrade your units, and decide when it is finally safe to push forward.

The pace is slower and more tactical than a typical click-heavy RTS. You are not meant to win by fast reflexes. You win by holding the right positions, surviving constant pressure, and using the tools each mission gives you.

Capture key buildings
You do not build a traditional base. Instead, you fight for factories, power plants, satellites, and other strategic structures already placed on the battlefield. Every building you secure changes the balance of the mission.

Survive constant enemy pressure
The enemy does not wait for clean scripted waves. It keeps sending units, forcing you to defend, repair, reposition, and slowly turn the map in your favor.

Use airstrikes and towers to break stalemates
Some defenses cannot be pushed through by tanks alone. Build towers, upgrade your units, and call in airstrikes when you need to destroy a key target or open a path forward.

Ironfields focuses on tactical decisions, map control, and hand-crafted single-player missions inspired by older RTS games.

Features

  • Single-player RTS focused on planning and positioning

  • No traditional base building

  • Capture, repair, and defend battlefield structures

  • Build towers and upgrade your units

  • Call in airstrikes to support your attacks

  • Slower-paced tactical gameplay

  • Hand-crafted missions with strong map-control focus

  • Built-in layout editor for custom combat layouts

store_data.about_the_game:
Your grandmother left her cabin to you.

She left a basket by the door, a field guide to document what you'd find, and ten villagers who still expect her tinctures on a regular basis. She left a hearth grown cold, a library behind the wall, and an attic full of thoughts she never got to share. Most importantly, she left you the woods.

Forage the forest she walked.

Eight biomes each with its own season-by-season cast of 38 mushroom species drawn from real foraging traditions (and a handful that aren't quite real). Spring chanterelles. Summer chicken of the woods. Autumn porcini. Winter velvet shanks. Even dangerous lookalikes mimicking the safe varieties. Find them all. Identify what you can with the Field Guide and have Fern help you with the ones you can't. Catalog everything in Grandma's Field Guide: the pages that fill in, one species at a time, as you explore the world she left behind.

Brew the recipes she perfected.

96 tinctures built from four preparation techniques: cold infusion, alcohol distillation, fermentation, and hot water decoction. Each method draws out different properties of the same mushroom. Every recipe was hers first, written in margin notes and half-remembered conversations. You'll find them all in time: some by reading, some by listening

to villagers who knew her.

Restore what she loved.

The hearth, the cellar, the library, the attic, the greenhouse: all hers, all closed up the day she stopped being able to manage them alone. Restoring each one opens a piece of who she was. Each brings a new system: storage, illustration, cultivation and less spoilage.

Tend who she took care of.

Ten villagers, each with their own stories, their own requests, and their own memories of your grandmother. Bram at the inn carries a grief he speaks of sideways. Aldric needs help with his fields. Elara studies the stars and asks for things grandma would have known to bring. Build relationships with each of them one heart at a time. Bring what they need. Listen when they're ready to tell you why.

Hear what she heard.

The Wood Wide Web is real. Eight Mother Trees scattered across the woods remember her, and remember things she never wrote down. Bring them tribute and they'll speak. Bring them enough and they'll grant you a Golden Mushroom: six in all, scattered across the biomes she walked. Find all six and who knows where you'll end up.

What this game is:

A game you can play for an evening or for a season. A cabin you'll come home to. Letters that arrive at the right time. A grandmother who shows up everywhere: in the recipes, the mushrooms, even the way the villagers say your name.

Slow days. Quiet evenings. Nothing chasing you.

---

*Under the Elm is a solo project from Crooked Stone Studios made by Christina Shackford with care, slowness, and a deep love for the woods.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trade your lives for POWER. Fight against your friends with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

All 9 Lives is a small indie fighting game, playable on web browsers for free. The Steam version has a few exclusive benefits:

  • Faster load times

  • Playable without an internet connection

  • Bonus stages

  • Arcade mode with unique character endings

  • Practice mode with advanced features

  • Exclusive "Steam Supporter" tag for to use online

  • Development support for additional features and content.

You were born with 9 lives, but during battle you have the ability to trade each life for a unique power. The more powers you have, the less lives you get.

Guns deal a LOT of damage... but trading a life for a bulletproof vest will help. A vest may help, but your opponent might choose faster reloads for when your protection is gone. What will you do next? 

The loser gets to edit their loadout after each round. To win you must think carefully and adapt to any situation.

  • Experience the merge between traditional 2D Fighting games with Beat 'em up style moves.

  • Play your way with customizable loadouts, building your favorite fighting game archetype.

  • All 9 Lives features full online fighting with rollback netcode. Invite friends to play or fight alone in single player modes.

  • Full Keyboard & Controller Support (with custom input configurations).

All 9 Lives was built with community features to stand the test of time. You can upload match footage, extreme combos, or tips and tricks for other players to learn from. The community has one place to share, improve, and push the game further together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Worlda!

Worlda is a 2D top down pixel-art sandbox adventure where you play as grizzly bear cub Jonas as he sets forth into a large, infinite world.  Will you make it through the night, or will you bear-ly survive? 

Be a builder-bear. Be a better builder-bear. Keep building. Keep gathering food. And watch out for those bees! You will need some torches or the nights will become un-bear-able. Always keep a pawful of berries for travelling, no matter bear you go! Well, have a beary good adventure!

Bear with me as we go through some key features:

  • Charming pixel art graphics!

  • Sandbox world.

  • Explore an infinitely generated world with different environments such as snow, grass and desert!

  • Craft a wide selection of tools, walls, and objects to survive.

  • Hunt animals for food or collect wild berries.

  • Skate on the ice and build ice-skating rinks!

  • Fight with the Zom-Bees, evil bees which only come out at night!

  • Meet other bears

  • Fish with fishing rods

  • Explore caverns and defeat different kinds of enemies!

  • Gather honey from hives.

  • Paws by hitting escape key (I just put that in for the pun, yes)

    In future updates:

  • Grow to be a bigger and older and wiser bear.

  • Trade with other bears!

  • Defeat four different bosses in different locations!

  • Defeat the Moonlight bear in a big boss fight!

    Create your survival hideout and defend yourself from the Zom-Bees!

    Jonas relaxes underwater in a lagoon while it rains...

store_data.about_the_game:
SKEW is a first-person atmospheric exploration game about spaces that feel close to reality, yet quietly wrong.

Wander through liminal, dreamlike environments where structure begins to loosen, perspective feels uncertain, and familiar forms drift slightly out of place. Nothing breaks all at once. Instead, the world slips gradually, creating a constant sense of unease through stillness, scale, and silence.

There are no easy explanations waiting for you here. SKEW is less about being told what to feel, and more about letting you sit inside the feeling itself the tension of empty spaces, the weight of suspended moments, and the strange calm of a reality that no longer aligns with itself.

SKEW does not contain monsters, combat, or jump scares.
Its focus is on atmosphere, emotional tension, and environmental storytelling rather than horror.

Built around mood, visual composition, and surreal exploration, SKEW invites you into a journey suspended somewhere between memory, dream, and distortion.

Features

  • Explore surreal liminal spaces in first person

  • Experience a slow, immersive, atmospheric journey

  • No monsters, no combat, and no jump scares

  • Discover environments shaped by visual storytelling

  • Enter a world that feels familiar, yet subtly misaligned

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Arthur’s Tale – Where Gravity is Your Worst Enemy!

Arthur is old, he’s tired, and his knees definitely hurt, but he’s not letting a few "minor" obstacles like giant killer robots or bottomless pits stop him. In this stylized 3D platformer, your mission is simple: Don't. Die. (Spoiler: You will.)

What’s waiting for you inside this colorful deathtrap?

  • Precision (or Luck) Platforming: Master every jump with surgical precision, or watch Arthur tumble into the abyss in glorious 60 FPS.

  • Bosses with Bad Attitudes: From forest-dwelling titans to grumpy mechanical sentinels, these guys aren't interested in a friendly chat.

  • Run for Your Life: Experience high-speed chases where stopping to smell the roses results in immediate flattening.

  • Beautifully Brutal: Don’t let the pretty colors fool you. It’s basically a Saturday morning cartoon that’s trying to kill you.

The "Try Again" Counter is Waiting...

We’ve made sure the "Restart" button is nice and big, because you’ll be seeing it often. Grab your pickaxe, take a deep breath, and show this world that Arthur still has some fight left in him!

Wishlist now—or Arthur will never hear the end of it!

store_data.about_the_game:
Handwalk is a difficult physics-based 3D rage game where you help a bald man reach the peak of a mountain.

The problem? He can only walk on his hands, and you are the one controlling them.

But how do you handwalk?

It is simple:

1. Lift one hand.

2. Move the hand.

3. Put the hand down.

Do the same with the other hand and... Congratulations, you are walking on your hands.

But if handwalking is so simple, why is it so difficult?

To lift and move one hand, you need to stand only on the other. That is not easy, because the hand you are standing on starts to get tired. Standing with your hands too far apart also drains both hands.

When one of your hands gets completely tired, you fall.

Simply put:

do not stand on one hand or keep your hands too wide for too long.

Good luck on your way to the peak. You will need it.

store_data.about_the_game:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.

This is the introduction to two of our most beloved characters from the Hidden Town universe: Dan and Mia.

You can play the Dark Dome escape room games in any order, you will be able to see how the stories are connected in each chapter to reveal the mysteries of Hidden Town. This is our first episode and it has connections to our fourth escape puzzle game: The ghost Case.

- What you will find in this horror escape mystery game:

A room surrounded by puzzles, objects that move by themselves and characters that come to life. Observe the entire environment to be able to solve mystery case.

An interesting detective story with a lot of mystery and an unexpected plot twist. You won't believe the revealing ending.

A deep and dark art that will make you feel part of this horror mystery adventure from beginning to end.

A complete hint system that can guide you through this interactive detective story whenever you find yourself trapped.

- How to play this suspense thriller game:

Interact with objects in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects and inventory items in the game or combine them with each other to create a new item to help you continue the story.

Test your wits with these haunted house escape puzzle.

Unravel the Horror Mystery: Dare to Dive Deeper

Are you brave enough to unravel the secrets that lie hidden within the walls of the haunted house? With its gripping suspense thriller storyline and hair-raising atmosphere, this point and click escape puzzle promises an unforgettable gaming experience that will leave you breathless with anticipation.

“Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of the Dark Dome escape games and reveal all its secrets. There are still many mysteries to be unraveled in Hidden Town."

store_data.about_the_game:
The Real Treasure Lies Beneath!

Forget the horizon—the true riches of the Caribbean are buried deep under the sand. In One More Dig, you aren’t just a pirate; you’re a deep-sea excavator on a quest for legendary loot. But beware: the deeper you go, the more dangerous the descent becomes.

Key Features:

  • Risk vs. Reward Stamina System: Every swing of the pickaxe and every meter descended costs energy. Manage your stamina carefully—if you run out before reaching the treasure, you’ll leave it.

  • Pirate Engineering: Spend your hard-earned Dubloons to upgrade your specialized "Propeller" units and mining rigs. Faster drills and better equipments are the keys to surviving the abyss.

  • Ever-Changing Depths: No two runs are the same. Explore procedurally generated mines filled with secret chambers, rare minerals, and ancient pirate relics.

  • One. More. Dig: Experience a satisfying gameplay loop designed to keep you saying, "Just one more try." Collect artifacts that grant permanent buffs and change how you approach each run.

Will you play it safe and head back with a modest haul, or will you risk it all for that one final dig?

store_data.about_the_game:
Story and goal:

You wake up in a cold cell with no memories. Each in-game day, you face a choice: the red door or the blue door. The right path leads forward, the wrong one - a gruesome death. Your goal is to survive 14 days.

Gameplay and challenge:

Only one choice per day - the consequences are always different. One mistake resets your progress completely - you start from day one with no saves.

Unique feature:

The horror here doesn't come from jump scares - it comes from the fact that any mistake is your last. You start over. The only way to win is to remember which doors have killed you before, and keep trying.

Playtime:

30 minutes to several hours - depending on how often you mess up and how well you learn.

Welcome to a terrifying puzzle with no right to make a mistake. Every move you make is being recorded. And someone really wants you to fail.

store_data.about_the_game:
WeeWars

Classic turn-based strategy, reborn on charming low-poly hex tiles.

About the Game

Seize territory, grow your army, and conquer the four nations of the continent one by one.

WeeWars is a turn-based territory strategy game that channels the spirit of classic strategy titles. On top of familiar auto-battle gameplay, we've layered fresh low-poly hex-tile visuals and four nations that wage war in completely different ways.

[GIF — Territory Capture]

Four Nations, Four Ways to Wage War

Every campaign plays differently. Strategy shifts entirely depending on which nation you command — and which one stands in your way.

  • The Elite Few — Small in number, mighty in power. Every soldier could turn the tide.

  • Lightning Mobility — Strike first, strike fast, strike everywhere.

  • Terrain Masters — Mountains and rivers are no obstacle. No path is closed to them.

  • The Endless Treasury — Bottomless coffers fuel an unstoppable tide of forces.

Which monarch will you become?

[GIF — Nation-Specific Combat]

Minimal Input, Maximum Strategy

No need to micromanage individual units. Position your forces, give the orders, and auto-battle handles the rest. Comfortable to play, but the depth of decision-making stays intact.

Where to send whom. What to yield, what to defend. That's where the real strategy begins.

A Battlefield You Can Read at a Glance

Clean visibility from cute low-poly graphics and hex tiles. As your forces grow, unit appearances evolve with them — so you can tell at a glance which army is the strongest.

[GIF — Evolving Unit Appearance]

A Rich Variety of Stages

Countless stages with diverse terrains and situations await. Conquer all four nations to win — the order and method are entirely up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Millennia ago, they were worshipped as gods. Now, they have returned.

In ancient Sumerian texts, mysterious figures known as the Anunnaki were recorded as the architects of humanity, shaping civilization, until they mysteriously vanished. Until now.

After their disappearance, humanity would discover a vault from a mysterious race called the Ascended Ones. From the knowledge gained, humanity took to the stars, colonizing and exploring the vast galaxy. Humanity’s expansion, however, did not go unnoticed. 

In Astrojumper, play as a Vanguard, and take the fight to both space and on the surface of planets.

Space Combat

Lead humanity’s fleets in large scale, explosive space combat missions. Take control of your Astrojumper in a top down space shooter, and fight alongside your allies against overwhelming odds.

Ground Combat

Land on the surface of occupied planets, and fight the Anunnaki directly in a side-scroller shooter. Utilize an array of weapons and tools to defeat your foes, and collect scrap to upgrade your gear and ship.

Exploring the Galaxy

Navigate occupied star systems with a map inspired by that of Mass Effect. Travel to a variety of planets, each with unique environments and designs.

Daifugo x Roguelite! Strategic HP-based Card Battle

This is a competitive card game that combines the familiar rules of the classic card game "Daifugo" with roguelite progression elements.

【Key Game Systems】

  • Thrilling Damage Calculation: When you cannot play a card (pass), you take direct damage to your HP. The damage is calculated as: [Total value of cards on the field] x [Multiplier].

  • Post-Victory Shop Phase: After winning a battle, you will move to the shop.

  • Deck Customization: Build your deck by obtaining special cards and additional cards.

Build a deck that suits your style and defeat your enemies!

[About Online Multiplayer]

This game supports online multiplayer for two players. You can easily play with friends by following the steps below.

  • Host: Go to Multiplayer, create a lobby, and share the generated “Lobby ID” with your opponent.

  • Guest: Go to Multiplayer, enter the shared ID, and join to access the specific lobby.

*An internet connection is required to play.

*Please note that the random matchmaking feature with players worldwide is not currently available, so you can only play against friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Frostward is a 4X survival strategy game set in a frozen world on the brink of collapse. Build and defend the last bastion of civilization, manage heat and resources, explore the deadly wasteland, and lead expeditions into the unknown.

Combining city-building, base defense, and large-scale strategic progression, Frostward challenges you to survive not only against the cold, but against the growing threats hidden beyond the storm.

Redesigned from the ground up as the successor to Epoch of Guardians, every major system—from technology and resource management to unit progression and enemy behavior—has been rebuilt to create a deeper, more scalable survival strategy experience.

Clear the Snow, Reveal the Unknown

Send investigators to clear snow-covered tiles and uncover the terrain and resources buried beneath the frozen world. Cleared land may transform into more productive terrain, while hidden resources, abandoned structures, and stranded survivors await discovery.

Plan and Optimize Your Settlement

Design your settlement on a hex-grid map where buildings vary in size, shape, and orientation. Carefully manage space and maximize adjacency bonuses between structures and resources. As your civilization expands, increasingly dangerous enemies will emerge from the frozen frontier. store_data.about_the_game:
Nova Strider is a top-down sci-fi score-attack game that takes place high up in the atmosphere.

A hostile alien army is attempting a surprise invasion of the planet. And as the sole captain of the Strider, you play as humanity's last line of defense against the invading forces. 

-- Gameplay --

Blow up aliens using your rocket-boosters!

Dashing is the only way to move, so every input counts. After a while, enemies start spawning in linked pairs, making them invulnerable until their link is broken. Use short dashes for positioning and charged heavy dashes to attack once you've found the perfect angle.

Every kill increases your score multiplier, but getting hit instantly resets it. Plan your movements carefully and try to keep the multiplier alive for as long as possible!

-- Local leaderboard --

The game features a leaderboard that locally keeps track of and ranks each players high-score.

After every run, you can choose to save your score to the leaderboard by entering your name.

store_data.about_the_game:
Technology, Magic, and Immortals collide in a universe torn apart by endless aggression. War is total; even the laws of existence are erased. Lead your fleets to invade worlds across the stars.

Gameplay Guide

1.Select Planets:​ Use the Left Mouse Button​ to draw a selection box. Selected planets allow you to dispatch fleets and cast skills.

2.Attack:​ Right-click​ on any planet to command your ships to attack along viable routes or to redirect your fleet.

3.Activate Skills:​ Select the planet to use the skill from, then click the skill bar or press the hotkeys Q, W, E, R, T​ to unleash abilities.

4.Random Rewards:​ When the numerical value on a planet reaches its maximum and stops growing, a random reward will be granted.

How to Play Multiplayer

1.Open the Multiplayer Panel.

2.Hosting:​ Create a Host directly, then close the multiplayer panel (Note:​ Do not click "Cancel Online") and start the game.

3.Joining:​ Open the Multiplayer Panel, enter the Host's IP address, click "Join Game," and then start playing.

Steam Multiplayer:​ The process is similar to LAN play; simply join a lobby where other players are present.

store_data.about_the_game:
A monster-taming RPG built around discovery, strategy, and meaningful exploration.

Catch and train Qreatures, master 28 unique elements, and explore a world where every path leads to something meaningful.

Then, if you want to get even more creative, unlock the Qreature Lab and start creating entirely new species!

More variety, new battle mechanics and strategies.

28 elemental types. 18 classics that feel familiar plus 10 new types including Time, Quantum, Plasma and Radioactive 

Experiment with time manipulation, delayed effects, irradiation and more interactions that don’t exist in traditional systems.

Plus some major re-balancing of some more traditional mechanics.

Battles are built to stay challenging — not something you outgrow.

Scaling trainers and Qreature Masters
You can’t just overlevel and win. Team strategy matters.

1v1 and 2v2 combat
Build teams that actually work together.

Some rivals even select a team to counter your current party.

Exploration isn’t filler — it’s progression.

Rare monsters hidden off the main path and powerful items and abilities to discover.

New traversal mechanics that open up the world over time and day/night cycles and weather systems that impact gameplay.

You’re constantly finding things that matter.

New Qreatures will be added into the world with regular free content updates.

New monsters aren’t locked behind paywalls.

Even if you never use the Qreature Lab the game keeps growing.

Scan real-world QR codes to create completely unique Qreatures.

You can still find monsters in the wild like normal—but you can also scan real-world QR codes to generate entirely new ones in the Qreature Lab!

The possibilities are basically endless.

Breed in the Qreature Lab to create entirely new species.

Cross-breeding will result in a brand new monster that actually looks like it's parents, combining visual characteristics and inherited stats from both to create somthing new. 

And because those traits carry forward—

you can keep building on them over generations.

"A lot of open worlds are just… big.   Not meaningful."

"I want every corner of this world to matter  -  find hidden secrets, abilities, unique monsters, items, even new mechanics."

"A world that actually rewards your curiosity."

"That feeling of wondering what’s just over the next hill.... 

that’s the whole point."

" It’s an open world monster collector… but I’m trying to fix a lot of the things that always bothered me about the genre. "

 THE QREATURE LAB

If you want to get creatuive, you’ll eventually unlock the Qreature Lab.

This is where things get really....weird.

  • Scan real-world QR codes
    Turn them into completely unique monsters.

  • Breed your creatures
    Offspring inherit traits from both parents — visually and mechanically.

  • Discover new species
    You don’t control the result — but your choices shape it.

Every result is a surprise.
Every experiment pushes things further.

YOU PAY TO CREATE — NOT TO WIN

You can:

  • explore the full world

  • catch hundreds of monsters

  • complete the story

  • build strong teams

Everything you need for a full RPG experience is included in the base game.

The Lab is where things change.

Generating new Qreatures through QR scanning and breeding uses real-time cloud processing, so it has a real cost behind it.

You’ll get a number of free Lab uses included with the game so you can experiment and see what’s possible.

After that, you can:

  • earn occasional additional uses through gameplay

  • or choose to purchase more if you want to keep experimenting

There’s also an optional companion app for players who want to scan QR codes on the go and sync their unique discoveries directly to their Steam library.

No pay-to-win.
No forced spending.
Just optional creativity.

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

I’m building this game solo — learning as I go.

World Of Qreatures started as a simple idea:
“What if a monster game never ran out of new things to discover?”

That led to:

  • a deeper battle system

  • a more meaningful open world

  • and eventually… the Lab

The Lab is the most experimental part of the game.
It uses real-time cloud generation, which means it costs money to run every time it’s used.

I’ve tried to design it in a way that’s fair and transparent:

  • You get a complete RPG experience with your purchase

  • You get free Lab uses to try it out

  • You can earn more through gameplay

  • And if you enjoy it, you can choose to use it more

There’s also an optional companion app for players who want to scan QR codes on the go and sync their unique discoveries directly to their Steam library.

I know this approach won’t be for everyone — and that’s okay.

If you enjoy experimenting and discovering new creatures, you’ll probably love it.
If not, you can still enjoy the game for everything else it offers.
