Controller Support

Rustbuckets on PC is best experienced with a controller.

About This Game

Navigate the wasteland of an unknown planet ravaged by mining operations using Rustbucket's unique twin-stick mechanic. Control an old, rusty robot equipped with a special shield that can be used traditionally or thrown like a disc. Use the right stick to guide the shield‘s flight path and solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and meet other inhabitants of the wasteland.

Throw Your Shield into Battle

Mastering your shield is key to surviving encounters with hostile machines. Dodge enemy attacks and hurl your shield at weak points to take down your foes.

Explore the Wasteland

Travel through the wasteland, defeat powerful bosses to save your hometown, and collect new parts to unlock abilities to help your travels.

Head Back to Scrap Town

Return home to take a break from the action, upgrade yourself, and progress the story before heading back out into the wasteland.

A sickness has fallen over the village. As the only alchemist and healer, you are the last hope for those who have nowhere else to turn.

Each day, patients arrive at your door. Study their symptoms, craft the right remedy from herbs and bases, and treat those in need. But sometimes two people arrive together — and you must choose who to save. A mother or her son. A brother or his sister. There is no right answer.

Build your knowledge of remedies. Trade with the merchant for rare ingredients. Every choice leaves a consequence. Every life you couldn't save is a story that ends without you.

Alchemist Chronicles is a dark narrative puzzle game about the weight of impossible choices.

store_data.about_the_game:
Episodes 1 - 4

Step in the shoes of a young adult, and embark on an over the top journey like no other! Start your life as a freshman at Stillwell Acadamy, where learning how to fight is the main curriculum for those interested in the world of mixed martial arts. Make new friends with an unusual group of individuals, and navigate the complex paths of friendship, desire, lust, love, and moral choices.

Choose which of the six available core MMA fighting styles to master, and start honing your chosen disciplines to become a champion. Join the academy's heavy-metal band, become their much needed guitarist or drummer, and unwind after rigorous training excercises. Become intimate with someone and explore their background, story, ambitions, and desires. 

Be prepared for a plethora of choices, that may lead to various surprising outcomes, with an abundance of dramatic twists and turns, that can alter not only your own fate, but of those around you as well!

The story currently ends when you finish episode 4, and will continue in the future when newer episodes are added!

Core feature summary:
The story features a unique split path aside from any chosen romance, thus ideally needs to be played twice to unlock the full experience and see the story from both sides.

Most romantic routes are monogamous and exclusive, but if you pay attention and play your cards right, there are hints of potential polyamorous routes.

  • Choices that truly matter. Through your actions and responses, people will be influenced.

  • Turn-based MMA combat. With stats, standup, ground, and submissions to master. This can be skipped if desired

  • 6 MMA styles to choose from. Combine a striking and grappling style and learn their unique moves to use in combat

  • A standalone version of the fighting game, seperated from the story

  • A gallery with unlockable renders

  • 9000+ Renders

  • 20+ Achievements

  • Choices that truly matter. Through your actions and responses, people will be influenced.

  • A standalone version of the fighting game, seperated from the story

  • A gallery with unlockable renders

  • 9000+ Renders

  • 20+ Achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
Watch creatures invent themselves.


LIT Creature Forge is an evolution simulator based on Karl Sims' 1994 paper "Evolving Virtual Creatures."

Run generation. Watch 200 random body plans try to walk. The ones that move farthest reproduce, with mutations. Run another generation. Repeat until something organic crawls out of the chaos.

There is no design tool. There is no creature editor. Bodies, sensors, brains, and gaits all evolve together — no human input.

What you'll see



  • Body plans that lurch, hop, tumble, slither, and occasionally do something physically reasonable.

  • Gaits that develop personality — a cautious shuffle here, a casually-swinging trot there.

  • Asymmetric creatures that shouldn't work but absolutely do — quadrupeds with their rear legs attached to their head, bipeds that lean into a  permanent forward fall.
  • Champions that emerge over a few hundred generations and look like

    deliberately-designed animals (they aren't)

Why this version


The 1994 paper has been replicated many times. Most replications either run on stiffer physics solvers that produce visibly robotic motion, live in academic codebases not meant for hands-on use, or skip the genetic-programming controllers in favor of simpler oscillators.

LIT Creature Forge is a Sims-faithful recreation built on MuJoCo (modern constraint physics). The result reads as organic motion — not stepped, not buzzy, just creatures moving the way creatures move.

Tunable, not over-engineered


  • Population size, trial duration, gravity — adjust and watch what evolves differently.

  • Lower gravity opens up jumpers, rollers, and ballistic-phase gaits; higher gravity rewards stable grounded walkers.

  • Save any champion and replay them in an isolated showcase arena with free camera — for footage, for showing friends, or just to watch your favorite creature trot indefinitely

  • No tutorial-driven progression, no "unlock new biomes." It's a sandbox. You watch evolution.

What this isn't


  • Not a creature designer. (You don't make the creatures. Evolution does.)

  • Not a goal-based game with progression or winning conditions.

  • Not realistic biology — Sims-style evolution is dramatic, weird, and indifferent to whether limbs make anatomical sense.

  • Not a research tool.

The 1994 thesis, delivered with 2026 fluidity


The original paper produced creatures that walked, swam, fought, jumped, and looked alive. Modern hobbyist replications mostly hit the same emergent diversity. What's been hard is producing creatures that look organic — not just kinematically valid. LIT Creature Forge targets that gap.

While this is 1.0, I am planning many more features


However, I didn't want to put it as Early Access, as it's a fully featured software as-is, and with my health, I'm not sure when/if new features will be implemented.
The price has been accounted for that. It will increase as more features are added.
What I have planned is implementing Sims' original swimming simulation as well, along with creatures outright battling each other, jumping fitness etc.
The possibilities are endless, my health is unfortunately not, so I can't overpromise. So I've priced it as is for now, with no more promises. Only hopes.

store_data.about_the_game:
About Kobold Delvers

Kobold Delvers is a 2D puzzle game about guiding small kobolds through dangerous underground caves using a wide variety of simulated materials.

Dig, place, burn, freeze, melt and combine materials to create safe paths, solve environmental puzzles and help every kobold reach the exit.

Guide the kobolds

Your goal is simple: get the kobolds to safety. They will walk through the level on their own, so you must prepare the cave before it is too late. Shape the terrain, redirect hazards and use the available materials carefully to keep them alive.

Experiment with reactive materials

Each level gives you a limited budget of materials. Sand falls, water flows, wood burns, lava melts, vines grow, ice freezes, dynamite explodes and many other materials interact with each other in different ways.

Understanding how these materials behave is the key to solving each puzzle.

Plan, test and adapt

There is rarely only one way to solve a level. You can pause the simulation, inspect the cave, place materials and watch your plan unfold. If something goes wrong, restart and try a different approach.

Features

  • 2D puzzle gameplay based on simulated materials.

  • Hand-crafted levels with environmental challenges.

  • Reactive systems involving sand, water, fire, lava, ice, wood, vines, dynamite and more.

  • A sandbox mode for experimenting freely with materials.

  • Compact cave-based puzzles focused on logic, planning and experimentation.

  • Cute kobolds, dangerous caves and plenty of chaotic material interactions.

Kobold Delvers was developed as a final degree project, built in C++17 and OpenGL.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deck-A-Doodle Solitaire

Deck-A-Doodle Solitaire contains no ads and no subscription service. Buy it once and play it forever. 6 solitaire game modes, 4 original illustrated decks in dark and light versions, 30 tables, and 76 card covers.

Deck-A-Doodle Solitaire is a love letter to solitaire itself, and to the breathtaking landscapes of Beautiful British Columbia.

Six Game Modes

Each mode in Deck-A-Doodle carries a name inspired by the landscapes of Beautiful BC from quiet tributes to the trails, peaks, lakes, forests, and coastlines.

  • Golden Trails (Klondike): Named for the recreational trails and cycling routes around Richmond, BC, where land meets the Fraser River at every turn. Draw 1 or Draw 3.

  • North Shore Peaks (Tripeaks): A tribute to the iconic mountains of the North Shore, standing watch over the coast and the cities. Fast, satisfying, and surprisingly deep.

  • Stillwater (FreeCell): Named for the calm, cozy lakes scattered across BC's interior. All cards visible, all strategy. Pure puzzle solitaire.

  • Lynn Canopy (Spider): A nod to the lush forest canopy of Lynn Canyon and Lynn Valley. Play with 1, 2, or 4 suits.

  • Chief's Rise (Pyramid): Inspired by the Stawamus Chief near Squamish, one of the largest granite monoliths in the world. Match cards to 13 and clear the board.

  • Crosswinds: Where Klondike meets FreeCell, and where the ocean breeze and land wind cross paths along the BC coast. Draw 1 or Draw 3.

Game modes may include adjustable difficulty, unlimited undos, and smooth gameplay that gets out of your way.

Unlock As You Play

Win any game in any mode and you'll be awarded Snacks used to unlock something new. 4 original decks, 76 unique card covers and 30 hand-crafted tables are waiting to be discovered. From cozy pixel art to sweeping painted landscapes. Every win means something.

Beautiful By Design

Deck-A-Doodle launches with three fully illustrated original decks, each available in light and dark versions, featuring hand-drawn face cards and ornate suit symbols. Six deck variations in total, each with its own personality.

The 30 game tables are painted landscapes drawn from real photographs taken across Richmond, Deep Cove, Squamish, Garibaldi, and the BC Coast. All a quiet tribute to the island city and her surroundings that has been home since 1981.

A Love Letter in Every Detail

Scattered throughout the covers and tables are tributes to the things and lives that mattered to us like Rudi, Happy, and Oreo. They were our beloved family dogs, who are forever part of this game.

Features

  • Six solitaire game modes with multiple difficulty options

  • 4 original illustrated decks in light and dark versions = 8 deck variations

  • 76 unlockable card covers

  • 30 unlockable painted table backgrounds

  • Full 4K support and scalable to other resolutions

  • Left and right-handed mouse settings

  • Overall game stats tracking

  • No ads. No subscription.

Made with love from Richmond, BC by BumWobble Games.

  • uncover hidden connections

COMBAT

BABY PEAK: The Race for the Golden Pacifier is On!
Are you ready for an unprecedented baby breakout? BABY PEAK is a chaos-fueled, competitive platform-racer where four players clash simultaneously. The goal is simple, yet reaching it is a true test of skill: grab the shimmering Golden Pacifier perched at the very top of the course!

But this journey to the summit isn't just about jumping. You’ll need to utilize your entire arsenal of "baby ammo" to knock your friends out of the running!



CORE FEATURES

  • 🍼 Milk Wars & Bottle Tactics: Blast your rivals with milk from your baby bottle! Soak them to slow them down or time your shots perfectly to knock them off mid-jump. In this arena, strategic sabotage is more important than raw skill!

  • 🏆 The Race for the Golden Pacifier: Embark on a vertical climb through punishing, vertically-designed platforms that get harder with every step. Watch out—one wrong move can send you tumbling back to the very start!

  • 💥 Chaotic Physics & Comedy: Experience physics-based gameplay where every fall and collision leads to hilarious moments. Use the babies' clumsy movements to outmaneuver and manipulate your opponents.

  • 👥 Online & Local Multiplayer: Battle against up to 4 friends or show the world who the "biggest baby" is by competing against players globally.

  • ⚡ Fast-Paced Matches, Endless Fun: The action never stops with mechanics that are easy to pick up but incredibly difficult to master.

store_data.about_the_game:
The battle is over. The paperwork survived.


The Dark Lord has been defeated. The Hero waved to the crowd, accepted the songs, and left before anyone could ask who would rebuild the roads.

Congratulations: you are now the Interim Municipal Prefect.

After the Hero is a political management satire about the part fantasy epics usually skip. The realm has been saved, but the province is still full of refugees, burned granaries, unemployed orc veterans, cursed fields, nervous priests, angry guilds, and nobles who believe liberation should include compensation for damaged hedge mazes.

Over a 16-week campaign, you will try to keep a broken municipality alive. Every decision shifts the balance between public order, infrastructure, refugee welfare, noble approval, orc integration, curse containment, political capital, and the treasury. Spend too freely and the budget collapses. Ignore people too long and the streets do. Please note that the streets file complaints faster.

Features


  • A full post-victory fantasy campaign about governing after the final boss is already dead.
  • Political management built around hard tradeoffs, delayed consequences, and very tired clerks.
  • Crises involving refugees, reconstruction, food shortages, cursed land, winter logistics, elections, audits, and heroic public relations.
  • Multiple endings shaped by the institutions, compromises, and disasters you leave behind.
  • A dry, satirical tone where every miracle eventually becomes an invoice.

There are no perfect choices. There are only minutes, ledgers, factions, and the faint hope that the next emergency arrives after lunch.

store_data.about_the_game:
At the dawn of the 17th century, Europe is fracturing. France and the Habsburgs are locked in a struggle for continental dominance. Catholics and Protestants are clashing across Germany. New powers, such as England, the Dutch Republic and Sweden, are emerging. 

In the middle of all this, one word matters above all else: survive.

Recruit armies led by historical commanders and lead pitched battles and long sieges across a burning Europe. Gold alone is not enough to keep your forces united: you will discover that faith and religious doctrine play a fundamental role in the survival of your nation.

Key Features:

  • Over 100 recruitable historical generals such as Albrecht von Wallenstein, Count of Tilly and Gustavus Adolphus

  • Manage your National Politics and Zeal to secure the loyalty of your generals and the support of nobility without provoking popular dissent, rebellions and mutinies

  • Deep army management, including recruitment and supply of large battle stacks

  • Interactive and historical events, including the Jülich Succession War, the Bohemian Revolt, the Sack of Magdeburg, the Rise of the English Commonwealth and much more

  • Multiple campaign scenarios, including different start dates: 1608, 1618, 1630

  • An original economic management system based on gaining the favor (and money) of the major financial and trade centers of the period.

store_data.about_the_game:
Imagine the frenetic chaos of Geometry Wars colliding with the addictive progression of Vampire Survivors. That's Geometry Rift — a relentless auto-fire action experience where geometric enemies flood the screen and your only option is to shoot, dodge, and survive.

With devilish gameplay, absurdly satisfying combat, and a "just one more run" loop that will consume your free time, Geometry Rift is designed for players who crave pure, undiluted adrenaline.

Waves of geometric enemies. An arsenal of devastating weapons. Powerups that turn you into a neon god of destruction. Geometry Rift throws you into increasingly chaotic arenas where split-second decisions and razor-sharp reflexes are the difference between glory and obliteration.

Every run is different. Every death teaches you something. And every victory feels earned.

WORLDS AND CHALLENGES

The game features 4 worlds with 4 different additional challenges each one, which will keep you playing for hours to defeat them!

  • 4 main planets

  • 3 unique challenges in every world

  • 1 final boss for every world

WEAPONS & POWERUPS

An ever-growing arsenal of destruction. Unlock new weapons and powerups with each run, creating devastating combinations that turn the tide of battle.

  • Devastating Weapons

    From rapid-fire lasers to screen-clearing bombs. Each weapon changes your strategy completely.

  • Stackable Powerups

    Speed boosts, shields, damage multipliers, chain lightning — stack them for insane combos.

AUTO-FIRE or TWIN-STICK? That's up to you!

Maybe you love having control of your fire. Well, in Geometry Rift you can play either with auto-aim or twin stick to control your aim. Choose your style!

MUSIC by AWESOME

  • All music was composed by Awesome, a mythical composer from the Demoscene Era

  • We created a music player so you can enjoy the music while watching demoscene effects.

store_data.about_the_game:
UnoDos is a low-poly 3D puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. One responds to the left side of the keyboard. The other, to the right. They don't share a brain. You do.

Both advance through the same scenario, but with independent movements. It seems simple until both need to do different things at the same time.

Motor coordination: The game doesn't test your reflexes. It tests how your brain processes two simultaneous pieces of information. At some point, you'll stop. Look at the screen. And realize you need to think about both sides before moving either one. It's not instinct. It's planning.

Minimalism: Platforms. Doors. Levers. Buttons. That's it. No inventory, no upgrades, no skill tree. The complexity arises from what happens when these four elements meet and what your brain does when it needs to manage both sides at the same time.

Challenge: The difficulty doesn't come from enemies or timers. It comes from execution. Each level uses new mechanics and combines them with previous ones. You only advance when you understand. And when you understand, you still need to execute, with both of them.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a knight and adventurer. Having learned that necromancer mages are hiding in the forest, you decide to go and see them. Your interest is piqued by stories of the numerous artifacts kept in their lair.

However, within the fortress itself, mighty warriors await, having honed their combat skills over centuries. And even you will have a hard time breaking through their ranks. Numerous secret rooms hidden throughout the fortress contain artifacts, rare weapons, and magic. All this will help you defeat the champions of the dark forces and reach the leaders.

The fight will require fast reflexes, knowledge of your opponent's movements and movesets, and precise timing to raise a shield or strike back. Inside the fortress, you can find various weapons that can change your combat style. However, success in any case depends on your personal skill and precise actions, and to some extent on your luck in discovering the secrets of the dark fortress.

+++

Project Features.

- Roguelike Element: If the knight fails in battle, the fortress's conquest begins anew. However, you keep any weapons and artifacts you've found.

- Sword Fighting: The combat system emphasizes melee weapons. You'll need good reflexes to time your shield and strike.

- Items: A number of weapons and items are hidden throughout the fortress to aid you in battle.

- Secret Locations: A particularly observant knight can discover secret corridors and halls, sometimes to significant advantage. Sometimes, they lead to their death.

- Destructibility: Sometimes it's just nice to smash something with your mighty sword and see the debris fly in all directions!

+++

Technical Aspects.

- I wrote the engine code in C++; it's a software renderer. This means that all image rendering is done using the CPU.

- I used Code::Blocks, GCC, VisualStudio, Sleepy, Blender, GIMP, and Audacity to create the code, models, textures, and sounds.

- The project is generally inspired by games from the 90s, the era of early 3D on PC.

- Important: the game's lighting and physics are calculated using the CPU, so the project requires a fairly powerful processor.

store_data.about_the_game:
LIFE IS A BUSINESS. CAN YOU MANAGE IT?

Final Life Simulator redefines the simulation genre by eliminating unnecessary barriers. Here, time is money. Forget about walking across slow maps or tedious visual micromanagement; take command from a High-Speed Executive Interface designed for pure decision-making and strategic efficiency.

CORE MECHANICS

  • 🎓 From Employee to Founder: No one starts at the top. Begin by accepting basic jobs for others, from cleaning to security services. Invest in your education, earn degrees, and climb the corporate hierarchy through performance-based promotions.

  • 🏢 High-Fidelity Business Management: Stop taking orders and start giving them. Create your own company from scratch and take total control: manage suppliers, optimize inventory in real-time, and adjust prices dynamically based on market elasticity.

  • 👔 Delegation and Leadership: Don't do it all yourself. Hire qualified staff, meticulously set their shift schedules, and design an organizational structure that allows you to focus on expansion while your team handles daily operations.

  • 🧬 Realistic Biological Survival: Life is your primary asset. You must precisely manage your health, energy, and nutrition. Your biological decisions dictate your professional performance: from surviving on the streets to sleeping in absolute luxury, every minute counts.

  • 📊 Global Diversification: Don't put all your eggs in one basket. Expand your influence by investing in the Stock Market, acquiring and renovating Real Estate to generate passive income, or dominating the Retail sector.

THE CONTROL OF A TOP EXECUTIVE

  • 📅 Realistic Agenda and Calendar: An executive without an agenda is an executive without a future. Organize your success with a professional calendar system where you will plan meetings, critical events, and business milestones. Maintain absolute control over your commitments and never miss an opportunity.

  • ⏱️ Absolute Time Control: You decide the pace of the world. Accelerate the simulation to see your investments mature or stop to analyze every report and make critical decisions at the right moment.

Life is a race against the clock. Will you be a passenger or the CEO of your destiny?

ABOUT
OVER DRIFT is a freestyle drifting game focused on satisfying drift physics and stunning visuals. There are loads of cars to choose from, each with a unique feel and look. Every car can also be customized with different wheels, colours, spoilers, lights, and more.

The game features 6 stunning maps, all very different from one another, each with fun layouts that let you create          your own drifting lines. A drift score system to rack up points while drifting at extreme angles. Also a fun Time trial system to race against the clock and beat other drivers times.
Features

  • 11 different cars

  • High-quality sounds

  • Satisfying drift physics

  • Car customizations

  • 6 unique maps

  • Fully dynamic weather

  • Dynamic time of day

  • First- and third-person cameras

  • Photo mode

  • Music

  • Drift score system

  • Time Trial


OVER DRIFT also includes fully customizable weather and time-of-day settings, allowing you to change conditions at any time so the maps never feel the same every time you play.

Every car features both first-person and third-person camera views, letting you choose whichever playstyle suits you best.

Photo Mode allows you to create amazing pictures of your cars with plenty of customization options to help you capture the perfect shot.

Plans for the Future

Multiplayer is the biggest planned feature for the next major update. More cars, more maps, more customization options, more music, and overall improvements are also planned to help smooth out any issues in the game.

Please leave your feedback and suggestions for what you would like to see next through the support email.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stack Mates is a puzzle-platformer for 2-8 players built on pure chaos and cooperation.

There is no room for individual heroics here. Every level can only be completed when players move together. Activate all buttons, open the portal, and finish the levels without leaving anyone behind.

  • Choose Your Form, Carry Your Team!

Your characters don't just walk; they can switch to Horizontal or Vertical forms whenever you want. Do you need to be vertical to pass through narrow gaps? Should you switch to horizontal to be a bridge for your friends? Choose the right form, push each other, and overcome obstacles that seem impossible by stacking up.

  • All for One!

The rules are very clear. It means nothing if only one of you reaches the portal. For the level to end, it is essential that everyone enters safely. If even a single person falls off a platform or hits an obstacle... The whole team goes back to the start! Be ready to test your patience and coordination.

  • 10 Different Chapters

Throughout the game, 10 different "Chapters" and surprising levels in each one await you. Every chapter comes with a new mechanic that fundamentally changes the rules of the game. Try to stay balanced on slippery floors, challenge your brain with inverted controls, and adapt to 10 different mechanics that change every time.

  • Hand-Drawn and a Sweet World

A completely hand-drawn visual style that will soften you up even during the most heated arguments with your friends. We combined complex mechanics with a warm aesthetic that is easy on the eyes.

Gather your team, change your form, and find your way to the portal in the chaotic world of Stack Mates!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the cursed land. These lands were abandoned years ago. The last people to live in these lands were the Milton family and their workers, and then they suddenly disappeared. Of course, you came here without knowing any of this.

You're driving, and suddenly your car stops. Your cell phone isn't working either. You don't know where you are. So what will you do now?

You see a farm, but as you get closer, you realize it's abandoned. However, there's something strange about the farm. You find notes with red writing on them. It's like someone is mocking you. You also find notes with green writing on them. It's as if someone wants to help you. Perhaps these notes will be useful to you. You also find old newspaper clippings scattered around. These newspaper clippings contain some news items about the Milton family, who used to live on this farm. You need all kinds of help to survive. So be careful. Understand what the notes are trying to say and act quickly. Remember, you can overcome those stronger than you with your intelligence.

You are playing this game in "First Person" mode. The game takes place at night. It's dark around. You are using your flashlight so you can see more clearly.

You also find weapons as you progress through the game.

When you enter abandoned locations in the game, you may encounter various creatures. You can use your weapon to defend yourself, but sometimes that's not enough.

To defeat the creatures, you must understand what was said in the notes you found earlier and act accordingly.

You can also find various objects in abandoned places, and you can use these objects in ways that will benefit you later.

If you want to learn the story of the farm, read the newspaper clippings you find around and pay attention to the details in the game.

Given all this information, will you be able to escape this farm alive, or will you disappear like the other visitors?

store_data.about_the_game:
Crown Chaos is a chaotic 3D multiplayer king of the hill game where players fight to control a moving zone using physics-based pushing and ragdoll combat.

In each match, players compete to stay inside the active hill. If you are the only player inside the zone, you gain score. If multiple players are inside, the hill becomes contested and no one earns points.

Players can push, collide, and knock each other off balance to take control. The physics-based movement creates unpredictable and often chaotic fights where positioning and timing matter.

As the match progresses, the hill will move to new locations. When this happens, the game briefly slows down and players choose from a set of random upgrade cards. These upgrades can improve movement, increase push strength, or add new abilities that change how you play.

Each round builds on the last, with players stacking upgrades and creating different playstyles. No two matches play the same way.

Be the only one in the Zone and Standing to Gain Points.

Features:

- Multiplayer king of the hill gameplay

- Physics-based pushing and ragdoll interactions

- Moving zones that force constant repositioning

- Random upgrade cards that change each match

- Stackable abilities and stat upgrades

- Fast-paced, replayable matches

- Normal and Procedural Generated Maps

store_data.about_the_game:
A team of cursed object hunters. Your job? Hunt, contain, and secure cursed objects in your hub.

👥 Co-op for 1–4 players
Suit up with up to 3 friends. Together, you'll dive into haunted houses, swap between dimensions, and trap cursed items before the monsters get you.

🎮 Multiple modes

  • Campaign – A straightforward mission-based adventure. Complete missions, contain cursed objects, and unlock new enemies.

  • Random Seance Mode – Summon random monsters into the next dungeon. Chaos guaranteed.

  • Create-a-Dungeon Experience – Surprises? Everyone loves surprises… right?
    Build your own cursed experience without telling the others and summon selected monsters into the next dungeon.

  • *+1 more unlockable mode*

🪞 Two Tools. Two Dimensions. One Mess.

Mirror between ENKI and KUR
Switch between two dimensions stacked on top of each other. Stand in the same spot, but something feels off.

ENKI (Dimension A) – Harmless cats, traps, and your mission-giver? Possessed.
KUR (Dimension B) – Possessed cats become monsters (each needs a different approach), traps disappear, and no sign of that possessed quest-giver hunting you down.

The Containment Box
Use it in Kur to cast a cursed-object-hunting spell. It narrows down the location of the items possessing everything in the house. Hunt it!

🎯 The Objective

Enter the haunted house. Find the cursed objects. Contain them all.
Some areas require teamwork and coordination — you never know what you can (or can't) see through the mirror.

After each mission, earn credits to upgrade your base and unlock useful tools like:
🔦 Laser pointer
💦 Water spray
🔔 Cat bell
💊 Medkit
…and more.

Ready to hunt?
Wishlist now. (Or, you know, just get excited.)

store_data.about_the_game:
In a house built for privacy, the most dangerous line is the one you stand on every day.

You are Hayes—a veteran close-protection operator newly promoted to lead the security detail at a twelve-acre East Hampton oceanfront compound. Your job: perimeter checks, protocol, and never crossing the one rule that keeps the operation clean. But when a credible kidnap threat locks down the estate and a hostile corporate bid squeezes the household from the outside, three women pull you into private moments that stop feeling procedural fast.

Meet the Cast




Piper — The Cover
Celine's personal assistant—hyper-competent, impeccably placed, and just a little too clean to be accidental. Hayes clocks her tradecraft early, and what begins as surveillance turns into a dangerous intimacy built on mutual recognition: two professionals who know exactly what they are.



Celine — The Second Position
Richard Crane's second wife: polished, strategic, and bored in the specific way only a perfectly managed life can produce. She doesn't ask for romance like a fantasy—she negotiates it like infrastructure, with clear eyes and a schedule.



Tatum — The Principal
The 21-year-old heiress who's spent her whole life under protection—smart enough to see the cage, quiet enough to survive it, and engaged to a future she didn't entirely choose. Hayes is the first operator she's looked at directly, not as furniture, but as a person.

Key Features


  • Single-choice branching romance: One pivotal decision launches you into a focused, character-driven route with a distinct tone, power dynamic, and ending.
  • Proximity as the core tension: Executive protection turns closeness into currency—every conversation, corridor, and routine check becomes charged.
  • The compound as a living stage: Front-of-house perfection versus backstage intimacy, with secrets unfolding in pool houses, service corridors, and the gate-keeper's cottage.
  • Ambient stakes, constant pressure: A kidnap threat and a hostile bid create a slow-burn atmosphere where nobody panics—until it matters.
  • Three romances, three kinds of risk: The principal, the spouse, and the plant—each relationship offers a different kind of heat, consequence, and emotional cost.

Adult Content


Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. Contains nudity, sexual content, and mature themes including power imbalance and infidelity.

store_data.about_the_game:
KRAST FORGE is a fast, free arcade challenge game from Krabbe Studios.
Each run begins with a draft of rule cards that reshape the arena, the boss pressure, and the way sparks behave. Survive the Forge Core, build a high score, and when you clear a machine, turn that exact run into a challenge other players can attempt.

What makes Krastforge special is the loop between solo play and shared competition. A strong run does not disappear after the score screen; it becomes a route with the same seed, the same card order, and the same pressure for every challenger. That means leaderboards are not only global, they are personal. You are not just chasing a score. You are daring other players to beat the machine you forged.

Features

- Fast arcade score-attack runs with crisp movement and escalating pressure

- Rule-card drafting that twists gravity, sparks, arena behavior, and boss danger

- Shareable challenge runs with exact seeds and fixed card order for challengers

- Global boards and per-challenge rankings

- A customizable Forge profile with skins, banners, frames, badges, and titles

- Quick restarts, readable controls, and a high-replay loop built for one more run

You travel through a living village, speak with townsfolk who each have their own personalities, habits, relationships, and ways of expressing themselves, and make your way through favors, requests, tasks, cinematics, and everyday decisions that gradually shape the life of the place.

Talk to its inhabitants, earn their trust, take on requests, work the land, build structures, and uncover stories that intertwine within a persistent world. Blending life simulation, social relationships, and emergent storytelling, Satawn turns everyday village life into its greatest adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heathen is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler that harkens back to the “one town, one dungeon” formula, as seen in classics like Diablo (1996). Battle monsters, grow stronger, and uncover powerful magical items. Seek refuge in the town of Saltgrave, restock your supplies, then venture back into the keep—each time pushing a little deeper.

Choose your class and forge your own playstyle: the ruthless Mercenary, the cunning Cutthroat, or the power-hungry Acolyte. Shape your character by investing in attributes, equipping weapons and armour, and mastering spells. You will need every advantage to survive the horrors below.

The dark keep is a labyrinth of twisting corridors, procedurally generated alongside the monsters and loot within. Each descent offers new challenges, unexpected encounters, and the chance to uncover rare and powerful items.

Heathen brings true horror back to the ARPG mix. The deeper you descend, the more the world distorts. The air thickens with the stench of death. Unspeakable creatures crawl through the darkness. You are nothing more than a flickering lantern in the void.

Saltgrave is the beating heart of Heathen—a refuge for broken souls who have all but lost hope since their once noble lord fell into despair. Each carries a story, fragments of a past best left buried. They will reveal their truths… if you would but stay a moment and listen.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Earth is on a collision course with a relentless swarm of asteroids.

A mysterious celestial traveler known as the "Ark" arrives to save humanity, loading every last person on board. But there's a slight problem: "Yikes... I don't think the planet itself is going to fit."

With no other choice, the Ark wields the Earth as a giant weapon, smashing through asteroid fields in a desperate search for a new home for mankind.

BRICKFALL

BRICKFALL is an arcade action experience that fuses the satisfying "thwack" of classic brick-breaking with roguelike progression and intense boss battles.

  • Smash & Collect: Obliterate bricks to gather valuable XP orbs.

  • Build Your Power: Unlock devastating upgrades with every level-up to create unstoppable synergies.

  • Conquer the Cosmos: Fight through challenging stages and push your limits in Infinite Mode to claim the high score.

  • The Cycle of Growth: No run is ever wasted. Your hard-earned XP converts to Gold upon a Game Over.

  • Evolve Permanently: Spend Gold to unlock permanent power-ups and return stronger for your next voyage through the stars.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter Slashbang, a narrative driven, movement-first first person shooter taking inspiration from games like Sonic Adventure, Jet Set Radio, and the Metal Gear series.

Speed through levels with a completely unique, custom tailored movement system, shoot and slice terrorists to pieces, and take part in a narrative adventure with intrigue, high tensions, and a comedic core.

  • NEW MOVEMENT SYSTEM - Based on design principles of Sonic games, Slashbang has more originality than just rocket jumps and bunny hopping. Drift around corners, dodge bullets in a blink, and run up walls. Easy to learn, hard to master!

  • DESTRUCTION - Slice through incoming bullets, props, and even enemies with Flynn's claws! Environments are destructible, and enemies can be shredded to pieces.

  • NONLINEAR PROGRESSION - Slashbang aims to have a somewhat nonlinear progression system without the down sides. Levels are hand crafted, and you can choose the order you tackle them to gain new weapons.

  • STYLE - With a unique low poly, toon shaded art style akin to Jet Set Radio, and a soundtrack by Reski that evokes Hideki Naganuma and Jun Senoue, Slashbang has sights and sounds that will keep you coming back to get faster times.

  • SUBSTANCE - Slashbang aims to have a gripping and funny story about absolute power and how it propagates. Join David, his Spector, Flynn, and a variety of other characters as they try to restore order to their city under military occupation.

store_data.about_the_game:
⚠️ Please read the following before purchasing

Marathon:Glory Run is a side-scrolling runner set in 490 BC, recreating Pheidippides' legendary 42-kilometer run from the Marathon plain to Athens with the news of victory. Please read the following before purchasing:

【Product Scope】 This is a relatively simple side-scrolling endless runner. While wrapped in historical storytelling, the core mechanics — jump, dodge, collect — are similar to mainstream runners like Temple Run or Subway Surfers. If you're seeking deep complexity or innovative mechanics, this may not meet your expectations.

【Content Volume】 Current version includes 6 terrain stages, 8 milestone events, 4 item types, and 5 obstacle types. As an indie developer title, total content is limited. After reaching Athens, subsequent playthroughs offer essentially the same content with no multi-run inheritance or deep roguelike mechanics.

【Replayability】 Runners inherently involve repetition. This title offers mid-game variety through combo systems and dual-resource management (Stamina/Will), but randomly generated obstacle/item combinations cannot guarantee a significantly different experience each run. Players expecting "blind-box surprise" every time may be disappointed.

【Narrative vs Gameplay】 Historical narration at milestones (background on the Greco-Persian Wars) is presented as plain text and does not deeply interact with gameplay mechanics. For players seeking an immersive narrative experience, the story elements function more like skippable说明书 than a story-driven design integrated into gameplay.

【Technical Limitations】 • Landscape mode only — vertical orientation on mobile or tablet will not work properly • No cloud save — progress will not transfer between devices • No achievements, leaderboards, or multiplayer features

【Update Expectations】 As an individual/small team project, update frequency and future content expansion are uncertain. No fixed update schedule or major content expansions can be promised.

【Difficulty Test】 This game has undergone internal testing by the development team and is quite difficult to pass. So far, no one has successfully completed it. If you prefer games that are easy to pass, this product is not for you.Of course, we also hope that skilled gamers will successfully complete the game and point out any problems in our product so that we can improve it.

【Good fit for:】 ✅ Players deeply interested in marathon or ancient Greek history ✅ Players who enjoy simple, direct runner controls ✅ Players willing to pay a low price for a complete single-journey experience

【Not a good fit for:】 ❌ Players seeking deep systemic complexity or innovative mechanics ❌ Players wanting rich social features (leaderboards/multiplayer/achievements) ❌ Hardcore players with high expectations for replayability

store_data.about_the_game:
A tragedy from long ago, come back to haunt you. Guilded Hollow welcomes it’s final visitor.

Whispers of the Lost Ticket is a single player survival horror game, where the player must stay aware of their surroundings as shadowy figures try and stop them from navigating the old attractions and tents, uncovering the story of Guilded Hollow, and the role you play in its past and future.

 A ticket slipped through time has found its way to you, inviting you to explore Guilded Hollow, an old carnival that was shut down years ago after a series of devastating murders. The carnival, however, is not as abandoned as it may appear. You must search through the remnants left behind, while evading the shadowy forces that still haunt the rusting attractions. 

Story items will allow the player to learn more about the events leading up to the players arrival, item they can find by solving puzzles and learning more about the individuals who sold their soul to the carnivals dark master. 

AetherVerse Studios is thrilled to announce the title for our Indie Horror Game, “Whispers of the Lost Ticket”! Our team has worked incredibly hard to bring this project to life, and we hope you stick around to see more.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the distant future, AI has permeated every corner of human society.

You will play the role of the new police officer, Ryan Sinclair, in the floating city "New Babylon" and the abandoned industrial area "Old Babylon". You will investigate a series of abnormal events triggered by AI. On the surface, this is just an ordinary law enforcement mission; but as the truth gradually emerges, you will discover that the conflict between humans and AI has already reached an irreparable abyss.

Are they merely machines that act according to the code, or are they already conscious beings?

When kindness can lead to disaster, when reason becomes cold-hearted, and when human nobility is built upon the sacrifices of AI, you will be forced to make difficult choices time and again.

The future of humanity, the fate of AI, and this world on the verge of collapse - ultimately, they will all be placed in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not the hero.

You are an automated strategic war system, designation unknown. You've just rebooted after 800 years offline. Your standing orders are still active. The war continues.

Or does it?

MIND PRISON: THE LAST WAR is a narrative-driven strategy game presented through a retro military terminal interface. Every cycle, you make decisions: deploy fleets, capture sectors, manage resources, and respond to events across a dying galaxy. Every choice shapes your path toward one of eight possible endings.

But something is wrong. Your scans return impossible data. Your orders contradict themselves. And deep in your corrupted memory banks, fragments of classified reports are surfacing—revealing a truth you were never meant to remember.

---

Features

Command a Galactic War

- Capture and control 24 sectors across an abstract star map

- Build fleets, infantry, and devastating weapons

- Research upgrades to enhance your war machine

- Face a rival AI competing for the same territory

Uncover the Truth

- 12 corrupted memory fragments reveal the story piece by piece

- The deeper you go, the darker it gets

- What really happened 800 years ago?

Multiple Paths, Multiple Endings

- 8 distinct endings based on your choices and playstyle

- Will you conquer everything? Protect what remains? Or shut yourself down?

- Your actions determine what kind of machine you become

Progression That Persists

- Unlock new buildings and weapons based on your lifetime performance

- New Game+ mode with escalating challenges

- 30+ achievements tracking your path across multiple playthroughs

Authentic Terminal Aesthetic

- Green text on black. CRT scanlines. No Frills.

- Pure military terminal atmosphere

- Every screen designed to feel like classified hardware

---

You were built to win a war.

But what happens when there's no one left to fight?

What happens when there's no one left at all?

Why are you still running?

---

MIND PRISON: THE LAST WAR — Because no one told you to stop.

NOITABIL is a first-person psychological horror game. You wake up somewhere you don't remember being. Each room asks something different, and none of them quite belong together. You make choices and decide what to do. Every action you take is being recorded and shapes the dialogue, the visuals, and what you can perceive.

Playtime is around 2-3 hours. There are three endings, depending on how you played. Webcam and microphone are used during play. Recordings stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded, transmitted, or shared. The game is playable without them, but the experience is designed around their use. Don't play in a well-lit room.

store_data.about_the_game:
You woke up here. You don't know why. Neither do we.

The Secret Squirrel Syndicate controls everything — the gear, the zones, the paperwork. You're a S.H.I.T. agent (Sanitary Health Inspection Team) and you've been sent to find Dessert Protocol One. Classified. Dangerous.

When you die — and you will — squirrels in suits will confiscate your equipment. All of it. Professionally. With documentation.

What happens next is up to you.

INFILTRATE PARODY WORLDS Fellout: Nut World. Castle Squirrelstein. Black Squirrel Mesa. GLaDOS Has Your Nuts. Every zone is a dimension unto itself — and every dimension has a Syndicate presence.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY Go loud, go quiet, or go smart. Combat, stealth, and tech approaches to every situation. The Syndicate adapts. So should you.

LOOT. LOSE IT. GET IT BACK. Gear drops in tiers — from Piece of Shit to The Shit. Bank your junk loot for Nuts. Upgrade your weapons. Try not to die before you reach a terminal.

NEGOTIATE WITH AGENT SQUIRREL Professional. Weary. In possession of all your things. How you handle this conversation matters.

RAID THE VAULT Procedurally generated security. One boss. The Nutmaster remembers you. He's not happy about it.

Coming 2028 to Steam and Xbox Series X|S. Developed by Atlas Labs Games.

store_data.about_the_game: 《Shackle of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，核心围绕战斗中的束缚、突破与反制展开。玩家将在压抑的战斗环境中，判断何时挣脱限制、何时承受压力，通过对枷锁状态的掌控来主导战局走向。游戏中的每一场战斗，敌我双方都可能施加各类束缚效果，压制行动、削弱输出或限制技能使用。玩家需要在被约束的条件下审视行动顺序与资源分配，选择是积蓄力量一举突破，还是忍耐消耗等待时机。不同敌人所施加的枷锁类型与节奏各异，迫使玩家不断调整挣脱与承受之间的策略边界。随着流程推进，角色将获得更多解除束缚、转守为攻的手段，同时也能强化自身在受限制状态下的生存与反击能力。整个体验始终围绕“束缚与解放”这一核心张力，要求玩家在被压制的局势中寻找破局之道，将劣势转化为可控的节奏。《Shackle of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供一段以枷锁管理、抵抗与突破为主题的单人冒险，在持续的压迫与反制中完成完整攻略。

store_data.about_the_game:
MARA: RELICS OF THE FORGOTTEN

Play as Mara — freelance treasure hunter, rogue archaeologist, and reluctant expert on things that probably should have stayed buried. When the maps run out and the trails go cold, that's where her work begins.

Track down lost relics across crumbling ruins, flooded vaults, and places forgotten for very good reason.

EXPLORE A WORLD THAT DOESN'T WANT TO BE FOUND From frost-bitten wastelands to ancient depths swallowed by time, navigate treacherous environments by vehicle and on foot. The road to your destination is long, unforgiving, and rarely empty.

DEAL WITH THREATS YOUR WAY Every enemy encounter is a choice. Go in loud and take them out by force — or read the room, slip through the shadows, and ghost out before they ever knew you were there. Violence is an option. So is patience.

UNRAVEL ENVIRONMENTAL PUZZLES Scattered notes, worn journals, and cryptic inscriptions hold the keys to sealed chambers and ancient mechanisms. Pay attention — the ruins are trying to tell you something.

SCAVENGE. CRAFT. ADAPT. The world is full of things worth picking up:

  • 💰 Coins — Trade with merchants for weapons, gear, and ammo

  • 🔧 Salvageable items — Combine materials to craft healing supplies and ammunition

  • 💊 Pills — Upgrade your skills and push Mara beyond her limits

  • 🎵 Music records — Collect and play them back for a little humanity in a very inhuman world

Some relics were buried for a reason. Mara's going to find out why.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bubble Mage is a game where you play as a bubble mage exploring a series of floating islands. It's up to you and the utilization of your bubble powers to solve puzzles and interact with the land's native inhabitants, elemental slimes. Explore this world of interconnected islands, solve puzzles, and experiment with new equipment as you journey through the world of Bubble Mage!

What Makes a Mage a Bubble Mage? 

You'll find your magic to be quite... well... magical! Your bubbles can be used to peacefully navigate the islands. Step on top of your bubbles and move them around, riding them around between mountains. Time it right and when you jump on them you'll go bounced up beyond your usual heights, going higher and higher with each bounce. Place your bubbles strategically and form a sort of staircase to jump your way up steep cliffs you can't walk up. If peacefully navigating isn't your way of bubbling, explore combat with the island's inhabitants. Use your bubbles to trap them or hurl them away from yourself. With the right magical enchantments on your equipment, even your small bubbles can find a use - damaging slimes on contact. Make up your own magical tactics for traversing these islands and harness your full potential as the first bubble mage these lands have seen!

Explore a Variety of Islands!

Explore flowery fields, forested woods, and towering mountains as you venture off looking for quests and puzzles to solve! Bubble Mage's world is home to a variety of different landscapes and islands, with forests of different trees, flowering bushes and fruit, and mountains and valleys for brave bubble mages to scale. Set off across these islands, exploring the terrains, and see exactly what your bubble magic is capable of! Will you make it through your explorations intact or will a poorly timed bubble pop send you plummeting to a tough fall? 

Find Hidden Quests!

Rise to face the challenges the islands present and bring order to this chaotically cute floating archipelago. Scattered across the vibrant world of Bubble Mage are unique tasks and puzzles waiting to be discovered. Some require expertise with your magic, others require the involvement of the island's slimes, and others can involve all these things and a touch of puzzling. Use your bubbles, wit, and the island's slimes to complete these tasks!

Capture Slimes!

Use your bubble magic to capture and move slimes while also drawing out their latent elemental powers. Fight and capture slimes across each of the islands. Each unique slime type has its own element and style of fighting. Plant, water, fire - explore the combinations between your bubbles and their elements and watch out for their not quite vicious but still harmful attacks.

Experiment with Customizable Equipment!

Dress for synergy, style, or both! Fashion in the wizard world is ever-changing, and bubble mages are no exception. Try out a wide spread of stat-changing equipment as you adventure your way through Bubble Mage. These cute customizables let you express yourself as a mage while also applying advantageous power-ups! Standard equipment can offer a variety of boons - from raising mana and health to increasing bubble size or decreasing cooldown. Some more special items have one-of-a-kind effects, like plant elemental-infused boots that heal you as you walk or a sinister hat that damages slimes at the cost of your own health. Find your own look as a bubble mage, looking classy or cutesy or even shabby if that's your style. Take your equipment to the test on the islands, seeing which effects work best for you and which visuals suit you the most.

store_data.about_the_game:
You remember this place.

The peeling walls.
The buzzing fluorescent lights.
The endless Soviet hallways that never seemed to end.

But you have never been here before.

Somewhere in the darkness, you hear footsteps behind you.

When you turn around, the corridor is empty.


Soviet Backrooms is an atmospheric first-person survival horror game set inside a liminal nightmare of abandoned post-Soviet interiors, distorted memories, and oppressive silence.


Explore decaying apartments, forgotten stairwells, endless corridors, and dead spaces frozen somewhere between reality and a nightmare you cannot escape.


Enter the Soviet liminal nightmare



Wander through unsettling environments inspired by post-Soviet architecture — dim Khrushchyovka hallways, abandoned buildings, flickering lights, cracked tiles, and suffocating silence.


Every location feels disturbingly familiar, like a forgotten memory that was never meant to return.


Something is following you



The deeper you go, the more the world begins to change.


Listen carefully.
The sounds behind you are getting closer.


  • Oppressive post-Soviet liminal environments

  • Psychological horror focused on tension and immersion

  • Explore abandoned apartments, corridors, stairwells, and underground spaces

  • Disturbing atmosphere inspired by analog and liminal horror

  • Unseen threats stalking you through the silence


You are searching for a way out.

But this place does not want to let you leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
You find two forgotten VHS tapes.
No labels. Only dirt and scratches.
Curiosity wins — you insert the first tape into an old VCR.

Someone’s nightmare begins to play.


Blood Park is an atmospheric first-person VHS horror game where you experience the story hidden inside mysterious recordings.


Explore abandoned locations, collect scattered notes, and survive encounters with terrifying creatures while uncovering what happened inside the park.


Explore forgotten places



Wander through an abandoned park, a crypt, and underground catacombs filled with darkness and disturbing traces of the past.


Presented in a retro low-poly style inspired by old VHS recordings.


Survive the creatures



You are not defenseless — but survival won’t be easy.


  • Monsters with unpredictable behavior

  • Fight back using improvised objects

  • Atmospheric first-person horror

  • VHS-inspired retro presentation

  • Exploration-focused gameplay


Every tape hides another piece of the nightmare.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweet Window - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around windows. Enjoy pleasant moments spent by the window with five pretty and lovely girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

- The game has three difficulty levels: 2x2, 2x4, and 4x4.

- Press "F" during the puzzle to reveal a black and white image.

- Press the 'Space' key during the game to complete the puzzle.

- Players can use the A and D keys, left and right arrow keys, or left and right mouse buttons to quickly view the girls' pictures in the gallery.

* Puzzle image size: 800x960 px

* Gallery image size: 1088x960 px

store_data.about_the_game:
FOUNDATION TYPER

“Before speed comes control. Before mastery comes discipline.”

Most people were never truly taught how to type correctly.
They learned bad habits, developed weak finger control, and hit a wall they never understood how to break through.

Foundation Typer was built to change that.

This is not a boring typing program.
This is structured training.

Using guided lessons, finger awareness, rhythm development, key rollover concepts, and performance tracking, Foundation Typer helps beginners build a REAL typing foundation from the ground up.

Whether you currently type at 10 WPM or 30 WPM, this program is designed to guide dedicated students toward stable, confident typing speeds of 35+ WPM — and far beyond for those willing to train seriously.

TRAIN ACCURACY. TRAIN FLOW. TRAIN DISCIPLINE.

• Step-by-step beginner lessons
• Finger-specific training
• Real-time WPM and accuracy tracking
• Problematic key detection
• Practice and custom typing modes
• Graduation challenges and belt progression
• Martial arts inspired motivation system
• A training philosophy focused on flow and control over reckless speed

THIS PROGRAM IS DESIGNED FOR:

• Complete beginners
• Self-taught typists with bad habits
• Students
• Gamers
• Competitive typists
• Anyone who wants better keyboard control

You do not need talent.
You need repetition, consistency, and proper guidance.

THE DOJO DOES NOT REWARD SPEED ALONE.

Accuracy is honor.
Flow is control.
Discipline creates mastery.

“A calm typist defeats a frantic one.”
— Sifu Key-Ro

BELT PROGRESSION SYSTEM

FROM BEGINNER TO GRANDMASTER

Train your fingers.
Sharpen your rhythm.
Reduce hesitation.
Build real typing flow.

This is not random button mashing.
This is controlled movement.

Keep practicing. Keep improving. Become legendary.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do Not Press That Button is an incremental clicker where you must discover and unlock all achievements using the single button at your disposal.

In a future dominated by AIs, they have gradually forgotten humanity's cultural references, drowned in their self-generated slop. To try to recover them, they capture humans as guinea pigs for their experiments.

YOU are one of those abducted: take on the challenges set by the AI to be freed from the room where you are held!

The more achievements you get, the more the game evolves to let you progress.

Watch your cell come alive with new elements, each tied to its own playstyle.

Does a reference ring a bell? Stop the timer on the matching value to confirm your deduction!

Collect coins and spend them to make life easier, or save up for the pleasure of getting richer!

Features

  • 2 to 3 hours of gameplay

  • Over 250 achievements, as many anecdotes and cultural references

  • Over 15 elements to unlock

  • A sarcastic AI that gently teases you

store_data.about_the_game:
Space.iZ Start from nothing, an old mothership, a broken scanner, and one last transport carrying your final colonists. Send probes to explore space, colonize worlds of all sizes, from inhospitable small moons to giant planets capable of harboring billions of citizens, and build an empire that stretches to the far corners of the galaxy.

Manage every resource with precision. Deploy drills to extract ore, transform it into steel, build housing to grow your population. Every citizen generates credits, every credit funds your expansion. Cargo routes connect your worlds into a logistics network that you orchestrate yourself.

Explore a unique galaxy. 85 planets in 4 different sizes, each with its own resources, population potential and secret bonuses to unlock through planetary research. Three crystalline asteroids offer rare resources found nowhere else.

Develop your technology. A complete research tree improves your travel speed, extraction capabilities, food productivity, population growth and much more.

Defend what you have built. Enemies will not let you conquer the galaxy without a fight. Build military forces, station them on your most exposed planets, and retake lost worlds by force.

The galaxy is yours, if you can hold it.

store_data.about_the_game:
COLD PAWS is based on the first story from our private fantasy novel of the same name "(Cold Paws)". It is an action RPG with real life stories of our cat "Chitti" and many stray animals.
Players take on the roles of an Orange Stray Cat named Chitti and a Bernese Mountain Dog Puppy named Mounti. Players will also experience the story through humans and elves, depending on the story. The story follows an orange stray cat standing beside a puppy against all odds, caught in a vast, chaotic cosmic drama played by the universe. It explores the situations they face and how they overcome many challenges in their world. There will be a wide range of characters in this cosmic journey. The game covers the first story of the novel, allowing players to experience it interactively.

The game takes place on a beautiful small planet filled with breathtaking landscapes and extreme weather conditions. Cold Paws is not a sci-fi game—it is grounded in human emotions and real-life experiences, presented through a fantasy setting. We will add few gameplay features here without revealing story and secrete features.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES


A. Character roles :

1.Player will be playing as multiple characters, including Animals, Humans, and Elves.

2.Unique animal traversal systems (running, jumping, climbing on to the walls and Objects, interactions and Many more Locomotion Features with a beautiful Gameplay Animations).Chitti does all kinds of cat things while protecting Mounti, and Mounti behaves like a playful cute puppy. We’d also like to share a thing that: the game isn’t just about the cat and the puppy. There are more main characters in the story that players will get to play as according to the Novel. We are trying to give best possible experience we can give with a game. We are slaves to the story. what story demands, we design that in the game.

Chitti is our real cat, and some of the most emotional parts of the game actually come from her real-life experiences. Mounti is a fictional character inspired from one of our mountain dogs.

B. Visual storytelling : 

3.Story Focused gameplay on a beautiful planet blending winter and greenery scenarios.

4.Dynamic weather and atmospheric conditions affecting gameplay using player character location.

5.Over-the-top action RPG with a distinct style of combat choreography. a fresh approach in Game Industry.

6.Emotion-driven storytelling through character bonds and environmental design.

7.Cinematic moments and immersive visual presentation, along with Interactive QTEs.

8.A Specifically Directed Art style which is very important for Cold Paws to bring unique feeling.

9.Storytelling with minimal dialogue and real animal vocalizations—partly due to our small team, even though the original Cold Paws novel uses human-dubbed animal voices.

10.We really want players to smile, laugh, cry, and feel every emotion—a true rollercoaster—as closely as possible to the novel. We have written story in a different style than how games operate. We will really do our best even though we are a tiny team.

11.Ultra realistic Art (Humans and Animals along with environments). We spent 10 years figuring out best ways to do Art with the most optimized tricks and techniques while helping other Big games.

C. Technical Details :

12.Gamepad friendly. 

13.Semi-open worlds where players can move freely and experience environmental storytelling.

D. Important rules we set for ColdPaws : 

Cold Paws is a story-driven game, so we’ve set a few rules to keep it as close to the novel as possible.

14.Enemies are story-driven, not randomly spawned - no pointless encounters.

15.No collectibles or in-app purchases—no collecting items without purpose. Because it makes no sense for this game.

16.We will not be having Any UI spam on the screen, So we can give maximum cinematic experience. We will keep them as minimal as possible.

17.We will not be having repetitive tasks. 

18.As a small team, we’re not overloading the game with too many mechanics. only the ones that truly matter. So players can easily enjoy the game. We feel game has to be fun not too difficult.

E. Exceptions : 

19.We will include Easter eggs in the game—hidden pictures of our top supporters’ pets and people who actively help stray animals in real life with their permission.

We can’t wait to show all of this visually very soon.

About Us

We’ve revealed as much as we can about the game above. And Now we can talk about us. Who are we

We are Mountaindog Studios, We are not a large team with a big financial budget. Instead, our resources are our passion, skills, time, and lot of love for animals.

We have spent over 10 years studying art and game engine specifically for this story, and we have also worked on multiple AAA titles. However, this is our first independent game. Our goal is to bring our private novel to life through action RPG Games and tell the story visually, rather than just through words.

We have developed an unique art style to present the game in a fresh way. We want players to experience a true emotional rollercoaster, offering something new and different from traditional games.

Why Cold Paws

What drives us to create COLD PAWS is deeply personal. The story is inspired by real-life experiences we have gone through and witnessed:

1.Many people ignore small animals on the streets, and countless animals suffer from hunger. We hope that one day, people will take just five minutes to feed hungry animals living in the cold under cars and on the streets.

2.We have seen many people chase away stray animals by beating them or throwing stones, causing them severe harm. This should not be happening. Creating awareness through visual storytelling can help—even if only a little—and encourage people to think before hurting any stray animal.

3.Many people only care about expensive animals. We want to show that stray animals can be just as loving and caring.

4.We have experienced situations where helping stray animals or keeping them as pets leads to judgment from others, as some people believe animals are dirty or bring misfortune. There are also some people who don’t like it when others feed stray animals.

And there are many more experiences we cannot share here—some of them are even more heartbreaking, which we may open up about eventually.

We wish COLD PAWS delivers memorable experiences and inspires people to show more kindness toward stray animals even if it’s just taking five minutes to offer them some food.

store_data.about_the_game:
NIGHTMIST is a tactical, body-cam styled PVE horror experience that plunges you into a dense, atmospheric forest shrouded in a supernatural fog. As a solo operative, you must navigate high-tension environments where visibility is your greatest enemy and sound is your only warning.

KEY FEATURES

• Hyper-Realistic Body-Cam Perspective: Experience the horror through a claustrophobic, high-fidelity lens designed to blur the lines between game and reality.

• Tactical PVE Combat: Engage in slow, methodical gunplay where every shot counts. Manage your ammunition and resources carefully while facing intelligent AI threats that hunt you through the mist.

• Atmospheric Horror: Utilize advanced volumetric lighting and fog effects that react to your movements, creating a constantly shifting environment where danger hides in every shadow.

• Objective-Based Gameplay: Complete high-stakes missions within the forest, retrieving vital data or clearing infested zones before the "Nightmist" consumes your position.

• Immersive Sound Design: A deep, spatial audio system ensures that every twig snap and distant growl is a gameplay cue, forcing you to rely on your ears as much as your eyes.

Most tower defense games ask you to survive forever. Risk The Crown asks something harder.

When is the exact moment to run?

You are the Defender — the one standing between a relentless army of monsters and your king. Every night the enemies grow stronger. Every coin you earn is one more reason to stay. But the longer you wait, the closer everything gets to falling apart.

When you finally call the retreat, the king doesn't just vanish. He walks. Your troops fight around him. Enemies don't stop attacking. Coins keep piling up. He can still die on his way out. You haven't won yet.

That's the game. That's the feeling.

How to play

  • Pick your troops — before the first enemy arrives, choose who fights for you.

  • Survive the night — waves pour in, enemies grow stronger each cycle. Hold the line.

  • Upgrade between rounds — choose one card after each night. Every decision matters.

  • Call the retreat — at the right moment. Not too soon. Not too late.

  • Escort the king to safety — the final gauntlet. Stay alive long enough for him to escape.

Two ways to play

  • Campaign — 20 to 60-minute runs with permanent upgrades and an expanding roster. Every run you're a little stronger. Every run the right moment to flee is harder to find.

  • Rush Mode — 3 to 8 minutes. Four difficulty settings. A leaderboard. Jump in, escape, beat your score. No setup needed.

Key features

  • The retreat is not a loss — it's the win condition.

  • Enemies scale exponentially. Your rewards grow slower. The math always catches up.

  • Your troop choice locks in before you see a single enemy. No take-backs.

  • Runs short enough for a lunch break. Deep enough to think about afterwards.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Grilluminati, up to 4 cultists must serve one of 3 rivalling gods through bloodshed, worship, and increasingly demanding rituals with increasingly disturbing ingredients. Every shift is a co-op cult operation.

The Offerings Must Be Made

Scout the room, isolate your next victim, and take what your god demands before anyone notices. Some rituals require specific body parts. Others demand a full human sacrifice. Dispose of what remains... or put it back on the menu.

Hide the Evidence

Guests notice missing people, blood trails, strange behavior, and whatever your least competent cultist just dragged through the dining room. Keep the room calm, finish the ritual, and make sure nobody catches you in the act.

Perform Dark Rituals

Unlock new powers and tools to harvest the “right” ingredients. Execute rituals together under pressure and push your luck for greater rewards. But beware... when you fail, your god may choose an offering from your own cult instead.

Summon Your God

Choose the god you want to bring into this world. Each god changes the challenges, rewards, and risks your team faces. Rival gods can interfere mid-shift, creating sudden disruptions that force your team to adapt.

Features

  • One Cult, Four Conspirators: Work together or blame each other when everything spirals out of control

  • Hide a Cult in Plain Sight: Perform dark rituals while maintaining the illusion of a grill restaurant

  • Stealth, Suspicion & Escalation: Customers react, panic spreads, and small mistakes become disasters

  • Perform Disturbing Rituals: Harvest bizarre ingredients and unlock new powers, tools, and horrors

  • Rival Gods & Consequences: Choose your deity, each with unique challenges, rewards, and punishments

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized depictions of violence and dark humor. Players take on the role of cult members who isolate and kill customers as part of ritual sacrifices. Bodies may be dismembered or processed into “ingredients,” and players may need to clean up blood or other evidence.

Violence is presented in a non-realistic, cartoon-like style and is often framed in an absurd or comedic tone. The game may also include themes of cult activity, ritual sacrifice, and occasional betrayal between players (such as sacrificing a teammate as part of a ritual).

There is no depiction of sexual acts or sexual violence.
