store_data.about_the_game:
Provisions Are Heaven, Life and Death on a Thread

Provisions move before troops. Here, grain is far more than a number — it is the lifeline that can decide an entire campaign. Every soldier and every warhorse consumes supplies in real time, and you must personally plan the routes of your supply convoys, guarding them fiercely against enemy interception. Once your supply lines are cut and granaries run empty, your army will rapidly starve: morale collapses, stamina drains, soldiers begin disobeying orders and fleeing, and an elite force can disintegrate in an instant. You must personally oversee grain allocation, establish military farms, plunder enemy storehouses, and even consider “foraging off the enemy” in desperate straits — the most brutal yet most authentic way to keep your army alive. This unforgiving logistics system forces every commander to calculate every last grain before a campaign. Every expedition is the ultimate test of resource mastery.

A Tide of Foes, Seamless Offense and Defense

The enemy will never sit idle. They will hurl themselves at your defenses in relentless, endless waves, and AI commanders will even adjust troop compositions and shift the focus of their assault based on losses. Amid the frantic moments between defensive actions, you must direct your soldiers to hold the gates, plug breaches, and withstand wave after wave of all-out, suicidal attack. And once the city is successfully defended, the roles reverse in an instant — you can lead your rested, full-strength army out on the offensive, suppress internal rebellions, wipe out roving bandits, or even launch a long-range raid to strike enemy cities, carrying the war onto their soil and turning the tide from defense to attack.

Diverse Troops, Devious Formations

You can train distinct troop types such as spearmen, sword-and-shield infantry, archers, crossbowmen, light cavalry, and heavy cavalry. Every unit possesses its own attack, defense, movement speed, cost, and footprint on the battlefield, all governed by a complete rock-paper-scissors counter system. Before battle, you will freely drag, rotate, and position formation blocks on a grand sand table, meticulously arranging your forward barrier troops, main battle line, flanks, and reserves. From classic formations like the Fish Scale and the Crane Wing to your own irregular skirmish patterns, the choice is entirely yours. Exploit unit counter relationships and the advantage of deep positioning to disrupt the enemy’s line of advance before the clash even begins, forcing them to blunder headlong into the death trap you have designed.

Boundless Battlefields, Dynamic Warfare

Throw yourself into a fully open, dynamic battlefield. You can use complex terrain — mountains, forests, rivers, slopes, and ravines — to lay pocket ambushes or fight with your back to the water, achieving victory against overwhelming odds through formation placement and terrain advantage. On the battlefield, a dynamic weather system forces you to adapt: torrential rain slackens bowstrings, extinguishes fire arrows, and turns the ground into mud that bogs down heavy infantry; dense fog hides movements, ideal for surprise attacks but also a risk of stumbling into traps; scorching sun accelerates water consumption, and bitter winter blizzards drastically reduce the combat power of troops not outfitted for the cold. At the same time, a unique random character system generates distinctive wandering champions, bandit chieftains, reclusive geniuses, and even hidden legendary strategists of the enemy faction. They may suddenly charge into the fray or defect in the heat of battle, filling every siege and field engagement with unpredictable variables.

Impregnable Fortress – Building Defense in Depth

Defense is not a single thin wall — it is layer upon layer of progressively reinforced killing barriers. You can construct thick rammed-earth walls, later upgraded to brick-faced stone fortifications, and erect multi-story arrow towers, ballista platforms, and trebuchet emplacements atop them. Beyond the gates, you can add barbicans, iron portcullises, and pit traps, shaping a three-dimensional defensive line of “outer moat – rampart – main wall – inner partitions.” As you invest resources, you will unlock sequential trap arrays, rolling-log and rock-launching frames, and cascading cauldrons of burning oil, transforming every inch of your position into an insurmountable wall for the enemy. True siege warfare is not a contest of numbers — it is a brutal war of attrition and a battle of wits.

City Management, Steady Accumulation

A comprehensive city management system demands you govern your domain like a true protector of the realm. You must meticulously balance grain reserves, timber, stone, iron, and other strategic resources; expand dwellings to attract refugees, thereby broadening your tax base and recruitment pool; and plan farmlands, markets, workshops, academies, and other production and research buildings, striking a balance between civilian welfare and military industry. Population demographics, public loyalty, and corvée labor burdens all dynamically influence the stability of your city and the efficiency of conscription. Only by laying a rock-solid logistical foundation can you sustain the long, grinding war for supremacy.

Assembling Heroes, Chance and Conquest

The vast world map is scattered with rich, diverse random events: mountain bandits on the prowl, urgent distress calls from villages, fierce champions hidden in ancient temples, lost texts buried in ruins, or even an open-air scholarly gathering. Along the road, you will encounter commanders of unique skills and backgrounds. There is more than one way to bring them under your banner: inspire them with virtue and honor, entice them with wealth, promise them official rank, or, after shattering their army on the battlefield, persuade them to surrender, imprison and convert them, or even capture an enemy general and break their will through persistent psychological assault until they genuinely pledge their loyalty. Every officer holds their own personal code of loyalty and distinct preferences. Whether you can gather the realm’s finest talents into your fold depends entirely on your methods.

Unique Hero Development & Combo Mastery

You will personally forge unique, top-tier warriors in the heat of battle. Every general follows their own growth path: by slaying enemies in live combat, winning duels, and completing tactical objectives, they gradually unlock godlike combo skills such as Sweeping the Ranks, Armor-Piercing Execution, Formation Splitting, Gale Thrust, Whirlwind Dance, and Bone-Shattering Blow. These skills are never simple button presses — they interact deeply with attack rhythm, body positioning, and enemy formation. Seize a split-second opening in the chaos, chain together a smooth execution combo, and tear through the enemy line in an instant. From a fierce champion who charges ahead of the troops to a realm-expanding god of war who plucks an enemy commander’s head from among ten thousand soldiers as easily as reaching into a bag, you will witness their transformation in the grinding test of blood and iron.

Myriad Tactics, Free Skill Combinations

Every officer possesses a diverse, dedicated skill tree that covers both passive enhancements and active combat techniques. Passive abilities might permanently increase troop capacity, boost the damage of a specific unit type, or trigger a desperate last-stand state when all seems lost. Active combat skills include charge techniques, formation maneuvers, and stratagems, such as Iron Wall Defense, Blazing Arrow Formation, and Ambush Disruption. Based on your generals’ skill pools, you can freely mix and match them for different battle scenarios, crafting your own exclusive tactical school: will you have a lieutenant specialize in defense to grind the enemy down, or unleash a dual-core burst combo to obliterate the opposition? It all rests on your decision.

Blood-Soaked Growth, Ascending to a God of War

Through the crucible of countless brutal live battles, along with dedicated training fields, war academies, and combat simulation facilities, you will continuously hone your officers’ levels, base attributes, and skill proficiencies. Experience comes not only from kill counts, but also from completing high-stakes tactical assignments and scoring decisive kills on enemy commanders. You will witness them rise from mere captains leading a few hundred men, step by step, into great generals who hold entire regions, and finally into battlefield lynchpins who can shift the realm’s tides with their own strength. Their legend is written by your hand.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHARKS UNDERCOVER

You and your friends are sharks masquerading as dolphins to dupe and snatch the clueless fish who wander into your shop. Keep up the act and don't let those teeth show!

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

Stock the shelves with seashells and fresh seaweed, serve the locals, and keep the place spotless. Work your fins off to earn their trust - it’s the perfect cover for your shady business on the ocean floor!

GIVE WHALES A GLOW-UP

Win the trust of the ocean’s behemoths by buffing their bellies and fins until they sparkle. Gaining whale loyalty is your ticket to winning over the smaller fry!

THE PREDATOR'S SECRET KITCHEN

Snatch your own customers and turn them into gourmet delicacies in the hidden basement beneath your shop. Your shop is the bait, and they’re the main course!

THE FISH POLICE ARE WATCHING

Underwater cops are on your tail! Scrub the crime scene, lie through your teeth during interrogations, and don’t let the fuzz catch a whiff of what’s cooking in your kitchen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mary awakens in a high-contrast world with no memory, trapped within a series of isolated and deadly scenarios. Trials of Mary is a story-driven, cinematic survival horror experience where your intelligence is your greatest weapon. Within a modernized nightmare loop, you must confront the darkest rules of classic horror cinema.

This journey, consisting of 4 main chapters each with its own unique atmosphere, offers 5–6 hours of intense gameplay. Stripped of unnecessary details, this experience allows you to directly encounter the most iconic subgenres of horror cinema.

Core Gameplay Features:

Intelligence and Strategy: Even if you are not a fighter, you can use environmental objects to survive and defend yourself when necessary.

Real-Time Interaction: No time wasted in menus; to solve complex puzzles, you must physically pick up, rotate, and examine objects in the 3D world.

Dynamic Escape and Defense: Use the environment to evade your pursuers. Each chapter presents unique enemy behaviors that force you to adapt your strategy.

Minimalist Interface: Focus entirely on the atmosphere with a “living” camera perspective that reacts to Mary’s fear, without cluttering the screen with UI elements. Can you complete this descent before the darkness fully consumes you?

The trial begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight, idle, and keep growing.

BreakDespair 2D is an all-directional scrolling shooter set in space, built around mining, automatic upgrades, drones, weapons, and explosive number growth.

Mine ore, convert it into GOLD, and strengthen your fighter, battleship, weapons, drones, missiles, and support beams. You do not need to manage every upgrade manually. If you have GOLD, your fighter and battleship can upgrade automatically.

There are no game overs and no time limits.

This is a shooter about steadily becoming stronger, not about being punished for every mistake. You can actively move and fight for better efficiency, or rely on auto-fire and automatic upgrades when you want a more relaxed experience.

If things become dangerous, stopping movement can also become a defensive option. From Evolution Level 7 onward, your fighter becomes invincible while not moving, and your drones can continue collecting ore and supporting you.

Automatic Growth

Upgrade items grow automatically.

There are 20 weapon types, but you can progress without constantly changing them.

Upgrade ratios can be adjusted, but the default settings are enough to play.

Players who enjoy shooters can fight actively, while players who want a calmer experience can let auto-fire and auto-upgrades handle much of the progress.

Explosive Number Growth

At first, even small meteors are a challenge.

As you grow stronger, more turrets, drones, missiles, battleship beams, and weapons fill the screen with firepower.

Features include:

- 19 upgrade categories

- 20 weapon types

- 15 evolution levels

- Main levels up to 900 million

- Up to 6 turrets

- Up to 4 drones

- Battleship beam and missile support

- Cleared zones can be challenged again with stronger enemies

- Eventually, you will face enemies with power reaching 90 quintillion

AI Companions

The story is supported by Lumiere and Astraea, two AI android companions.

They are not tools, and they are not enemies. They think, fight, and travel together with you as allies.

In this story, AI itself is not the enemy. What threatens peace is the force that tries to take freedom, intelligence, and emotion away from living beings.

During your journey through space, you will meet AI, fairies, other civilizations, mechanical lifeforms, and even those who were once enemies.

Story

In a certain country on Earth, you lived with two adopted daughters and two AI androids.

However, the world changed drastically because of a certain force. AI was forbidden from having will or emotion, and people also found it harder to live freely.

Following Lumiere's proposal, you escape by warping away with your battleship. Your two adopted daughters hide in cryosleep, while you, Lumiere, and Astraea fly into unknown space.

After the warp, you arrive in an unknown region of space.

All you have is the damaged battleship Lumiere and one fighter, Astraea.

Your journey begins as you try to return to the Solar System and defeat a massive enemy.

Recommended For

- Players who enjoy numbers growing bigger and bigger

- Players who want idle-friendly progression

- Players who want a shooter with no game overs

- Players who do not want constant manual upgrade management

- Players who like science fiction stories about humans and AI living together

- Players who want to play at their own pace

Features

- No game overs

- No time limits

- All-directional scrolling shooter gameplay

- Automatic upgrade system

- Idle-friendly play

- 19 upgrade categories

- 20 weapon types

- 15 evolution levels

- Main levels up to 900 million

- Up to 6 turrets

- Up to 4 drones

- Battleship beam and missile support

- 8 zones plus character endings

- 11 characters with individual episodes

- Replay cleared zones with stronger enemies

- Keyboard and gamepad support

Story

Your mission is to find ten rare plants whose properties our species need in our planet.

You are performing your mission at night so you can avoid human contact. If however, you notice these creatures who call themselves as humans you can calm them down with a special beam we installed in your ship.

Keep an eye out for rare collectibles such as interesting music cassettes and other art creations so we can admire them back at home.

This is time of music, peace and love so remember to enjoy your journey along the way. Groovy travels my friend.

Groovy Gig is a short and casual game where you control an alien in a spaceship. This is a hand-drawn casual 2D game with the main themes of nature, art and peace. Everything you collect can be admired in your spaceship. It is designed to bring you nostalgic atmosphere of the era. Who wouldn't want to be a hippie alien?

Features

  • Fly around with your awesome spaceship

  • Listen groovy music as you collect the tracks along the way

  • Collect cool stickers that you can put in your spaceships window

  • Find rare plants and place them in your special made capsules

  • Calm down people who are arguing in their houses with your peace ray

  • Have fun and enjoy the 70s!

store_data.about_the_game:
Belt 'em all!

Travel the land far and wide to add all Beltmon to your belt! (Cause that's where you keep 'em, not your pockets)
Dozens of unique creatures each with their transformations to form your personal team and challenge the champions of every city.

Depressive pixel art

Are you tired of colorful, bright and uplifting landscapes? Say no more!
With Beltmon's darker-than-necessary and gloomy unique art-style you will feel right at home.

Retro looks

A mix of 90s 8 and 16 bit pixel art to warm the hearts of those who have already lost their spark and to give the younger ones a taste of what we had to deal with.

Rock is the goat

In an age of electronic music, overproduced sounds and autotune, Beltmon's soundtracks will make you feel like it's the early 2000s again. Back when music was made of music.

THIS IS A PARODY

This game is a PARODY and as such is protected under the EU law.

store_data.about_the_game:
Life Shatter is a first-person psychological horror game about guilt, despair, and the attempt to find a "better" reality to live in.

After passing the point of no return, the protagonist discovers the ability to move between realities. Each new reality brings you back to familiar spaces, but the details are no longer the same: objects, events, and people shift, while the consequences of past decisions gradually accumulate.
To move forward, you must observe, compare, and memorize key changes that bring you closer to the reality you seek. Mistakes lead to darker branches, where pressure, fear, and guilt grow stronger.

The game is built around atmospheric exploration, unsettling cutscenes, and environmental storytelling. As you progress, new fragments of the story are revealed, and the question "Can a life be fixed?" becomes increasingly ambiguous.

Key features:

  • First-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere and tension

  • Reality shifting with branching episodes and multiple outcomes

  • Observation-and-memory gameplay: finding and tracking changed details

  • Story delivery through environment, sound, cutscenes, and internal monologue

  • A consequence system that affects later scenes and the ending

Important content warning:
This game contains mature and heavy themes, including suicidal themes, depictions of violence, strong language, references to alcohol and drug use, as well as sexual implications.

store_data.about_the_game:
History will remember this Petty Warfare as the War of the Frontier's Birth. We know what started it and how it ended, but we still know nothing about the Knight who determined its outcome.

You arrive in the New South as a knight of the Empire, born to enforce God’s miracles upon the world. Knight is your duty. Knight is your name. Knight is all you know. 

In search of the Saint of the Frontier, you will lead a vanguard of eight companions. Each with their own interests, reasons, and obligations. They will not follow you out of fellowship. They aren't your puppets, and they despise each other. They will interfere and spy on you. Yet some may become the names you never truly leave behind.

As commander of the rear division, you will bring God's judgment upon the living. Resolve conflicts between settlers, stop disobedience, pass sentences on traitors, and find the fragile balance between the army, the aristocracy, and the colonists — or break it completely. Your judgments will dictate the outcome of the campaign’s decisive battle.

Exploring the frontier means pushing the borders of the Holy Valley outward. Your mission will take you deep behind enemy lines, across the lands of the Forgotten People, through villages consumed by religious hysteria, and into places the Church and State won't even acknowledge exist. How far and how hard you push will determine how far the Empire's borders reach.

And of course, you will fight: enemy forces, hostile predators, people who have made this land their own, and creatures older than the faith that gave this war its justification. Out here, their numbers make it hard to pretend the frontier was uninhabited before.

As a knight of the Empire, many eyes are on you. Much is expected of you. You are meant to follow duty, serve the common good, and uphold the virtue of your title. But the Frontier keeps its own testaments. 

The First Saint has already been born — and he will force you to choose.

Key Features

Dynamic real-time combat with personal responsibility: In combat, you will read your enemies, wait for openings to strike, and unleash divine miracles upon them. The farther you advance, the sharper your skills will become, and more of your miracles will manifest. You will not fight alone. Members of the Vanguard bring unique talents to the battle, carrying out your orders or violating them.

Eight companions with their own will: Your relationships depend on various parameters including personal sympathy, the choices you make, and your authority in their eyes. Each one has a history, personal interests, and quests to complete. And yes, there are romance options among them.  

A morality system that actually works: Your choices mean nothing if you aren't willing to answer for them. Tired of evil playthroughs that just cut content and only exist for YouTube creators? So are we. Every choice in Petty Warfare has pragmatic weight and real value. Which value you prioritize is up to you.

Decided to train orphans to fight back? Good. You did what the common good demanded. A few weeks later, a band of raiders will appear in the area. Refused to kneel before bandits? Good. You didn't compromise the honor of your title. But your brother lost his arm in the fight. Sentenced a deserter for fleeing the battlefield? Good. The code demands it. By morning, his father has cut off the army's supply line.

Dialogue built around pressure: Branching conversations that shape your leadership style. Interrupt people mid-sentence and delegate lines to companions without knowing what they're going to say.

Rear camp management: Handle correspondence, guard rotations, and the kitchen. Manage your soldiers and pass judgment on deserters. Every decision matters. Like really. Choices made in the demo will land in the short term and follow you into the full game.

A frontier of horror and politics: Over 50 original characters created to show you different faces of the New South. Some of the plot will reach you through events. Some through symbolic dreams. Some only on a second playthrough. The frontier is set in a hand-crafted world with a thousand years of history behind it. Politically and institutionally grounded, but full of weird creatures, strange cultures and dark fantasy imagery. 

The New South teems with life: You were trained for war against Ariolanian forces and armies of the Confederation. But the frontier is home to more than that: apex predators, native species of anti-humans once thought extinct, and colossal remnants of the ancient Despots. They can sense your miracles. They hate every manifestation of them. And they remember what the frontier was before you crossed their border.

A Deal Was Made.

 The CEO of ARCO, a failing game studio, made a pact with the devil. Success, fame, power — all granted. The price: the souls of every child who played their final game.

  • Classic dark-fantasy 2D platformer inspired by early Castlevania

  • Steam Achievements tracking your journey through the darkness

store_data.about_the_game:
Hunter's Mark takes place within a world of fantasy magic and creatures mixed with modern mechanisms. You play as a Hunter and your job is to cull down populations of Goblins, Ghouls and whatever else the Guild wants Gone. And with your impressive stamina, sharp senses, and a Guild-funded arsenal of fantasy-esque guns (ammo not included) at your disposal, you're an expert at it.

Happy hunting.

FEATURES

  • First-Person Hunting

    Pick and prepare for missions of FPS-Action, Run, Jump, Crouch and Dash around the level, around enemies, perhaps even Dash INTO enemies. Gun down enemy hordes until your quota is met, and once it is, head back home to a paycheck. Repeat ad nauseam.

  • Weapons

    Fantasy-esque troubles need fantasy-esque weaponry to deal with, luckily you have a few given to you by the Guild. You'll be able to bring Three different weapons on missions, but you'll have to fund your own ammunition, right out of your own wallet. Joy.

  • Stealth Is An Option

    While you can always throw caution to the wind and dump all your ammo on enemies, you could also pick them off one-by-one with extra damage from Sneak Attacks and preserve your ammo. Be careful however, because one poorly thought out shot and you could get forced to use the former option.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a settlement from nothing

Starting from nothing, you gather enough wood to build your first campfire and shelter. From there, settlers will join you and merchants will arrive, allowing your city to thrive. Roll to Riches is an incremental city builder that begins with nothing and brings you closer to a thriving Viking city with every roll of the dice. Every building you raise and every worker you assign is a step toward economic prosperity.

Roll the dice

Every resource gathered, grown, mined, or processed is determined by the roll of a die. Expand and improve to gain more and better dice. Build out your settlement, increase your population, and automate each dice roll with your villagers.

Trade and expand

Once per minute, a traveling merchant arrives in town, ready to trade. The merchant brings tools for mining, seeds for farming, and sheep for shearing. Sell what your settlement produces and buy tools to construct new buildings or improve production.

From fire pit to Viking trading hub

The gameplay loop focuses on growth: build, roll, trade, and upgrade. As your wealth increases, so does your production. Can you develop your production chains and manage your resources effectively to make your ancestors proud?

The dice are cast. Will you roll your way to riches?

You are Steve. A boyfriend, provider, and the guy who keeps forgetting to take out the trash.

store_data.about_the_game:
Store Expansion & High-End PC Setup

Expand your space to place more PCs and unlock a variety of high-end models to become the best premium PC cafe in the neighborhood.

Strategic Logistics & Inventory Management

It doesn't end with just setting up PCs. Unlock the highlights of a Korean PC cafe: various K-snacks, drinks, ramen, and frozen foods. Keep your shelves and refrigerators fully stocked.

Pricing & Review System

Set the prices for everything yourself, from PC usage fees to food. If it's too expensive, customers will stop coming; if it's too cheap, you won't make a profit. Achieve efficient growth by setting optimal prices that match your store's reputation.

Efficient Staff & Part-Timer Management

As the store grows, you won't be able to handle all the serving and cleaning alone. Hire and assign part-timers who fit your operational needs. Proper staff placement is the key to increasing your store's turnover rate.

Real-Time Store Maintenance

Drinks spilled on the keyboard, dust on the floor, smashed monitors... Customers will be the first to turn away if the store is dirty. Manage it yourself by running around, or hire competent staff to maintain a pleasant environment at all times. Cleanliness directly translates to sales.

Facility Expansion & Hardware Upgrades

Reinvest your profits to upgrade the quality of your store. Unlock essential amenities like restrooms and smoking rooms, and expand your space.

Paint your own body! Blend in like a chameleon in this hide-and-seek game!

yeah! Mechcha "Hide and Seek"

The rules are simple. Split into the Seeker team and the Hider team to play hide-and-seek. The Seekers win if they find everyone within the time limit.

yeah! Mechcha "Paint"

The way you hide is a bit special. Paint your pure white body to blend into the stage. Just like a chameleon. The hiding spot, the pose, and above all, your artistic skills are the key! Deceive the Seekers' eyes with a mimicry that would even surprise a chameleon.

yeah! Mechcha "Matching"

Of course you can play with friends, but you can also play with people you don't know. (If you create a server that is not set to private, anyone can join freely.) Game streamers can easily host viewer participation games. The maximum number of players depends on the host's network environment. (2–10 players recommended. Junebug was designed as a calm companion to help you stay focused and make your work sessions more intentional. Begin by setting a duration for your session and the tasks you want to complete. Choose a peaceful natural environment, forests, gardens, and quiet outdoor spaces, and settle in with your cat companion. Work at your own pace, complete tasks as you go, and unwind before your next session.

As you progress, spend time in new areas, each with its own atmosphere and mood, from soft garden settings to deeper forest environments designed for focus and calm.

As you complete sessions and tasks, keep track of your progress and build a record of what you’ve accomplished over time.

Forget routine resource gathering. Here, your guests are the resources. Harvest their parts to stitch together a loyal workforce and complete your magnum opus: the Perfect Being. This is a dark-sim with high viral potential and a deep progression system.

  • Hotel Renovation & Expansion 

Restore the hotel to its former glory. Customize rooms, select eerie furniture, and open new floors as your profits grow. Keep the guests coming and the silver flowing, you’ll need it for your research.

  • Exploration and  Minion Crafting 

Explore every dark corner of the hotel to find hidden resources for upgrades. Descend into the hotel’s underworld. Use your surgical arsenal: syringes and scalpels, to exterminate the local vermin and monsters. Dissect your kills and stitch them together to create zombie staff. Being a zombie is hard work. Your minions wear out and eventually fall apart, forcing you to constantly hunt and craft fresh replacements.

  • Guest Management 

Satisfy your guests whims by matching them with the perfect rooms. But remember: you aren’t just a host; you’re a predator. Utilize guests to collect valuable biological materials essential for your scientific breakthrough.

  • The Laboratory 

The heart of your operation. This is where you process your "finds." Decide whether a fresh limb is better suited for a new bellhop or if it’s the final piece needed for your Perfect Being.

About This Game

Pegote is a dynamic deckbuilder. You reshape your deck as you go.

During each run, you'll play cards, attach stickers, and mutate them mid round. Every modification is permanent, forcing you to commit to your decisions and adapt to what you've created.

What starts simple quickly evolves into layered, high stakes decision making. Stickers stack, interactions emerge, and your deck becomes a system of its own. Some combinations will feel brilliant. Others will spiral out of control. Learning to navigate that chaos is the key to mastering Pegote.

Discover, experiment, exploit synergies, and deal with the consequences of your own designs.

Features

Mid run card mutation
Modify your cards as you play. No fixed builds, only what you create in the moment.

Permanent choices and consequences
Stickers stay. Every decision shapes your deck and locks in new possibilities and risks.

Emergent synergy system
Layer stickers to create unexpected interactions. Discover powerful combos or dangerous outcomes.

From simple to deep
Easy to understand, but quickly grows into complex, system driven decision making.

Every run is unique
Your deck evolves based on your choices, leading to wildly different strategies and outcomes.

Manage momentum, save each other from bad situations, and push forward through a world that punishes mistakes and rewards coordination.

  • Shared chain connection between bikes

  • Physics-based movement and interactions

  • Communicate through proximity voice chat

  • Checkpoint progression across the map

SUIT UP, OFFICER, THE INMATES ARE HERE

The prison buses never stop. Team up with your friends in co-op to run the intake checkpoint. Manage the endless crowds of inmates, do your job, and try to get through chaotic shifts.

NOTHING GETS PAST YOU

Every inmate is hiding something. Use X-ray scanners, sniffer dogs, and manual checks to find the weirdest contraband. Make sure nobody enters the cell block with a secret stash!

MANDATORY WATER PROCEDURES

Let’s be honest: new arrivals are filthy and often too energetic. Grab a water pistol to wash them down or to calm the rowdy ones. Just keep it professional and make sure the warden doesn't see any visible bruises.

PAPERWORK AND WARDEN'S ORDERS

SALARY VS SIDE HUSTLE

You can definitely build your career honestly and upgrade your tools step by step. Or... you can take the fast track. Accept bribes and secretly sell the weird contraband you confiscate. Whatever you do, just don't let the warden catch you running a shady side business.

store_data.about_the_game:
Assemble the pieces

Manage your tides to the best of your ability, and optimize your placements. Collect precious resources: materials to construct the buildings whose plans you'll find here and there, food to ensure the survival of your population, magical energy, sacred shells, and more...

Manage your population

Feed them, care for them, pamper them, if you want them to continue giving their best. Assign them useful and necessary tasks, even if they are not always pleasant, so that they can best serve the Kingdom.

Explore the world

The world is full of remarkable places : observation towers, forgotten temples, lost shipwrecks, hidden idols... All deserve to be visited, but you'll have to make choices. Choose your path wisely : the shortest isn't necessarily the safest. Take the time to study the map to find the one that will be the most advantageous.

Defend your Kingdom

Hordes of malevolent creatures will swarm to make your life miserable, torment your people, and destroy your kingdom. Do not be intimidated, and strategically position your military buildings and soldiers to resist more effectively.

Pray to the Gods

They are powerful, terrible, and in a very bad mood. They are just waiting for you to make a mistake so they can unleash the devastating tsunami that will spell the end of your Kingdom (and the game). Pray for their favor, and for luck and natural conditions to be more favorable to you.

Find the compass

Hunt down the clues, piece together the map, and locate the compass of destiny with which you can find dry land, and thus protect yourself from marine cataclysms and the whims of the Gods.

Collect the relics

Find all the treasures buried in the mud. Dig in the right place, collect them, and equip yourself with those that seem most useful before setting off on your adventure again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fizzle Fighters reinvents the classic bomber arena formula with precision mechanics, strategic positioning, and a pressure system that separates beginners from masters.

What Makes Fizzle Fighters Unique?

It's not just about placing bombs. It's about controlling space. Knowing when to push, when to retreat, and when to take risks.

Special Equipment

Alongside the classics you love (bomb kicking, speed boost, increased blast power), Fizzle Fighters introduces unique skill-based items:

  • Impact Gauntlet – Charge your punch to destroy crates directly and break through defenses.

  • Golf Club – Launch bombs from a distance, attacking from impossible angles.

  • Dash Shoes – A quick straight-line burst to dodge last-second explosions.

  • Omni Amplifier – Amplifies for a moment every tool to its peak potential. Impact Gauntlet charges faster and unleashes rapid multi-hits; Golf Club sends bombs soaring over extreme distances; Dash Shoes grant a powerful, long-reaching leap.

Coin Collect Mode: No One Sits Out

Forget being eliminated and watching others play. In Coin Collect, everyone plays until the end — making it the perfect mode for online play.

How it works:

  • Instead of being eliminated, players get temporarily stunned when hit.

  • When stunned, they lose some coins, which drop to the ground.

  • The goal: have the most coins when the round timer ends.

  • Coins are found inside crates… or stolen directly from rivals.

The result: Constant tension, thefts, and counterattacks. There's always something at stake. No waiting around.

Multiplayer Without Limits – Online That Never Dies

Fizzle Fighters is the first title in the Fizzle Fighters Ecosystem. Our studio is already working on new themed bombers that will connect to the same world:

  • A pirate-themed one (in Buccaneer's Booty universe)

  • A penguin-themed one in Antarctica

  • A monkey-themed one fighting over bananas in the jungle

We're also developing mobile versions and a retro web game, all compatible with the same online platform through a unified API.

What this means for you:

  • Cross-play between different titles in the ecosystem

  • An active community maintained for years to come

  • Each new game adds players to online matchmaking without fragmenting the user base

  • Your progress, unlocked characters, and stats carry across the ecosystem

Local and Online

  • Local Multiplayer: Up to 4 players on the same couch. Multiple sub-modes with variable rules.

  • Online Multiplayer: Compatible with other titles in the ecosystem through our API.

Why Fizzle Fighters?

Because it's not just another game. It's a growing platform. Every online match you play today helps build a community that will be even bigger tomorrow — with more connected products and more ways to play. No downtime. No boring eliminations. Just explosions, coin stealing, and strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stack pairs. Build power gems. Detonate. Bury your opponent under cascading garbage.

ChonkBlocker is a head-to-head puzzle battler in the Puyo Puyo / Puzzle Fighter lineage, sharpened by a decade of "what if the comebacks were even bigger." Drop falling pairs of chunky, color-coded Chonker gems, match colors into chains, build giant 2×2 power gems, then time the detonation that cascades into a single screen-shaking chain reaction. The garbage rains on the other board. Your opponent has roughly four seconds to find an answer. Often they don't.

The depth lives in the reads — when to defend, when to bait a counter, when to hold a power gem one more turn for the perfect setup. Every match is decided by a handful of frame-perfect calls and the comeback nobody saw coming.

Features

  • Comeback-friendly combat. No match is over until the screen fills. Fat chains and well-timed power gems flip momentum in seconds — the comeback is a core mechanic, not a fluke.

  • Online 1v1 with matchmaking. Drop into a quick-match queue or set up a private match with a friend. Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, and Linux players are matched on the same servers.

  • Local network play. Self-host on your LAN for tournament night, dorm play, or any time you want to skip the internet entirely.

  • Vs. CPU practice. Sharpen reads, drill chain patterns, and warm up against trainable AI before stepping into the queue.

  • Eight Chonkers, all yours. Brix, Tempo, Pip, Cinder, Vesper, Juno, Lattice, and Flicker — each with their own attitude on win, loss, and detonation.

  • Chunky, readable 2D art. Bold, color-coded gems and crunchy detonation effects built to read at speed even when the board is in chaos.

  • An original chiptune soundtrack that bangs. Retro hardware sound, modern hooks, every track a banger. The music ramps with your chain count — bigger swings, louder beats, harder hits.

  • Controller-first, Steam Deck verified. Built for couch play. Verified on Deck Gaming Mode. Mouse and keyboard fully supported.

  • True cross-platform. Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon native), and Linux + SteamOS — same game, same chonk, anywhere you play.

Wishlist now to follow development and get notified when the demo and beta open up.

store_data.about_the_game:
Print In Progress is a cozy management sim about the simple satisfaction of running a 3D print shop. Take on orders, manage your filament, and watch voxel models come to life layer by layer. Ship your creations to earn cash, then reinvest it to grow your hobby into a full-scale workshop.

Not every customer is in a rush. Decide how you want to manage your time:

  • Fast Orders: High-pressure, high-reward. These need to be finished quickly but pay out a premium.

  • Slow Orders: Low-pressure, lower pay. Perfect for when you want to take your time and enjoy the hum of the machines.

Every model needs material. Before you hit "Start," make sure you have enough in the tank.

  • Filament Management: Manage four different types of filament. The more complex the model, the more plastic it consumes.

  • Auto-Generation: Unlock upgrades that will help you get filament easily so you can focus on the bigger picture.

Every print is a trade-off. Tweak your settings to match your goals:

  • The Detail Slider: Go for a "blocky" fast print or a super-fine detailed model. High detail earns more money but keeps the printer busy much longer.

  • Overdrive Mode: Need it done now? Crank the speed. Just be careful.. pushing your printer too hard increases the risk of a failed print!

  • Cinematic Mode: Hide UI, get popcorn and lean back while watching the printer work. Becomes a satisfying time-lapse once your printer reaches insane speeds.

The job isn't done when the printer stops. You’ve got to get your hands a little dirty:

  • Clean the Print: Satisfyingly break off the support structures to reveal the finished model.

  • The Shipping Toss: Aim and flick your finished product into the shipping box. Try not to miss!

Take that hard-earned cash and pour it back into your passion:

  • The Upgrade Tree: Unlock new models, better printer parts, and helpful automation.

  • Expand Your Fleet: Why have one printer when you can have four?

  • Make it Yours: Decorate your workspace. Take any print from your inventory and place it on your shelves or worktable to make the shop feel like home.

Play however fits your mood:

  • Engaged Mode: For when you want to lean in. Prints are faster, progression is snappier, and the shop is busy.

  • Idle Mode: Turn the game into a "tiny Desktop Companion." Let your tiny 3d printer run as a cozy screensaver in a corner while you work or study, and check in on your prints whenever you need a break.

Now it's time to create your little workshop!

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

"The end of the tunnel doesn’t always lead to salvation."

Miles to Nowhere is more than just a typical horror game; it is a first-person (FPS) psychological horror experience where your perceptions, your past, and your conscience collide.

STORY

In the midst of chaos, during a village raid where bullets fly... As a police officer, you have run out of ammunition and have only one choice left to survive: A dark, forgotten tunnel, sealed years ago and wiped from the maps. But this tunnel is not just a physical passage; it is the beginning of a journey into the deepest corners of your mind and your suppressed traumas.

When you emerge from the tunnel, the world is no longer as you left it. Every shadow you see and every growl you hear will remind you of the heavy burdens of your past.

KEY FEATURES

Psychological Collapse: The world around you shapes and shifts according to the character's mental state. The line between reality and hallucination blurs with every step.

Claustrophobic Atmosphere: Deep tension created through narrow tunnels, abandoned locations, and high-quality visuals.

Ammo Management & Despair: You are a police officer, but your magazine is empty. Will you face your enemies or hide in the darkness? Your choices will determine your chance of survival.

Deep Narrative: A tragic finale where you will experience the character's internal destruction firsthand, told not just through dialogue but through environmental storytelling.

The hugely popular streamer Komayama Kiri finally stars in her own streaming survival action game!

Join the fox-eared, glasses-wearing V-streamer Komayama Kiri as she livestreams her way through mysterious, galaxy-scale trials!

Falling, streaming, drama, viral fame, and endless waves of enemies――.

Grow as a streamer while surviving overwhelming threats from every direction.

What is the true nature of the mysterious entity known as 【NEKO】?
What is really happening behind the Perseus Constellation Annual Video Awards?

Can Komayama Kiri really “do absolutely everything” until the very end!?

Game Features:

“Komayama Kiri Does Everything” is a streaming-themed survival action minigame collection.

▶ Action gameplay where you dodge obstacles while falling through the sky

▶ A semi-idle simulation where you turn livestreams into videos and spread them across the galaxy to gain popularity

    ・Upgrade your streaming gear and editing environment to take on even greater trials.

▶ Survival action gameplay where you dodge, attack, and power up against massive hordes of enemies

    ・Combine numerous upgrades to create your own unique build.

Strange events constantly occur, including streaming trends, cosmic entities, and chaotic surprises.

Each minigame features its own gameplay mechanics and unique events.

Play Time

80–120 minutes

Video & Streaming Guidelines

You may freely livestream, upload videos, and create content featuring this game without needing permission from the publisher.

Monetization of gameplay videos and streams is fully allowed on any platform, including donations, memberships, and all other monetization systems.

We would appreciate it if you include the game title in your stream/video title and link the Steam page in the description whenever possible.

The publisher assumes no responsibility for any damages or issues resulting from streaming or uploading videos of this game.

If there are any discrepancies in interpretation, the Japanese version of these guidelines shall take precedence.

These guidelines may be changed without prior notice.

store_data.about_the_game:
What would you leave behind to find your way home? She Was King tells the story of three little witches, bound in sisterhood, separated by something they never saw coming.

Choose between three witch sisters, each with her own special elemental power. Whether you want to summon the bones of the dead or sling razor sharp knitting needles with the ease of a ninja, the choice is yours. 

Speaking of choices...you have decisions to make. Each decision affects how you'll experience these weird worlds...and whether you'll make it out alive...or not. 

Features:

  • Your choices create your future. Decisions you make in-game will directly impact gameplay. 

  • High-Octane Combat. Harness your own skills against a large variety of quick-acting monsters. 

  • Trinkets can save your life. A well-timed snack can mean the difference between making it out alive, or not. 

  • Multiple Distinct Biomes. Magic lurks around every corner, in worlds as tame as a cozy forest, or as strange as a twisted circus. Ever been to an evil Candy Land before? Buckle up, buttercup. 

  • Dynamic, immersive soundtrack. You won't need to turn down the music on this game. Every level can be seen and heard...and sometimes even felt. 

  • Uncover hidden truths. You wake up to a silent house, with a crack running down the middle. Where oh where is Miss Agony and what the heck is going on around here? Learn the truth about your family. 

  • Nightmare mode. Push your skills to the limit in our elusive Nightmare mode. 

  • Adorable pets! Because we all need a buddy.

Help them reclaim what was lost. Explore weird worlds, choose your fate, and find your way back to where you belong.

store_data.about_the_game:
Coloniam - One World. Four Powers. Endless War.

Coloniam is a persistent real-time MMO grand strategy set on the actual map of Earth. While turn-based games pause and wait, Coloniam never sleeps. While you sleep — your enemy plans.

This is not a fresh launch. Coloniam has been running for over a decade as a browser MMO, and now arrives on Steam as a native desktop client.

Choose Your Power

Four real-world superpowers fight for dominance. Each has its own units, weapons, and strategic identity:

  • Russia — Industrial scale, ironclad strategy. Su-35 fighters, Kirov-class battleships, Yasen-class submarines, Kuznetsov carrier.

  • United States — Technological supremacy and naval power. F/A-18 Super Hornets, USS Iowa, USS Virginia subs, Gerald R. Ford carriers.

  • Europe — Diplomacy, finance, precision. Eurofighter Typhoon, HMS Dragon destroyers, HMS Astute submarines, Queen Elizabeth carrier.

  • Indo-China — Numbers, speed, industrial might. J-20 stealth fighters, Renhai cruisers, Type 093 submarines, Liaoning carrier.

Pick a side. Fight for it. Or betray it from within.

Real-World Map. Real-Time Stakes.

Coloniam plays out across the actual surface of Earth. Naval battles use accurate Web Mercator projection, wherever there is water on the planet, war can be fought there. Land armies march across continents in real time. Trade convoys cross oceans, factories run day and night, and battles rage 24/7. When you log off, your alliance defends the border. When you log back in, the world has moved.

What You Will Do

  • Build Your Empire — Found cities, raise walls, develop industry, become unstoppable.

  • Command Your Forces — Move armies across continents, lay siege to enemies, capture territory.

  • Naval Dominance — Direct aircraft carriers, submarines, cruisers, fighters, and bombers in real-time naval combat.

  • Master the Economy — Control trade routes, play the markets, dominate raw materials. Whoever rules the gold rules the war.

  • Diplomacy and Treason — Forge alliances, break treaties, run propaganda campaigns. Every move rewrites history.

  • Live in a Persistent World — Servers run 24/7. Your decisions have permanent consequences, even while you sleep.

Steam Native Client

  • Steam Cloud Sync — Settings travel between your PCs automatically.

  • Steam Overlay — Full integration. Shift+Tab works out of the box.

  • Optimized Performance — Less memory and CPU than a browser tab.

  • In-Game Politics — Vote for global leaders, run for office, shape alliance policy.

A Decade of History

Coloniam has run for over ten years. Alliances have risen and fallen. Betrayals are still talked about. Players who started in their teens now command empires built across years of patient play. This is not a game with an ending — this is a world that continues.

For New Commanders

  • Read the in-game tutorial — it covers everything from your first city to your first battle.

  • Join an alliance early — solo players rarely survive their first month.

  • Ask questions — the community is over a decade old and welcomes newcomers.

  • Take it slow. Coloniam rewards patience over panic.

Coloniam — Real world. Real war. One life. One power. Thousands of stories.

  • Command Your Forces — Move armies across continents, lay siege to enemies, capture territory.

  • Naval Dominance — Direct aircraft carriers, submarines, cruisers, fighters, and bombers in real-time naval combat.

  • Master the Economy — Control trade routes, play the markets, dominate raw materials. Whoever rules the gold rules the war.

  • Diplomacy and Treason — Forge alliances, break treaties, run propaganda campaigns. Every move rewrites history.

  • Live in a Persistent World — Servers run 24/7. Your decisions have permanent consequences, even while you sleep.

Steam Native Client

  • Steam Cloud Sync — Settings travel between your PCs automatically.

  • Steam Overlay — Full integration. Shift+Tab works out of the box.

  • Optimized Performance — Less memory and CPU than a browser tab.

  • In-Game Politics — Vote for global leaders, run for office, shape alliance policy.

A Decade of History

Coloniam has run for over ten years. Alliances have risen and fallen. Betrayals are still talked about. Players who started in their teens now command empires built across years of patient play. This is not a game with an ending — this is a world that continues.

For New Commanders

  • Read the in-game tutorial — it covers everything from your first city to your first battle.

  • Join an alliance early — solo players rarely survive their first month.

  • Ask questions — the community is over a decade old and welcomes newcomers.

  • Take it slow. Coloniam rewards patience over panic.

Coloniam — Real world. Real war. One life. One power. Thousands of stories.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Fog Below is an arcade dungeon-crawler using a minesweeper-inspired exploration mechanic. Tiles hide enemies,  spells, recipes, armor, weapons  and more . Click to reveal them — a flood-fill reveal cascades outward but stops once it is near an enemy. The dungeon uses a heat map to visually alert the player of enemies in close proximity: yellow glows when danger is close, orange glows when very close and finally red when an enemy is one tile away. The player can decide to continue revealing tiles and eventually engage the enemy or try to tactically avoid the enemy and continue to explore the dungeon before exiting the portal to the next level.
  
Every tile you reveal increases the Threat Meter. When it fills, an elite enemy spawns and you enter combat. You are given the opportunity, via a load out screen, to examine the enemies stats and resistances and load up on buffs and spells that can work in your favor, if you have them available. Once you have defeated 5 consecutive elite enemies a boss will spawn, defeat the boss and the Threat Meter resets and the cycle repeats but will become noticeably harder.

Arcade Combat

Your cursor is your melee attack. Enemy targets consist of Drifters that move across the arena. Pylons are stationary but need five hits before they detonate and damage the player. Hydras split on death and spawn 2 Drifters. Wraithlings will move towards your cursor and die on contact and damage the player. Phase targets fade in and out as they move across the arena. You can click to melee damage enemy targets or use up to four loaded spells for increased damage. Choosing the right spell can have a dramatic effect on the outcome, you can mix single target, damage over time, stuns, shields, self heals and area of effect spells to take advantage of enemy weakness or resistances.

Between fights: spend Skill Points on skill trees, 3 combat focused and 3 crafting focused, craft potions and food, enchant your gear, and recruit companions that provide buffs to your character. Each level offers a quest that rewards you with potions, upgrades, etc.

Revealing tiles can also trigger Fibonacci sequences, Prime clusters, Perfect Squares and more that can reward achievements and bonuses.

Features:

  • Minesweeper-inspired exploration with a dynamic heat-map proximity radar

  • Real-time arcade combat — melee cursor attack with an additional 4 spells available

  • Game loop — Defeat 5 elites, then the Main Boss, rinse and repeat as the difficulty increases

  • Three lives, you can earn extra lives from loot, pickups, etc. When all lives are lost the game ends

  • Full RPG layer: skill trees, alchemy, cooking, rune-weaving, enchanting, companions, quests, and bestiary

  • ASCII-style art

  • Steam leaderboards for depth, speed runs, and achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
Relax in Endless. Master Strategist and Two-Body if You Can.

Endless Snake starts with the snake you already know: eat apples, grow longer, and do not crash into yourself. Endless lets you keep it calm, settle into the rhythm, and play a clean one-handed run.

But if you think you have snake figured out, the harder modes are waiting.

In Strategist, you plan your route before you move. A good plan feels brilliant. A greedy plan can trap you before the snake even starts. It turns snake into a tactical puzzle where every committed turn matters.

In Two-Body, you control two snakes at once. One board, two bodies, one rising multiplier, and twice as many ways to ruin a perfect run. It is still snake, but now your focus has to survive on both sides of the board.

Pick Your Kind of Pressure

  • Endless is the chill mode. No strict timer, no build pressure - just you, the board, and one more apple.

  • Classic keeps the rules clean for pure high-score runs.

  • Strategist turns routing into planning, timing, and commitment.

  • Two-Body challenges your coordination by making you manage two snakes at the same time.

  • Journey Roguelite adds upgrades, boss fights, build choices, and long-term progression.

  • Challenges bring sharper goals through Time Attack, Daily, Weekly, Pure Score, and Boss Rush.

Score With Skill

Apples are more than points. Chain them for combo multipliers, cut close to danger for risk rewards, and use 15 apple types like magnet, slow, ghost, mystery, bombs, shrink effects, and score bursts to change how a run plays.

A casual run can stay smooth and simple. A serious run becomes a test of timing, routing, planning, and nerve.

Runs That Keep Changing

Journey Roguelite lets your snake grow in more ways than length. Pick upgrades, build around what you find, and adapt when a boss breaks your usual route.

The stricter modes are there when you want to prove something. Pure Score removes upgrades. Time Attack gives you 60 seconds. Daily and Weekly runs put everyone on the same seed. Boss Rush skips the warm-up and goes straight to the fights.

There are 10 bosses, unlockable skins and themes, replays, leaderboards, and 100 achievements, from easy first steps to goals that ask for real mastery.

One Hand. One More Run.

Steer with arrow keys or D-pad. Boost with one button.

Relax in Endless. Master Strategist. Survive Two-Body. Then try one more run.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Setup

The farm's been in your family for generations, and lately you've let it run itself. The bank has noticed. They want this place by week's end — unless you can start pulling your weight, one egg at a time.

The Loop

Chickens lay eggs across a pulsing green field. Your click-circle sweeps over them on a timer; whatever it touches goes in the basket. Each day is only about twenty seconds long, and at the end of every one, you head to the nest tree to spend your haul on upgrades that make tomorrow's run faster, longer, and richer.

Features

  • Four egg tiers - white, green, blue, and golden, each worth 10× the one below. The golden ones are the prize.

  • A sprawling skill tree with dozens of unlocks: longer days, bigger collect circles, faster cursors, more chickens, faster lays, hatch chances, crit lays, and more.

  • A prestige tree that resets the run for permanent perks: colored chicken breeds (each laying a rarer egg), the post-day plinko bonus, twin sine-wave trampolines, the Grand Egg Exchange, and more.

  • End-of-day plinko - every egg you collected drops through a Galton field of pegs and bouncy trampolines for a multiplier payout. Bigger hauls, bigger paydays, occasionally chaotic results.

  • Random events - egg meteors crater across the field with a pile of eggs, chests pop open the moment your collector touches them, coop beacons double lay rates inside their radius.

  • Helpful foxes - once unlocked, they roam the field auto-collecting whatever your cursor missed.

  • Exchange - bulk-convert hoarded lower-tier eggs into rarer ones (or vice-versa) at a 10-to-1 rate, with one-click "Convert All" buttons for when the stockpiles get out of hand.

  • A real ending - light up every node in both trees, then *Buy The Farm* to settle the debt for good. The bank goes home empty-handed.

The Pitch

You'll start with one chicken, twenty seconds on the clock, and a single goal: don't let the bank win. By the time you're done, you'll have flocks of golden-laying purple hens, foxes covering your blind spots, plinko machines turning every basket into a payday, and an exchange counter swapping commons for treasures. Whether you save the farm in an afternoon or a long week of optimization is between you and the chickens.

store_data.about_the_game:
WHERE the F$CK is my BITCOIN ⁉️ is a casual simulation about digging through endless piles of trash in search of something valuable. What starts as a simple way to make quick cash turns into a strangely satisfying grind, where every item you find can be either useless junk or something truly valuable. Collect trash by hand, fill your bags, and sell whatever you can to keep going.

As you earn money, you’ll be able to improve your efficiency, unlock new trash piles, and grow your small operation into something bigger. The loop is simple but hard to put down: dig, sort, sell, upgrade — and repeat. With each run, you become faster, more efficient, and a little closer to finding what you’re really looking for… even if you’re not sure it’s still there.

It’s not just about money — it’s about the chase, the curiosity, and the feeling that the next pile might finally pay off.

Features:

🗑️ Addictive collect → sort → sell gameplay loop
💰 Valuable items hidden among piles of junk
⚡ Upgrades that improve speed, energy, and efficiency
🏗️ Unlockable trash piles with increasing rewards
🔁 Satisfying progression that keeps you coming back for “one more run”

store_data.about_the_game:
Silent Shark is a tactical and realism-focused WWII submarine simulator built around plotting, estimation, and submarine command, set in the Pacific Theater.

Track contacts by hydrophone, work out their course and speed, identify ships through the periscope, estimate range with a stadimeter, and build your firing solution from imperfect information. The game is played on a tactical chart with period-inspired instruments and deliberate controls.

A good attack takes preparation. You need to approach from the right angle, manage depth and speed, account for visibility and sea state, set up the torpedoes, and leave yourself a way out before escorts respond.

If destroyers do locate you, be prepared for evasive maneuvers and paying attention when to go hard and fast, or slow and silent.

Core Features

  • Map tools like compass, ruler, timestamped points, and angles help you to hunt for the perfect course to intercept.

Silent Shark was created with lots of love by John Goering - indie developer from Berlin. John is the creator of the head tracking app SmoothTrack and the thought organizing app Mindscope. He grew up playing the sub sim Silent Service II on Atari, then later discovered Silent Hunter IV, and more recently, UBoat - he then decided to take the parts he loved most about these games - the map mode - and double down on that and turn it into the sub sim of his own dreams.

store_data.about_the_game:
Thrown into an arena with a fierce opponent, you must command your units in order to come out alive.

Key Features

  • Strategic gameplay with depth

  • A three phase draft with a roster of 12 unique units

  • An ELO ranking system

  • Multiple game modes for blitz, rapid or classical length matches

Each of your units has a special ability with unique rules. You must think carefully, devise a plan, an overcome your opponent's strategy.

The Draft

The game does not begin with your pieces in predetermined positions. Instead, you take turns with your opponent, drafting each unit and placing them in three phases.

Some units may be placed multiple times while others only once.

The white pieces begin with an advantage, they move first once the match has started. As a result, the black pieces must take on a more responsive role. By picking last in the draft, they can position themselves to best counter white's tempo advantage.

Units

Each of your units has a single unique ability.

Fighter

The Fighter is a simple yet formidable unit, almost always chosen by players. Fighter have high health with the highest physical resistance and block chance in the game, though they are weak to magical damage. Fighters are your front line tanks.

Pyromancer

Wizards of all kinds have poor physical resistance, though they typically have moderate magical resistances. The Pyromancer's Fireball deals moderate magical damage to all units in an area.

Warlock

The Warlock's Void Lance is one of the highest damage dealing spells in the game. The Warlock has very few hit points and poor mobility, making them extremely vulnerable to counter attacks.

Cleric

Our only healer. Mass Heal comes with a very large recovery time. The Cleric has very low health, and is best kept far from combat.

Magus

Although the Magus comes lightly armored and with a poor chance to block, he has a short recovery time and large move distance. The Magus' is able to quickly navigate the board, finding the best places to strike. The Magus' Sunburst deals moderate magic damage to all nearby units.

When reduced to low health, the Magus may become Consumed by Fire.

Shaman

The Shaman enters a state of deep focus after casting her spell. For as long as the Shaman remains focused, affected units have Magic Armor, gaining an additional 20% resistance to physical and magical damage.

Living Fire

Living Fire is immobile, meant to ward off an area from your opponent. The Living Fire will Scorch nearby enemies, dealing a tremendous amount of magical damage. Living Fire is immune to physical damage.

And more!

There are currently 12 unique units, with more planned.

store_data.about_the_game:
It started with a meme.

A harmless image mocking a powerful dictator from across the border. Days later, its creator vanished.

Your agency was hired to bring him back.

What should have been a straightforward extraction turns into something far more dangerous. The deeper you push into hostile territory, the clearer it becomes, this isn’t about one man. It’s about control.

The regime isn’t just silencing critics. It’s rewriting what people are allowed to see, say, and even find funny.

And now you’re in the middle of it.

Infiltrate heavily guarded facilities, gather intel, and adapt as your mission keeps expanding beyond its original scope. What begins as a rescue becomes a fight to dismantle the system and confront the man behind it.

Key Features

  • Stealth-First Gameplay

     Stealth is a great first option. But sometimes......

  • Adaptive Loadouts
    What starts as a simple rescue evolves into a multi-layered operation with higher stakes at every step. So make sure you have the right weapon for the job.

  • Satirical Edge
    A story where something as small as a meme becomes the spark for something much bigger.

store_data.about_the_game:
JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery where you play a contractor (the "CONTRACTOR") who signs away three years of their life (the "TERM") in the hopes of clawing their way out of poverty. Your employer (the "COMPANY") agrees that any remaining balance of 'e' (the "CURRENCY") is yours to keep at the end of your TERM.

---

THE CONTRACTOR. You. Yes, you. All you need to do in order to work for the COMPANY is to purchase this game and sign the introductory contract.

THE TERM. 3 years, exactly 1095 days. 

THE COMPANY. Your beneficent employer, generously allowing you to enrich yourself.

THE CURRENCY. Also known as 'e'. The world runs on 'e'.

In JOB you will interact with a variety of evolving applications ("SPECIAL LABORS") that incorporate and subvert incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and escape-room style puzzles. As you labor, you will also learn about your strange employer (the "COMPANY") and the truth and nature of your work. 

---

"SPECIAL LABORS" include...

  • FLOW. An idle, flowchart resource manager.

  • LOG. A memory-testing typing rogue-like.

  • PET. A cute companion who will perish if neglected.

  • and many more...

In JOB you will...

  • Perform odd, cruel, and addictive digital labors

  • Learn the truth of your employer, the Company

  • Unravel the bindings of capitalism

store_data.about_the_game:
Single Note is an atmospheric first-person adventure set in an alternative retro world where music has become a source of energy.

Everyone dreams of a better future — and our main character is no exception. One day, he finally finds the courage to leave the nest where he has lived alone for so long and sets off toward the flying city — a place that promises a beautiful tomorrow.

You may wonder: how can a city fly? In an ordinary world, it cannot. But the world of this story is a special case.

In this world, music has been turned into energy. Thanks to it, people created incredible inventions that spark the imagination. But on the road to the city, it becomes clear that many of these wonders now stand empty. Not everyone can endure the endless music of their engines.

Travel through a beautiful retro world, overcome obstacles and harsh weather — and reach the flying city in your own musical vehicle.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Hearts at Sea” is a single-player, story-driven action game, supported by management and puzzle mechanics. Play as Julian, a tavern keeper turned sea captain, and sail through an abandoned archipelago, building a ragtag group of heroes to fight terrible sea monsters. Manage their needs and desires, and turn them into a force to be reckoned with!

The Sea of Serpents, once a beautiful and prosperous region, has fallen in disrepair. Ravaged by a cataclysm 17 years ago, it has since been ruled by a faction of mysterious sea monsters, set on outright devouring every single sailor that dares brave it’s waters.

Until now, that is. Lately, a strange group led by a former tavern-keeper and a witch have entered the fray. Recruit heroes, manage their needs and defeat the monsters, to liberate the Sea of Serpents once and for all!

Take 4 different characters into battle, each with their own set of abilities, fighting styles, and fantastical relics. Help them challenge 4 towering bosses, in over 10 hardcore combat encounters.

“Hearts of Sea” brings a diverse cast of characters, including (but not limited to) a frustrated tomb explorer, an unwilling privateer and a regretful religious fanatic. Discover their deepest secrets and find out what they like and don’t like, so you can properly fulfil their needs and get them ready for battle.

Each of the heroes has a different set of preferences, and you better balance their needs by decorating their bedrooms accordingly. Be warned, though: if someone’s left unhappy, the rest of the group may suffer in battle!

store_data.about_the_game:
A storm that should have killed them. A continent that doesn't appear on any map. Three outcasts who don't remember reaching shore.

Livia: a sanatorium nurse who survived a plague that killed every patient, every friend, every neighbor she had.

Miranda: a tavern girl who killed a nobleman's son with a broken bottle in self defense, and would do it again.

Sten: a river boat captain who lost his ship, his crew, and his name to a piracy charge he wouldn't answer.

Three strangers boarded the same ship for the same reason: nothing left for them in the old world.

The storm came too fast and the lightning was the wrong color.

They wake on a beach in a world the maps don't know, with strangers in their heads who call themselves spirits, and powers in their hands they have no idea how to use.

Driftbane: The Long Awaited is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited allies, and a corruption killing two worlds at once. Strategic battles on an isometric field where the fastest fighters strike first. Terrain shapes every engagement. A flank lands harder. A counter only triggers from the front, and only for allies who've earned the skill. No permadeath. Risks stay risky instead of save-scummed.

Stone, Water, Fire - and the Reasons They Chose You. Each party member carries a virtue tempered by their worst experience. Spirits recognize that virtue and grant power that matches it: stone that won't yield, water that won't stop, fire that cauterizes.

Powers grow as the bonds deepen. Units grow in strength with levels, equipment and class promotion paths. The why of any of it is the story you're playing for.

Every Ally Earned.

The spirit-realm is home to fantastical beast-folk like Vulpari fox-folk in the meadows, Ulfar monks in the frozen north, and others further inland. Each has a culture and a corruption they face. If you can help them overcome it, you will gain allies in your fight to seal the drift. You earn their loyalty through story and exploration.

A World Sick With Things It Has No Word For.

The rain is wrong. The crops are dying. The native races have no defense against vices they have no word for. Behind it all stand the Four Horsemen. Villains or perhaps just consequences gathering weight. Discover the secrets of the Drift.

store_data.detailed_description:
A storm that should have killed them. A continent that doesn't appear on any map. Three outcasts who don't remember reaching shore.

Livia: a sanatorium nurse who survived a plague that killed every patient, every friend, every neighbor she had.

Miranda: a tavern girl who killed a nobleman's son with a broken bottle in self defense, and would do it again.

Sten: a river boat captain who lost his ship, his crew, and his name to a piracy charge he wouldn't answer.

Three strangers boarded the same ship for the same reason: nothing left for them in the old world.

The storm came too fast and the lightning was the wrong color.

They wake on a beach in a world the maps don't know, with strangers in their heads who call themselves spirits, and powers in their hands they have no idea how to use.

Driftbane: The Long Awaited is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited allies, and a corruption killing two worlds at once. Strategic battles on an isometric field where the fastest fighters strike first. Terrain shapes every engagement. A flank lands harder. A counter only triggers from the front, and only for allies who've earned the skill. No permadeath. Risks stay risky instead of save-scummed.

Stone, Water, Fire - and the Reasons They Chose You. Each party member carries a virtue tempered by their worst experience. Spirits recognize that virtue and grant power that matches it: stone that won't yield, water that won't stop, fire that cauterizes.

Powers grow as the bonds deepen. Units grow in strength with levels, equipment and class promotion paths. The why of any of it is the story you're playing for.

Every Ally Earned.

The spirit-realm is home to fantastical beast-folk like Vulpari fox-folk in the meadows, Ulfar monks in the frozen north, and others further inland. Each has a culture and a corruption they face. If you can help them overcome it, you will gain allies in your fight to seal the drift. You earn their loyalty through story and exploration.

store_data.about_the_game:
PRO: Push React Outgun is a tactical multiplayer FPS designed to push the boundaries of combat and drop players directly into the heart of modern battlefields...

The Story

Following a nuclear catastrophe, all water sources have been contaminated and energy reserves rendered useless. Currently, drinkable water is only obtained by desalinating seawater, a process that requires a nuclear element known as "nit." Those in power employ mercenaries known as Enforcers to secure this resource, while the common people, known as Raiders, attempt to seize it through strategic raids.

Redefining Combat

The moment you step onto the battlefield, you will be immersed in chaos and realism. Close-quarters combat is about more than just rapid firing; you must hold the right angles, coordinate with teammates, and maintain strict trigger discipline. A single mistake can decide the entire round. PRO forces you to slow down, think, and execute your moves like a professional.

Key Features

  • Next-Gen UE5 Visuals: Environment design equipped with advanced lighting, Nanite technology, and realistic materials to maximize your situational awareness.

  • Heavy and Realistic Weapon Mechanics: Grounded gameplay where recoil, timing, and discipline define the thin line between survival and death.

  • Environmental Audio Experience: Track your enemies' every footstep through acoustic resonance and audio occlusion systems. He who listens, wins.

  • Tactics First, Reflexes Second: Win rounds through coordination or snatch victory from impossible moments with razor-sharp reflexes.

  • Map Design: Layered and detailed maps that punish careless movement and reward precise advancement.

Early Access Roadmap

We are growing alongside our community. Planned improvements include performance optimization, network stability, automated matchmaking, and balance updates.

  • Rank System: Determine your global standing through a ranking system and international statistics.

  • Matchmaking: Encounter players of your own skill level with automated matchmaking.

  • Expanded Content: New game modes and diverse maps will be added to differentiate your combat experience.

  • The Nit Economy: After every battle, the winning team will be rewarded with "nit."

  • Weapon Customization: Use "nit" to equip your weapons with scopes, red dots, suppressors, flash hiders, and more.

  • Character Customization: Customize your character with new outfits, camouflage, tactical vests, and various cosmetic upgrades using your earned "nit."

  • Localization: Support for 15+ subtitles and languages will be added.

  • Arsenal Expansion: We plan to introduce more weapon options and a deeper realism experience.

Early Access Note

PRO: Push React Outgun is currently under active development. At this stage, only the Casual mode is available. The version you play today is a strong foundation that will continuously evolve. Your feedback helps us determine our priorities and perfect the feel of the game. Tell us what works, what needs improvement, and what you want to see next.

Please keep in mind that this game is being developed by a single individual, and the development process reflects this. We would like to thank our entire community for standing by us in this passionate independent development journey and for believing in our project.

store_data.about_the_game:
A strategy/4X game where you take over space, made by hotshot game developer Gideon Kennedy of Gerrymap fame.

Spaceman's Luck is like lightning crystallized into a video game. Designed to be fast and easy to play, it shuns classic principles of the genre (being boring and sucking) and embraces 4V: Vitality, Vigor, Virtue, and Virility.

You colonize space, while trying to expand in the most Advantageous way. You go from star to star, and each one has planets. Some planets are Really Good, others Aren't. Some stars are Far, and others Close. Do I need to say more...?

This is where the patented Luck mechanic comes in. A good Spaceman's Luck will allow you to win somewhat easily, and a bad Spaceman's Luck will kill you in real life.

There are four default races representing the Tremendous Diversity of this wonderful Galaxy (and the 4 V's): the Humans, Space Elves, Space Orcs, and Space Ants. Each has their own Strengths and Weaknesses. You can make your own race, also.

Do you have a Spaceman's Luck?
