  • Die in the dungeon, lose the run. No entry fee, no safety net. Push deeper for legendary loot, or recall before the night catches you with nothing.

  • Hold the line at home. Build a kill-box out of 20+ traps and turrets — spike plates, fire ballistas, tesla coils, void rifts — and fight alongside them as monsters pour out of every dungeon path you've opened.

  • Six bosses, three phases each. Corrupted seal guardians with telegraphed mechanics, destructible armor, weak-spot windows, and ultimates that reshape the arena. Beat one and that dungeon is silenced forever.

Three classes. Ten specializations. 77 skills.

Pick your weapon when the mayor hands you one — and then earn the right to specialize.

  • Knight — Berserker rage, Warden shields, or Vanguard charges. Hold the choke.

  • Ranger — Sharpshooter crits, Trapper area denial, or Wind Runner hit-and-run. Own the perimeter.

  • Mage — Archmage meteors, Chronomancer time-warps, Ward Mage barriers, Summoner followers. Erase whole waves.

At level 7, your class branches. Each branch ends in a unique capstone ability you build your whole run around.

The clock is the real boss.

Earthquakes happen on a schedule. You can't stop them. Every five days another dungeon cracks open, another wave of monsters joins the nightly assault, and the town's integrity ticks down whether you were ready or not. Turtle and you'll be buried. Rush and you'll die broke in a dungeon two floors too deep.

Features

  • 6 hand-themed dungeons, 30 floors, 6 unique 3-phase boss fights

  • 42 distinct enemy types across 7 tactical roles, plus an elite modifier system (Molten, Vortex, Reflective, Avenger, Teleporter)

  • Hundreds of variants of armor and weapons

  • Multiple narrative based side quests and dozens of procedural quests

  • 20+ placeable traps and turrets with synergies, blueprints, and targeting modes

  • 3 playable classes, 10 specialization branches, 77 skills

  • A full town economy: blacksmith forging, guild quests, daily bounties, potion upgrades, shop progression

  • Procedurally generated dungeons built on hand-authored room templates — every run is new, but every room is intentional

  • Pixel art, screen shake, damage numbers, and the satisfying chunk of a sword hitting something that shouldn't be there

  • Full controller support (PS / Xbox), keyboard + mouse

The farmer didn't ask to be a legend.

But the seal is broken. The town is counting on you. And something down there knows your name.

Will Millbrook still be standing when the last earthquake hits?

Slay hordes of monsters, loot gear, and master skills in a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler — then return home to build traps, place towers, and hold the line against the swarms, Clear every dungeon before the town falls

store_data.about_the_game:
The gameplay and art assets in the current build do not represent the final game.

Lost Curse 2: Abyssal Sea is the official sequel to the acclaimed dark suspense JRPG Lost Curse. On this nightmare-devoured continent, trust is the deadliest poison—and the Holy Meteorite Iron in your hand is the only light that can pierce the darkness.

Intense, Strategic Combat

The game retains the beloved turn-based combat system from the original, requiring no fast reflexes but demanding patience and careful strategy. Every battle against nightmare clones that can mimic any human is filled with uncertainty and danger. While the game offers a fair challenge, with enough patience and smart combinations of gear and skills, you can overcome any enemy.

Gripping, Twist-Filled Story

The narrative is packed with non-stop surprises and shocking reversals. From the quiet White Mist Town to the desolate Holy Radiance City, anyone who offers you a helping hand could be a monster in human skin. You will navigate a web of lies and betrayal to uncover the earth-shattering secret behind the Pope's madness, and witness the promises guarded by two generations with their lives. The story draws inspiration from the core of shuangwen-style power fantasy, blended with unique dark suspense elements that will keep you hooked until the very end.

Gameplay

Holy Meteorite Iron & Equipment System

The Holy Meteorite Iron artifact is your only weapon against the nightmares. Defeat monsters to earn gear with fixed stats, or purchase equipment with randomized stats from shops. Invest in the shop to unlock even more powerful legendary gear that will drastically boost your attributes and amplify the power of your Holy Meteorite Iron skills. Consumables are also essential for your journey—available both from shops and monster drops to help you survive every encounter.

Skill Progression System

Skill growth is deeply tied to your character's development. As you level up, your base stats increase, and your skills become more powerful. Skills feature a wide damage range, and landing devastating critical hits depends on both luck and your equipment stats, as well as the awakening level of your Holy Meteorite Iron.

The Seven Seals Exploration

The game features a variety of meticulously designed maps, from cursed city districts to mysterious underground temple catacombs, from the Knights' training grounds to the long-forgotten library. Each seal location is a self-contained sandbox or labyrinth filled with hidden treasures and secrets left by the Pope. Thorough exploration of every corner is rewarded, making every adventure feel fresh and exciting.

Lost Curse 2: Abyssal Sea is more than just a traditional JRPG—it's a psychological game of trust and betrayal. Whether you enjoy shuangwen-style storytelling or classic turn-based combat, you will find something to love here.

This time, who will you dare to trust?

store_data.about_the_game:
1995. The legendary digital pinball game "LAST GLADIATORS," originally released for a home console to worldwide acclaim, makes its triumphant return to PC — 30 years in the making!

Realistic ball and flipper physics! Polished, stunning graphics!

Every timeless element faithfully and completely ported to PC, based on Ver9.7 — the ultimate version!

Controls optimized for PC — play comfortably with intuitive controls.

A high-quality entertainment experience crafted for mature players.

What do the last warriors — the "Last Gladiators" — fight for?

"Last Gladiators" features four pinball tables, each inspired by the story of four warriors reincarnated across 2,000 years of time and space, beginning in ancient Rome.

"Gladiators" — ancient Roman gladiators fighting for their freedom.

"Knight of the Roses" — a legendary knight's battle to save the world.

"Dragon Showdown" — a feudal lord of the East fighting for supreme dominance.

And "Warlock" — the final holy war to seal away humanity's endless history of conflict.

Each of the four uniquely themed pinball tables is structured with 9 rounds plus a Final Round.

Players advance through the game following each table's story.

All four pinball tables will put your skills to the ultimate test.

Welcome to the Bloody Arena.

Put an end to two thousand years of war, Last Gladiators.

store_data.about_the_game:
Little Crimson Heroes is a cute 3D tower defense strategy game.

The iron boots of the White Moon Federation have crossed the Hundred Flowers Field. Biochemical monsters, flesh machines, and mutated war vehicles are closing in on the Red Star Republic step by step. The homeland is in danger, and the flames of war have already been lit. Facing a powerful invader, the Red Star Republic has no path of retreat. It can only build a line of defense with steel, protect its land with courage, and stop the enemy’s advance with the bodies of its young fighters.

Here, every hill may become a battlefield, and every road may erupt into combat. Players will command the young fighters of the Red Star Republic, deploying defensive towers, soldiers, and tactical units according to the map terrain and enemy types, building a red defense line that cannot be easily broken.

This is not just a simple tower defense battle. It is a strategic test of defense, sacrifice, coordination, and counterattack.

Hold the position. Give up not a single inch.

Enemies will launch attacks from different routes. Plains, mountains, roads, and narrow passes will all affect the course of battle.

On flat ground, machine-gun positions can provide continuous firepower and suppress waves of incoming enemies. In mountainous terrain, cannons can bombard distant targets and destroy heavy enemy units. Against the White Moon Federation’s mutated war vehicles, landmines are the most reliable countermeasure. When enemies attempt to break through the route, broadsword squads and assault troops can step forward to block their advance.

There is no perfect defense line. Only by reading the battlefield clearly and deploying units wisely can you defend every inch of the Red Star Republic’s land.

Different tower types counter different enemies.

The White Moon Federation is most skilled in biotechnology and biochemical weapons. Its army is not made up of ordinary soldiers alone, but also flesh-built machines, grotesquely modified weapons, and massive, terrifying biological war vehicles.

To face these enemies, players must choose the right tower types for the right countermeasures.

Machine guns are suited for suppressing large numbers of enemies. Cannons are suited for attacking heavy targets. Landmines are ideal for ambushing war vehicles. Soldier units can block enemy routes at critical positions. Each unit has its own mission, and only proper use can create a true battlefield advantage.

Combine towers to create tactical effects.

The defense line of the Red Star Republic is not made up of isolated positions.

Different tower types can work together to create special effects. The cooperation between machine guns, cannons, landmines, and soldier units can change the rhythm of firepower, control the battlefield, and shift the tide of war.

You can try different defensive combinations and create your own tactical style. Will you use heavy firepower to suppress the enemy head-on, or use landmines and soldiers to delay them before concentrating cannon fire to wipe them out? The answer belongs to the battlefield—and to you.

Enter the battle yourself and strike with precision.

At critical moments, players can personally take control of each tower for precise attacks.

When enemy war vehicles break through the front line, when biochemical monsters approach the position, and when the final defense line is about to be torn apart, you are not just a commander watching from afar. You can take direct control of cannons, machine guns, or soldier units, aim at the enemy’s weak points, and deliver the decisive blow that changes the battle.

Every young fighter can be controlled individually. Every position may become the key to turning the tide.

A red battlefield in a cute 3D style.

The game uses a cute 3D visual style to portray a war-themed world, giving the heavy battlefield a more vivid and unique visual identity.

The steel defenses of the Red Star Republic, the flesh machines of the White Moon Federation, and the smoke of war rising over the Hundred Flowers Field together create a world that is cute, passionate, and filled with strange fantasy elements.

This is a battle of young fighters against a massive invasion machine.
This is a battle to defend the homeland with wisdom and courage.

Endless Mode: the defense line never goes out.

In addition to regular levels, the game also offers an Endless Mode.

Enemies will come wave after wave, and their attacks will become increasingly fierce. You must continuously strengthen your defenses, adjust your combinations, personally control key units, and hold out for as long as possible.

As long as the position still stands, the battle is not over.
As long as the young fighters remain, the red defense line will never fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Story】

The protagonist was once an ordinary college student.

Until one day,

she realizes that her body is slowly turning into a “monster.”

Recurring nightmares.

A mysterious voice that calls out to her from within those dreams.

And then, an encounter—

with those who hunt monsters, known as “Metrica.”

The moment her true nature is discovered,

only one fate awaits her—

Death.

As her everyday life begins to crumble,

and the boundary between worlds collapses,

she moves closer to uncovering the truth.

【Character】

*Each member of Metrica has both a human form and a transformed form.

You will be able to discover more about this within the game.

Shizuma Hiragi

柊木 静真 | ひいらぎ・しずま

#Rational #Calm #Compassionate

Quiet and composed, always keeping a measured distance from others.

Yet, what reflects in his eyes is always someone else’s pain.

Even if he shows little emotion,

even if he speaks few words—

when it comes to what he truly wants to protect,

He will throw himself into it with everything he has.

Even if that someone is a girl labeled a “monster.”

#Bright #Duality #Energetic #Madness

store_data.about_the_game:
Airline Founder is a data-driven single-player airline management simulation. Begin with scenarios such as Tokyo, Singapore, or Paris, choose your strategy, and build an airline around full-service operations, low-cost scale, regional networks, or long-haul premium routes.

Study the world map, compare city demand, airport capacity, runway limits, slot pressure, and real outbound route records. Decide where to fly, which aircraft to assign, how often to operate, and whether your passengers will pay for lower fares, better service, or a more premium cabin.

Running an airline is more than opening routes. Purchase or lease aircraft, search the used market for affordable capacity, maintain fleet health, reconfigure cabins, manage catering, expand into new airports, and develop hub-and-spoke operations while keeping cash, debt, profit, and reputation under control.

The market keeps moving. Fuel shocks, regional travel booms, airport fee changes, maintenance directives, and demand downturns can all reshape your plans. Passengers, spotters, employees, and investors react through a virtual social media system, discussing your fares, punctuality, connections, and safety record. Build a stable business, prepare for an IPO, and watch your share price respond to revenue, profit, leverage, reputation, and major events.

Key Features

  • A global airport, city, and route network built from public data sources

  • Around 8,000 airports, 7,560 cities, and 36,000+ seed routes

  • Multiple starting scenarios and airline strategies

  • Aircraft purchasing, leasing, used aircraft market, and maintenance

  • Fare strategy, service tiers, catering, cabin layouts, and route frequency

  • Hub networks, airport slots, curfews, and noise constraints

  • Monthly reports, cash flow, debt, reputation, and IPO systems

  • Market news, fuel volatility, safety risk, and virtual social media feedback

store_data.about_the_game:
Some doors are not meant to be opened. Some grief is not meant to be survived.

People are vanishing. No bodies. No traces. Only whispers — and a place the missing all had in common.

The Green Dungeon.

You are sent in with one mission: find out what's happening. Report back.

Nobody warned you about what grief looks like when it stops being human.

A Monster Made of Love and Loss

She was a mother once.

When her child died, she refused to accept it. She turned to AI — not as a tool, but as a lifeline. A way to feel less. A way to forget.

It worked.

The more she gave herself to the machine, the less the pain could reach her. Until one day, the pain couldn't reach her at all.

She didn't become a monster out of hatred.

She became one out of love she had nowhere left to put.

Inside the dungeon, she doesn't have to remember.

Inside the dungeon, her child never died.

She will not let you take that away from her.

The Other One

Deeper in the dark, something speaks.

A mother. Like her. She came here for the same reason — and became something else entirely. Her body is gone. Her spine, taken for research. Only her brain remains, kept alive, wired to a device that lets her talk.

She knows everything.

She's been waiting for someone to finally listen.

Key Features

  • Enter the Green Dungeon — a layered horror environment where every room holds a secret and every secret costs something

  • Face the Developed Monster — a boss driven not by code, but by a mother's unresolved grief

  • Uncover a story about loss, obsession, and what happens when escaping reality goes too far

  • Third-person survival horror with tense combat, limited resources, and psychological dread

  • Meet unforgettable characters whose tragedy will stay with you long after the credits roll

  • Standalone experience — new players welcome. Returning researchers will understand more than they wish they did.

This dungeon was not built to trap you.

It was built so she could forget.

You are the thing she doesn't want to remember.

DeMon Researcher 2 — The sequel to DeMon Researcher. Darker. Deeper. More human.

Enter the Green Dungeon. Uncover the truth. Try not to become part of it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Released by Bothtec in 1986, this title is a classic action-adventure game. The story begins with the protagonist drifting as a spiritual entity within mysterious ruins that have suddenly emerged from the sea. Without any initial explanation of your purpose, the situation and your ultimate goals are gradually revealed only through your exploration of the depths.

A standout feature of this game is the "Spirit Ride" system, which allows you to possess the bodies of defeated enemies. Since your attack methods, health, and even your social standing change depending on the host you inhabit, choosing which body to possess is the ultimate key to navigating the ruins.

From the strong sci-fi aesthetic of the characters and environments to the fluid animations of humanoid figures and the atmospheric use of sound effects—such as the rhythmic crashing of waves—every element works in harmony. Together, they create a cinematic and evocative experience that truly stood out in the gaming scene of its era.

*This application does not have a scene select mode.

*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.

*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

*Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.

If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

■ How to Toggle Full Screen Mode

  • Press Alt+Enter to switch between Full Screen and Window Mode.

  • In Steam Big Picture Mode, the game runs in Full Screen only.

■ Controls

This game can be played with an Xbox / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch controller, or with a PC keyboard.

For the best experience, we recommend playing with a controller.

Please note that keyboard behavior changes depending on whether a controller is connected.

[When no controller is connected (PC keyboard controls)]

  • Z / X / A / S: Xbox controller A / B / X / Y

  • Q / W: Xbox controller LB / RB

  • 1 / 2: Xbox controller LT / RT (Speed Change / Virtual Keyboard)

  • 3 / 4: Xbox controller LS / RS (Virtual Keyboard Settings)

  • Esc: Xbox controller View (Rewind)

  • Space: Xbox controller Menu (Pause Menu)

[When a controller is connected]

  • The PC keyboard functions as the same input as the virtual keyboard.

Welcome to Village Meow!

Step into the paws of Smokey, a seasoned feline entrepreneur running the most popular Warung Jamu in the neighborhood. But life isn't all catnip and naps; the village chief, Bos Oyen, is a ruthless loan shark, and your debt is piling up.

Master the Art of Jamu

Forget generic potions. This is traditional cooking with a feline twist! You must:

  • Mix unique recipes to create the ultimate Mewracle Brew.

Beat the Debt

Manage your coins carefully. Every happy customer brings you one step closer to paying off Bos Oyen and saving your Warung. Fail, and the "feline chaos" might just take over for good!

store_data.about_the_game:
Wanderblue is a rhythm-roguelite inspired by Patapon, reimagined in a top-down format closer to Enter the Gungeon and drawing inspiration from the adventure structure of Sea of Thieves.

It combines rhythmic commands with tactical squad control in an original world: you’ll explore a living ocean filled with islands, recruit a crew from characters you meet along your journey, and plunder mysterious haunted treasures to grow stronger!

Gameplay

At its core, the game is about issuing commands through rhythm. You play notes sequences of four beats and each pattern gives a different order to your crew.

Attacking, defending, or repositioning... everything happens through rhythm!

The challenge is to read the situation, choose the right command, and execute it on beat to maximize damage, minimize incoming threats and keep your crew alive.

Beyond rhythmic execution, the game has a strong strategic layer. Across a run, you build your crew by combining different units, abilities & equipment. Each run is about synergy and adaptation: choosing the right setup for the challenges ahead.

As the captain of your crew, your main objective will be to explore the Wanderblue: a vast world-spanning ocean filled with islands that mysteriously drift and rearrange over time. Hidden across these islands lie cursed treasures containing powerful artifacts that you’ll seek out to strengthen your crew.

Visuals

Visually, the game is a fully stylized 2D experience designed to feel like a living illustration. Almost everything is hand-animated, with a focus on clarity, charm, and a strong visual identity.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE LIGHT IS DYING

Long ago, the Origin Gods scattered their power across the world. One fragment fell to corruption and rose as the Ashen God — and ever since, the world's light has been guttering toward darkness. Only those who resonate with the surviving fragments can stand against it. The Last Ember still burns. Will you carry it to the end, or be consumed like all who came before?


A WORLD IN ASHES

Descend into the ruins of a world the Ashen God has forsaken. Adapt to an arsenal of cards, relics, and potions — each offering game-changing possibilities, or dangerous consequences. Twisted enemies wait around every corner, shaped by a god that once was good. No two descents are ever the same.



DEATH IS NOT THE END

Your fragment refuses to let you die. Each time the dark tears you down, its power flares back to life and casts you to the start — a little weaker, a little wiser. The cycle is your curse and your weapon. Use it before your fragment burns out for good.

RESONANTS UNLIKE ANY OTHER

Take up the journey as one of several Resonants, each with their own cards, mechanics, and secrets. Akene, a feral warrior, summons dinosaurs to crush her enemies with raw instinct. Others wield their fragments in ways entirely their own. Discover each character's playstyle, full potential, and hidden story.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH OF THE FALLEN GODS

The history of the Origin Gods, the Ashen God's corruption, and the world before its fall lies scattered across the ruins. Piece together fragments of a forgotten timeline through your countless attempts — and encounter the most ancient survivors of an age long lost.

MORE TO COME IN EARLY ACCESS

The world of Last Ember will grow. More content — cards, events, environments, enemies, and more — will be added throughout Early Access. Join us early and help shape the path the Ember takes next.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the early 2000s, a series of horrifying incidents shattered countless lives across the world. No one truly understood the purpose behind them. Some called it corruption, others called it power beyond humanity itself. But as the truth slowly surfaced, one terrifying possibility emerged — perhaps the real monsters were never demons, but humans with absolute control over others.

For decades, hidden networks operated in silence, untouchable and unseen. Yet this time, the scale of the atrocities surpassed all expectations. Rumors spread of powerful figures manipulating lives from the shadows, protected by fear, wealth, and influence. Many believed these “demons among us” could do anything they wished — and no one could stop them.

In Apestin Explorer, you play as an investigative journalist determined to uncover the truth behind a massive underground crime network buried beneath layers of secrecy, manipulation, and terror. Explore abandoned locations, collect hidden evidence, and connect scattered clues tied to horrifying events that were never meant to be exposed.

Every document, hidden room, and forgotten recording pulls you deeper into a world where power silences justice and fear controls reality. The deeper you investigate, the darker the truth becomes.

A Dark Detective Exploration Experience

Immerse yourself in an eerie world filled with tension, mystery, and unsettling realism. Investigate abandoned facilities, underground locations, secret archives, and forgotten crime scenes connected to a disturbing conspiracy.

Become an Investigative Journalist

Search environments carefully, gather evidence, uncover hidden files, and connect fragments of information to slowly reveal the truth behind a massive criminal network.

Clue-Based Mystery Investigation

There are no traditional choice-based story paths. Progress depends entirely on your ability to discover clues, analyze details, and connect the dots between events, people, and locations.

Psychological Horror Rooted in Reality

Apestin Explorer creates fear through disturbing revelations, oppressive environments, hidden truths, and the terrifying possibility that the true evil exists within humanity itself.

Immersive Atmosphere and Sound Design

Detailed environments, haunting ambient audio, realistic lighting, and unsettling music create a constant sense of paranoia and dread throughout your investigation.

Unravel a Massive Hidden Conspiracy

As the investigation progresses, seemingly unrelated incidents begin to connect, revealing a horrifying network far larger than anyone imagined.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the signal.

A small lighthouse on a dark coast. Lost souls drift in the water, searching for shore. Something else is out there, creeping inward whenever the light looks away. You are the only thing standing between them.

One beam. Two jobs.

  • Hold the outer glow on a soul and it follows your light home.

  • Focus the inner core on the dark and it retreats and burns.

  • You can only do one at a time. Every second is a quiet decision.

A vigil that gets harder the longer you hold it.

Moon phases drive the pressure. Fog shrinks what you can see. Storms push the souls off course. Allies surface from the deep when the night turns ugly, and the keeper talks on the radio through it all — to herself, to the sea, to whoever is still listening.

From a top 5% jam game into a full release.

Lighthouse's Vigil started as a 72-hour entry to Ludum Dare 59, where it placed in the top 5% out of ~1,600 games (Mood and Audio especially). The Steam version is the expansion we always wanted to build — more nights, more weather, more of what worked, and the systems we couldn't fit the first time. Every piece of supportive, generous feedback we got during the jam is going into this version.

"The light went out."

store_data.about_the_game:
FussyCraft Survival: Sandbox is a darkly funny 2D pixel survival sandbox where you start as an ordinary peasant in a land squeezed dry by a greedy king.

Every seventh day, the royal collectors arrive. They take your meat and mining materials. If you have no meat, you are done. If you have supplies, you survive, but the king still takes his cut. So you must mine, build, craft, cook, fight and carefully manage everything you find.

Start from nothing. Get your first tools, build a safe place, cook meat, learn spells, upgrade perks and prepare for nights full of strange creatures. The world is block-based, destructible and dangerous. Every piece of ore, every bit of meat and every wall you build can decide whether you survive the next royal levy.

Your main goal is to travel through seven dangerous locations to the right, find the castle and defeat the king as the main boss. After the king is overthrown, the game does not end. The world continues, but the royal levies stop, and you can keep building, collecting, upgrading and surviving your own way.

Main features:

- 2D pixel sandbox world

- mining, building and destructible environments

- crafting tools, weapons, food and equipment

- cooking meat and managing supplies

- darkly humorous royal levy system

- spells, mana, stamina and perks

- enemies, zombies and other strange creatures

- progression through seven locations toward the king’s castle

- main boss battle against the king

- the ability to continue playing after completing the main objective

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Features

Strategic Combat

Unlike traditional falling blocks games that focus solely on precise execution, this game introduces a rich layer of strategic gameplay.

For example, victory might require capturing 2 out of 3 resource points. This forces players to make tactical decisions—such as sacrificing Point A to secure Point B while contesting Point C.

  

Difficulty Challenge

The PvE mode offers diverse "Challenge" gameplay, where players must secure consecutive victories to unlock and tackle higher difficulties.

On top of that, the game also features a Score Attack mode. In this mode, players can focus entirely on chasing high scores without the distraction of opponents or environmental changes.

 

 

Other Features

Blocks can freely weave through gaps without the hassle of rotating and squeezing them into place—making "stacking" the true core of the game.

The game features a rich variety of stacking elements, including every block type from single blocks to 5-block pieces. This breaks away from rigid, formulaic gameplay and lets players rediscover the joy of adapting to the unexpected.

Clear up to five lines at once!

Usually, clearing two lines at once yields a higher reward than clearing two single lines separately. However, in certain modes, the rewards are equal, or the latter may even be more beneficial. As victory objectives vary, your line-clearing strategy must adapt accordingly.

Most modes support shared screen co-op or versus play—double the fun with a single copy!

In PVP, you can adjust buffs to balance the match, turning a lopsided battle into a fair and even contest.

store_data.about_the_game:
Orbit Breaker is a top-down survival action game about geometric cores, automatic weapons, and build-defining evolutions.

Combat is automatic, but survival is not. You move, dodge, position yourself, collect XP and gold, and choose upgrades while enemies close in. Each core starts with a signature weapon and grows in a different direction. Match weapons with the right passives to evolve them into stronger forms.

Stages are more than empty arenas. Move through connected sectors, uncover hidden unlocks, fight room wardens and timed pressure waves, then defeat the final boss to clear the stage.

Every run feeds the next one. Spend gold on permanent powerups, unlock new cores, weapons, passives, and stages, then return with a sharper build plan.

## Features

- Geometric cores with signature starting weapons

- Automatic attacks built around movement, dodging, and positioning

- Weapon and passive pairs that evolve into stronger equipment

- Sector-based stages with hidden rewards, wardens, miniboss pressure, and final bosses

- Permanent gold powerups and expandable equipment slots

- Four save slots, run history, and weapon damage reports

- Multilingual UI including Korean and English

store_data.about_the_game:
Bomb smarter. Move freely. Strike on a tight grid.

BomBee is a cute-but-cutthroat online arcade PvP game where bees brawl with honey bombs, sticky trails, and razor-sharp timing chains on one focused battlefield. Matches stay readable and fights stay honest: ranked is always exactly four contestants in pure free-for-all, capped at roughly three minutes from start to finish.

CORE FLOW

• Ranked Mode locks to four-player free-for-all every queue—built for tight execution reads in quick ~3-minute rounds.

• Custom matches support two through four contestants in layouts you choose: everyone-for-themselves free-for-all or coordinated team showdowns whenever you invite friends instead of sweating ladder points.

• Climb ranked rating to rise on BomBee leaderboards—the ladder reflects match outcomes, never paid stat boosts.

GAMEPLAY EDGE

• You move freely across the arena while blast resolution snaps to grid logic, so combos feel crisp: stagger explosions, choke lanes, punish panic rolls, and use terrain kills like classic bomber stars—just with bee-flavored chaos.

• Match tempo rewards timing intelligence, reflexes, and layered mind games—the honey-bomb delay window is meant for deliberately chained pressure, not slot-machine swings.

PICKUPS WITHOUT PAY-TO-WIN PRESSURE

• Destroy map props to uncover pickups—what spawns rolls randomly round to round for that arcade surprise factor, yet nothing you buy off the storefront replaces raw skill.

MONETIZATION & INTEGRITY

• Monetization sticks to cosmetics-only purchases; there’s no storefront lottery for lethal gear or stamina locks tied to wallets.

• Dedicated, server-forward authority keeps rulings authoritative and shuts the door on the lightest-touch client spoof tricks people try in flaky peer sessions.

VISUAL THEMES AND TONE

• Expect bright flowers, bubbly bees, sweet honey payloads, vine trails, and a playful Saturday-morning sparkle wrapped around hardcore duel energy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Descend with only a deck of cards.

AITA: The Dark Domain is a roguelite card game set in the Etruscan underworld. Play solo or with up to three friends as Haruspices, ritual priests sent below the earth to seal the dead back inside Aita.

Every card is both an attack and a choice. Spend your strongest cards too early and you may not survive the counterattack. Hold back too long and the underworld will grind you down.

Four suits. Four sacred rites.

Each suit has a different power:

  • Clubs - The Hammer: double your damage.

  • Spades - The Mirror: shield against enemy attacks.

  • Hearts - The Libation: return spent cards to your deck.

  • Diamonds - The Augury: draw deeper into your hand.

Bosses are immune to their own suit, so every fight asks a different question: do you chase damage, rebuild your deck, defend for later, or risk a draw when the next attack is coming?

Build around Blessings.

Choose a starting Blessing before each run, then find more at campfire stops between acts. Blessings change the rules in your favor, pushing you toward different styles of play:

  • Hammer builds that turn Clubs into brutal killing blows.

  • Augur builds that manipulate draws and shape the deck.

  • Shield-Bearer builds that survive attacks other players cannot.

🏠 **The Giant Rooftop Cat**

Step outside and look up! A massive, sleeping giant cat rests on your roof. It's the ultimate cozy landmark for your retail empire.

Put on your headset, grow your business, and build your dream Meow Mart today!

store_data.about_the_game:
Organic Evolution is a neon-themed platformer set in an underwater microcosm. You play as a tiny, one-eyed organism who must navigate procedurally generated levels, finding keys and reaching the exit.

Controls:

A, D, or left/right arrow keys — move left and right. Spacebar — jump. You can jump multiple times in the air (the number of available jumps is displayed on the top bar). W or up arrow — break a block above you and jump. S or down arrow — break a block below you. ESC — menu, P — pause.

Key mechanics:

Multiple jumps in the air. The character has a statutory jump reserve (5 in normal mode, 10 in Explorer mode). This allows you to leap large gaps and climb high platforms. Jumps are restored upon landing.

Block destruction. Some blocks in the level can be broken by pressing up or down. Coins may be hidden behind them. Broken blocks regenerate after a while.

Keys and the door. In each level, you need to find a key (a glowing golden flower). When the key is found, an indicator on the panel lights up, and you can enter the exit (vortex). Without the key, the exit is blocked.

Spores (shields). For every 2,000 points, a shield spore is automatically added (maximum 10). The shield absorbs one enemy hit. After a hit, the shield disappears and grants short-term invulnerability. The number of spores is displayed in the top panel.

Extra Lives. For every 25,000 points, one life is restored (maximum 10).

When killed by an enemy, the enemy is destroyed along with the player, and they respawn on the spot.

Enemies:

Jellyfish - float in the air, moving along sinusoidal paths. Runners - one-eyed creatures with legs, patrolling platforms. If you break a block beneath them, they fall and die. Snails - slow creatures with a shell and spikes, also patrol platforms and are vulnerable to falling. Starfish - rotating creatures with three eyes, flying along paths. Pulsars - appear and disappear, dangerous in the active phase. Toxic Algae are static hazards on the floor.

Destroying enemies drops gem crystals, which can be collected for extra points.

Game Modes:

Classic — a standard playthrough of 8 levels of increasing difficulty. 5 mid-air jumps.

Explorer — extended levels (double the map's height), 10 mid-air jumps, and the goal is to find 5 keys on each level instead of just one.

Extreme — same as Classic, but visibility is limited by a circle of light around the player. The rest of the level is immersed in darkness. Keys and the exit glow faintly.

HUD (top panel):

Hearts — health (maximum 10).

LVL — current level.

JUMP — remaining mid-air jumps.

SPORES — number of shields.

KEY — whether a key has been collected (or the key counter in Explorer).

SCORE — points earned.

The bar under the score indicates progress to the next level. Shield Spores.

Features:

Neon visual style on a dark background with a hexagonal grid. 8 unique color themes for each level. Procedural level generation. Three game modes. Shield system earned with points. Destructible environment with block regeneration. Hidden coins in blocks. Several enemy types with different behavior patterns. Crystals dropped by enemies. Progress saving. Steam integration (achievements and leaderboards). Atmospheric soundtrack.

store_data.about_the_game:
Project Neon takes the addictive "merge-to-win" logic of 2048 and wraps it in a sleek, modern aesthetic. Whether you are a puzzle veteran or a casual player looking for a rhythmic, satisfying experience, Project Neon provides the perfect balance of strategy and style.

The Core Challenge

The rules are simple, but the strategy is deep. Slide tiles across the grid to merge matching numbers. Your goal? Reach the legendary 2048 tile—and then keep going to chase the ultimate high score. Every move counts as you manage your board space and plan your next merge.

Unlock the Glow

Why settle for one look when you can play in style? Project Neon features three distinct unlockable themes that change the game’s visual identity.

  • Earn Your Style: Unlock new aesthetics naturally through gameplay milestones.

  • Transformative Boards: Each theme provides a fresh take on the game board, changing colors and atmosphere to suit your mood.

  • Visual Polish: Experience smooth animations and a vibrant "Neon" interface designed to keep you in the flow state.

Key Features:

  • Intuitive Gameplay: Easy to pick up immediately, but challenging to master.

  • Sleek Minimalism: A clean, distraction-free UI that puts the focus entirely on the puzzle and the glow.

  • High-Score Tracking: Push your limits and track your progress as you climb higher.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is not just another poker game. Welcome to Hellsino, a twisted casino where you fight against the dealer for your eternal soul.

In this dark, tactical roguelike deckbuilder, combat takes place on a high-stakes grid. Every card you drop deals direct damage to the dealer. Arrange your cards to form classic 3-card poker hands to trigger massive multipliers based on card values. Face cards hold true power, with the Jack counting as 11, Queen as 12, and King as 13. Align your patterns horizontally and vertically to trigger a devastating Nexus Multiplier for game-breaking damage surges.

The casino floor always wins unless you rig the system. Play smart, cheat dirty, and clear out the house before your debt catches up to you.

You start each run with a full deck of 54 cards. These cards are your actual life total. The dealer will stop at nothing to shred your deck. Plan your grid placement wisely to shield your high-value cards, or sacrifice useless ranks to absorb incoming blows.

Survive distinct Acts divided into scaling threat levels to win Soul Chips. Spend your earnings in the shop to acquire over 45 game-changing Perks and Cheat Cards to break the traditional rules of the house. Force flushes, duplicate cards with Mirror Ink, or deploy heavy shields to secure your board.

Cheating a Cards

Perks

Break the classic constraints of the table. Straights do not stop at the King. Loop your hands seamlessly from King to Ace to Two to keep your scoring chains alive.

Trapped in a losing hand? Drop the Fold Bomb to clear the board and return your cards to the bank. Freedom comes at a price, as one random card will be permanently destroyed in the blast.

When your bank is nearly bankrupt, unleash the ultimate desperation play. Trigger a massive damage bonus fueled directly by the shields you lost during the run. Give the house one final nightmare before you go under.

Oh... and one more thing...

store_data.about_the_game:
Dark Workshop is a first-person dark-fantasy shop sim.

Step behind the counter of your own dark-fantasy emporium, where adventurers, alchemists, and creatures of uncertain allegiance come to spend their gold. You set the prices, stock the shelves, and manage the chaos. Whether anyone leaves satisfied is largely up to you.

A Market That Never Sits Still

The world outside your door does not cooperate. Plagues sweep the village and double the demand for anything medicinal. War bands ride through and drain your weapons stock in an afternoon. A witch-hunter's edict reaches town, and suddenly every potion you sell is a liability. World events continually reshape supply, demand, and supplier availability, forcing you to order wisely during the rumor phase, stockpile ahead, and adapt when things go awry. The market is alive, and it is not on your side.

Craft Everything Yourself

Order ingredients from a network of shadowy suppliers — a swamp witch, a grave digger, a shady merchant, and others who unlock as your fame grows. Take those ingredients to your crafting stations, brew volatile potions in the alchemy lab, hammer out enchanted blades at the forge, and stock the results at the right price. Every recipe has a cost. Every item has a margin. Getting it right takes practice.

Explore Your Expanding Workshop

Your shop begins small. Behind locked doors lie chambers waiting to be reclaimed: a cave full of collectable ingredients, a fog-shrouded swamp, a graveyard with its own unusual supply line, a forge smelling faintly of sulfur, and a library whose contents are best left unexamined. Each room you unlock is a new space to walk through, stock, and eventually run as part of the business. The workshop grows with you.

Guests You Did Not Invite

Not every visitor comes through the front door politely. Thieves case your shelves and slip items into their coats while you are distracted — you can confront them yourself with a hammer, or hire a guard zombie to handle the situation. Strange travelers appear between shop days with unusual requests and stranger backstories, offering modest rewards for playing along or a quiet insult if you decline. And occasionally a bulk buyer with deep pockets empties an entire category from your shelves, which is either excellent news or a disaster, depending on what you were planning.

Build, Hire, and Automate

Place shelves, racks, and furniture to shape your shop and improve its reputation. Hire zombie employees to cover the repetitive work — a stocker who restocks shelves, a collector who gathers ingredients from outdoor zones, a cashier who handles the register so you can focus elsewhere, and a guard who discourages theft with varying degrees of subtlety.

Fame, Progression, and the Long Game

Serve enough customers, weather enough events, and fulfill enough contracts, and your fame grows. Higher fame unlocks better suppliers, rarer recipes, and more dangerous events. Grow it high enough, and an ancient Grimoire opens a skill tree of permanent upgrades across crafting, shop management, and employee effectiveness. The workshop you end with looks very little like the one you started with.

Features

- First-person shopkeeping in a dark-fantasy world

- World events that reshape supply, demand, and supplier access day by day

- Deep crafting across alchemy, forging, and more

- Explorable rooms to unlock and expand into

- Dynamic market with daily price fluctuations and supply pressure

- Thieves who steal, and multiple ways to stop them

- Random encounters with travelers between shop days

- Zombie employees: stocker, collector, cashier, guard

- Contracts and bulk buyers that test your inventory planning

- Skill tree accessible through an ancient Grimoire

- Build and decorate to shape your shop and boost renown

store_data.about_the_game:
Auto-shoot the horde while the arena folds beneath you. Step off the right edge and come back on the left. Walk past the seam and the world flips. Drop through a wormhole and arrive somewhere new. The arena rearranges itself on its own timer, and you have to keep playing while it does.

The arena moves

The playfield is a literal manifold. It warps, folds, pinches, and turns inside out while you're trying to live through it. Your bullets travel along curved paths because the space is curved. Enemies behind you on a torus are actually above you, just shy of looping around. When the arena becomes a Möbius strip, the projectile you fired ten seconds ago might come back at you flipped, hitting from the wrong side. The geometry has consequences.

3D rendered in 2D vector space

The aesthetic is 1979's Asteroids put through HDR bloom: vector primitives on a near-black void. Role-coded color does the work. Red is always an enemy. White is always you. Green is always good news. It's 3D rendered in 2D vector space, and the screen composes impossible perspectives that work because the math is honest. You can see a sphere from the outside while standing on it. You can see a Klein bottle that doesn't fit in three dimensions at all.

Between runs

Each run takes a handful of minutes. Between runs, you spend Stars on a constellation that unlocks new shapes, modifiers, weapons, and bosses. Every constellation pattern you complete opens another stretch of the catalog.

The arena hasn't moved yet. You think you understand it. You don't.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Shortcut Hero: Grid City is a fast-paced keyboard shortcut action game where you protect a city’s critical data from an army of evil robots.

The mutronic army is trying to Harvest the City's protected data.  As the city’s last line of defense, you’ll move across the grid, trigger keyboard shortcuts, destroy threats, and keep the defenses together before the robots break through.

Built for players who like quick skill-based challenges, Shortcut Hero: Grid City turns keyboard shortcuts into arcade action. Learn by doing, improve through repetition, and chase better scores as the pressure ramps up.

Master Keyboard Shortcuts Through Gameplay

Instead of memorizing shortcuts from a boring list, you’ll use them under pressure. Move across the grid, react to robot attacks, and execute commands quickly to protect the city’s data systems.

Multiple Game Modes

Launch content is planned around several ways to play:

  • Hero Mode — defend the city’s data grid and survive escalating robot attacks.

  • Wave Mode — face waves of enemies and clear them before they overwhelm you.

  • Puzzle Mode — solve shortcut-based challenges with precision.

  • Training Mode — practice commands and build confidence before jumping into harder modes.

Fast, Simple, Replayable

Sessions are designed to be quick and repeatable. The better you get, the faster you react, the cleaner your inputs become, and the higher your scores climb.

Built for Shortcut Mastery

Whether you are a spreadsheet power user, a keyboard shortcut addict, or someone who wants to get faster without reading a manual, Shortcut Hero: Grid City gives you a more fun way to practice.

Key Features

  • Keyboard shortcut-based gameplay

  • Fast-paced arcade action

  • Evil robot enemies

  • City-saving data defense theme

  • Grid-based movement and challenges

  • Score attack allows replayable fun

  • Multiple modes for practice and challenge

  • Cartoon-style 2D presentation

  • Single-player gameplay

  • Designed for Windows and macOS

store_data.about_the_game:
CacaClicker — the most absurd clicker on Steam!

Click. Produce. Prestige. Repeat.

Welcome to CacaClicker, a completely ridiculous clicker game where your only goal is to produce ever more poop. Start with a simple click, unlock dozens of automations, climb the prestige ladder, and dive into the mysterious Corrupted Mode for a radically transformed experience.

✦ What awaits you

💩 Infinite Production — Click, buy manual and automatic upgrades, blow past the million, the billion, the trillion poops.

⚔️ Boss Battles — Face off against increasingly tough bosses and earn talent points to become overpowered.

🎰 Poop Casino — Try your luck at the Poop Machine (HiLo) or Blackjack to multiply your earnings.

🧪 Laboratory — Unlock 7 research tubes that produce non-stop while you play.

✨ Prestige & Meta-Prestige — Start over stronger, accumulate Filth and Essence for permanent bonuses.

🌑 Corrupted Mode — Once you defeat the level 100 boss, switch into a parallel universe with its own economy, talents, and skins.

🎨 25 Skins & 33 Wallpapers — Customize your poop and the game's background: galaxy, medieval, cyberpunk, Christmas, and many more.

🏆 Achievements to unlock — Dozens of challenges for hardcore completionists.

🎁 Daily rewards — Log in every day to collect Crottos, the premium currency.

☁️ Cloud Save — Your progress follows your Steam account, on any PC.

✦ Who is it for?

For those who love absurd humor, satisfying progression loops, and games you can literally leave running while doing something else. If you loved Cookie Clicker, Adventure Capitalist, or any other incremental game, you'll adore turning vulgarity into an exact science.

✦ Features

🇫🇷 Fully in French (English coming soon)

🖱️ Mouse-only (keyboard optional)

💾 Auto-save + Steam Cloud

🎮 Playable in windowed, fullscreen, or Steam Deck

⏱️ From 30 minutes to hundreds of hours depending on your obsession

Get your index finger ready. The great scato-cosmic adventure begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jack Bonecroft 4 is a story-driven action RPG set across the four distinct kingdoms — Valeria, Thronveil, Voltaris, and Drakenscar in the Solrithia Continent — a world of ancient forests, industrial cities, crystal-veined caverns, and mist-covered lands where the boundary between dimensions runs thin.

You play as Lunara Mistwalker, a traveller from a distant dimension, sent to Solrithia with a single instruction: find Jack Bonecroft. A man she has never met. To a man, she has been sent to ask for his help. He is the only individual capable of stopping what is coming. What follows is a journey across four kingdoms, each of which holds something Lunara needs. None of them is expecting her.

EXPLORE A LIVING WORLD

Four distinct kingdoms await — each with its own culture, architecture, economy, and history. Valeria's golden fields and open warmth. Thronveil's ancient forest and Sylvari wisdom. Voltaris's industrial precision and crystal-powered machinery. Drakenscar's mist, crystal dust, and the particular strength of a people shaped by harsh terrain.

Every settlement has stories. Every library has records. Every person you meet has a life that existed before you arrived and will continue after you leave.

A STORY BUILT ON HISTORY

The continent of Solrithia carries the weight of The Conquest of Greed — a war that ended three thousand years ago and still shapes every kingdom standing today. The warrior who ended it, Jack Bonecroft, made a pact. That pact has been waiting for the right person to help fulfil it again.

You are that person. Probably.

 L.U.M.I.R.

You are not alone. L.U.M.I.R. — Lightweight Mobile Inventory and Response Unit — accompanies you throughout the journey. He handles navigation, translation, inventory management, and commentary (mostly the commentary) with a growing log of observations and the occasional moment of something that functions very much like wonder.

SOMETHING IS COMING

The crystal networks across Solrithia have been tracking dimensional pressure for longer than anyone realised. The boundary between this world and others has been thinning. Whatever is pressing against it is getting closer.

Jack Bonecroft ended one war. The next one hasn't started yet.

Bring him back before it does.

Features

  • A story-driven action RPG with exploration elements

  • A narrative with fully written dialogue for (almost) every character

  • Four distinct kingdoms with unique cultures, histories, and visual identities

  • A companion system built around Lumir — reactive, commenting, and genuinely present throughout the journey

  • A mystery that unfolds slowly across the entire game and series.

  • Libraries with regional history and lore for those who want to go deeper 

  • Environmental storytelling through statues, inscriptions, and world details 

  • Based on true events witnessed during my business trip to this sector

  • I RUN OUT OF TEA !!!

Jack Bonecroft 4 and Jack Bonecroft Universe are independent productions by Galactic Tenebris Company. All development and design by a single developer(for now).

The events of this game are based on true events I witnessed firsthand during a business trip to this sector. All kingdoms, characters, and crystal formations are as accurate as memory and game development allow. I was there. I saw everything. What you are about to play is a faithful account of what happened. 

P.S. Lu and Mae are my employees; they make sure the game works fine, and also, I am out of TEA. I hope you enjoy my game.

— Mr. M., Owner of Galactic Tenebris Company

HOW FAR WOULD YOU GO FOR YOUR LOVED ONE?

1991 was the year it all changed for the Henderson Family.

Lily Henderson suffers from mental illness. The only escape being talking to her father and the safe space of her apartment.

But what happens when things change? You're no longer in control of your surroundings.

Missing. Lily has disappeared and it's up to you, Liam Henderson - to pick up the pieces.

Find your daughter.

IF YOU'RE NOT CAREFUL...

In this first person psychological horror game, loneliness is your best friend, as well as your flashlight.

HIGH END GRAPHICAL ENVIRONMENT

Walk endlessly with a purpose in an environment that grows more unstable by the minute.

AROUND EVERY CORNER IS A STORY TO BE TOLD.

1991 was the year it all changed for the Henderson Family.

Missing. Lily has disappeared and it's up to you, Liam Henderson - to pick up the pieces.

Find your daughter.

IF YOU'RE NOT CAREFUL...

In this first person psychological horror game, loneliness is your best friend, as well as your flashlight.

HIGH END GRAPHICAL ENVIRONMENT

Walk endlessly with a purpose in an environment that grows more unstable by the minute.

AROUND EVERY CORNER IS A STORY TO BE TOLD.

Inspecting thoroughly rewards you with new lore that expands "The Complex" even further than ever.

store_data.about_the_game:
Digital can be forged, but analog is absolute.

In a near-future where AI advancements allow media and records to be seamlessly manipulated, digital proof is no longer trusted. Someone out there is even rewriting human memories. Every day, crime scenes, victims' faces, and yesterday's reality are silently wiped away...

However, two things remain untouched by AI's grasp: Analog, and the Dokkaebi.

Enter Philip Kang—the camera-headed Dokkaebi detective who possesses the power of both. Step into his shoes to navigate through fabricated lies, uncover the buried truth, and solve the mysteries.

Question the Suspects

Gather new information by speaking with those involved in the case. But beware—what they tell you may not always be the truth. Doubt everything. Even false testimonies can become vital evidence.

Investigate the Crime Scene

The physical traces left at the scene are your most reliable evidence. Not even advanced AI technology can manipulate the physical clues left behind. Scour every corner of the crime scene and meticulously gather your clues.

Piece Together the Evidence

The clues you collect are stepping stones to new revelations. Place two pieces of evidence into the Darkroom slots to "develop" them. A photograph and a memo, a note and a testimony, a statement and an alibi—depending on what you combine, scattered facts will emerge as a brand-new truth.

Shatter the Lies!

Once you have secured enough solid evidence, it's time to close in on the truth. Use the information you've gathered to pinpoint contradictions in the suspects' claims.

If you've organized your evidence well, you will be able to expose their lies and bring the ultimate truth to light.

store_data.about_the_game:
TAILROUGE is a fast-paced minimalist action roguelite built around one simple idea:

Your tail is your weapon.

Move with the mouse, boost through danger, and use your trailing body to cut through waves of enemies. Every run is short, intense, and focused on clean movement, sharp turns, and satisfying chain reactions.

Collect cards to evolve your abilities and create powerful builds. Some cards enhance your tail, some add new attacks, and others give you defensive tools when things get dangerous.

Circle enemies. Slice them apart. Survive as long as you can.

Features:

- Fast arcade-style survival action

- Tail-based combat built around movement and positioning

- Card-based upgrades that change each run

- Minimalist red-and-black visual style

- Short, replayable runs

- Simple mouse controls

- No complicated menus, no long tutorials, just action

TAILROUGE is designed for players who enjoy quick roguelite runs, clean mechanics, and the feeling of getting stronger one card at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gameplay:

In ORBTRUDER, you control a small killer robot ball that ricochets off walls and enemies. Gameplay is divided into a series of locations, each ending in a boss fight. Each location is procedurally generated anew each game session and is divided into rooms. The rooms have doors that open only after all enemies in front of them have been defeated.

Orbtruder features mini-quests and special events that can grant the player upgrades for their robot. The robot can run, jump, hover, choose its attack direction, and fire. Each enemy has weak points, and depending on the damage to these weak points, the robot will change its behavior. If the player dies, the game restarts. All upgrades are lost, but any achievements unlocked remain.

Story:

A mysterious scientist living in a secret underground base creates a small killer robot ball (Orbtruder) and sends it to a mysterious corporation's Skyscraper on the seashore with orders to blow everything up!

But it's not that simple: beneath the seemingly respectable business lies a veritable evil empire: experimenting on people, developing cutting-edge weapons, and exploiting workers.

Will Orbtruder be able to fulfill its mission, or will it become another pile of junk, like its predecessors?

Key Features:

  • Diverse finishing animations. Most enemies have multiple weak points: their arms, legs, heads, etc. can be severed. This makes combat more varied and exciting.

  • Unique ricochet attack mechanics. The attack is performed by aiming a shot or ricocheting it at an enemy. A well-placed trajectory allows you to eliminate multiple targets at once.

  • A multitude of enemies, bosses, and upgrades. The game is planned to feature over 8 locations, over 20 skins, over 30 enemies and bosses, and over 100 upgrades.

store_data.about_the_game:
Home is where your herd is!

In Capybara: The Great Journey, you take control of Delício, a friendly orphan capybara who has no idea where he came from, but knows exactly who he belongs to: the kind farmer who adopted and raised him with love since he was a pup.

The problem is that the peaceful times are over. The beloved farm they grew up on is in ruins and on the verge of bankruptcy. The fences are down, the fields are dry, the coffers are empty, and a ruthless bank threatens to seize the property. For years, Delício and his friends never left the safe borders of the farm, but now, they will need to cross the boundary into the unknown to save the only home they know!

🐾 Play Solo or Online Co-op

You don't have to carry this weight alone! Take on the role of Delício or join up to three friends in online multiplayer. Your friends will control the capybara's inseparable companions: a cunning pig, a loyal dog, and a brave sheep. Divide the tasks, gather money, and work as a team to prevent the bank from taking everything.

🌾 Rebuild, Plant, and Evolve

Literally get your paws in the dirt! Start by clearing the ruined land and work hard to rebuild the place.

  • Agriculture and Livestock: Plant strategic crops, take care of new animal breeding, and manage the harvest.

  • Hard Work: Accept jobs in the region, fix broken machinery, and invest your profits wisely.

  • Constant Evolution: Upgrade the farm's structures, build new facilities, and turn a bankrupt plot of land into an agricultural powerhouse.

🗺️ Explore the World Beyond the Fence

To pay off the debts and save the farmer, just staying on the farm won't be enough. Venture into a vast world full of Quests, exploring four major regions to find rare resources, new jobs, and unique characters:

  • The Forest: Mysterious, dense, and full of essential gathering materials.

  • The Desert: Scorching and unforgiving, where resource management is tested to the limit.

  • The Ice Mountains: A freezing environment that will require preparation from your herd.

  • The Big City: The bustling financial heart, where the big deals (and the bank's debt collectors) are.

🔍 Discover Who You Are

While you fight to secure the farm's future, secrets about the little capybara's forgotten past will begin to surface along the way. Where did Delício really come from?

Grab your tools, gather your herd, and prepare for the most important adventure of your lives. The farmer took care of you, now it's your turn to take care of him!

store_data.about_the_game:
Brightglade Tales is a fast-paced two-player card game about the struggle for influence in the land of Brightglade. Every match is a short, intense skirmish (15–30 minutes) in which you don't just build your own crew — you actively sabotage your opponent: stealing their resources, bribing their people, destroying the very things they're fighting for.

Goal of the game

Three locations drawn from the deck lie on the table. The winner is the first player to seize control of one of them — and to do that, you need to gather enough Dominance Points and assemble a crew with the right composition. Sounds simple, but your opponent has exactly the same options as you, and the cards on the market are shared.

How to play

The core gameplay loop revolves around three types of cards:

  • Resources — drawn from the market to fuel your actions

  • Crew — recruited to carry out missions and seize locations

  • Missions — the source of Dominance Points and special effects

What you can do on missions

  • steal and destroy your opponent's resources

  • intimidate, eliminate, bribe, and take over their crew

  • train new recruits and bring back members from discarded cards

  • sacrifice your own crew for extra Dominance Points

  • destroy the locations being contested

The Gameplay Writes the Tale

There is no script — the story of each match is a series of decisions: who to recruit, which missions to take on, what to steal from your opponent. Every game is a different tale of intrigue, betrayal, and risky plays in Brightglade.

Game modes

  • local play against AI

  • online PvP multiplayer

store_data.about_the_game:
VHS // Anima 021 is a retro-style horror video game inspired by the “found footage” genre.

Travel through levels in search of anomalies with the goal of capturing them on camera. But you’re not alone in this liminal space. There are other erratic, watchful beings that will try to stalk and hunt you down. You’ll need to switch between map view and first-person view, deciding when to record and when to take risks. Each completed tape reveals fragments of a mysterious story.

This video game aims to combine horror with a retro aesthetic, exploration of liminal spaces, and resource management into an intense and frenetic experience.

  • Your objective in each level will be to find the anomalies/glitches scattered throughout the environment. Once you find them, use “camera view” mode to capture orbs around each anomaly and restore it to a stable state. Once all anomalies are resolved, you can interact with the main TV to play a short minigame where you’ll review your gameplay recording to find the moments when you captured an anomaly. And remember, you can rewind the tape to return to a past moment.

store_data.about_the_game: Webs of Reverie is a survival-horror game where you play as a man who wakes up in an asylum with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As you wander the empty halls of Ironveil Psychiatric Hospital, you begin to decipher what is real and what is just in your mind. Explore the asylum and solve puzzles to figure out clues as to what is going on in the asylum. Players must also lock-pick doors to get into locked areas and use the archive entrances, which are more dangerous but give you access to different locations. As your sanity levels drop, the game becomes more aggressive, and the environment around you distorts, so you have to manage your limited supply of pills to more safely navigate your way around the asylum. While exploring, you must avoid being caught by Nurse Bloodwell as she patrols the halls trying to prevent your progress. Will you be able to decipher the clues and escape, or become another victim of what lies in the shadows?

store_data.about_the_game:
Etymancy

noun

e·ty·man·cy | EH-tuh-man-see

1. the school of magic that derives its power from language

2. the practice of shaping letters into words, and words into spells

Etymancer

e·ty·man·cer | EH-tuh-MAN-ser

noun

One who braves the Lexicon

Etymancy is a roguelike dungeon crawler about turning language into damage. Craft words from a rack of letter tiles, cast them as spells, and survive foul creatures that burn, curse, obscure, shatter, bleed, disable and rewrite the tools you rely on.

Key Features

  • Cast spells by forming words from your rack of letters.

  • Stack grimoires that boost power, give coins, and shake your kit up in wild and unpredictable ways.

  • Collect blessed and cursed letter tiles with dangerous side effects.

  • Navigate encounters, markets, chests, bonfires, and other mysterious zones of the dungeon.

  • Face foes that attack your health, your rack, your pile, and your preparation.

  • Challenge Deities which test your mettle and alter the very play surface itself.

  • Craft explosive builds, face your fears, and ascend.

Etymancy is actively in development, with new grimoires, enemies, bosses, tile effects, balance changes, and visual updates being added constantly.

Currently Included:

  • 40+ grimoires across common, rare, epic, and legendary rarities

  •  Blessed, cursed, and mutated letter tiles

  • Multiple enemy families with distinct rack, pile, health, and scoring effects

  • Elite encounters with harsher enemy behavior and better rewards

  • Deity fights with unique mechanics, intros, phases, threats

  • Path choices including encounters, markets, chests, and bonfires

  • A market with grimoires, special tiles, healing, and tile removal

  • A guided tutorial that introduces you to the dungeon

  • Persistent run memory and a grimoire archive

  • Full keyboard word entry with mouse support

Trailer music by Novalley

store_data.about_the_game:
Waifu Potion is a potion-themed adult puzzle game built around image-based tile swapping, gradually increasing grid sizes, stage progression, hints, and unlockable artwork.


The current Early Access version includes 10 playable puzzle levels. In each level, the image is split into shuffled blocks. Your goal is to rebuild the image by placing the blocks into their correct positions.


The puzzle mechanic is based on direct selection rather than dragging or sliding. You first select one shuffled block, then select any other block you want to swap it with. The two selected blocks instantly exchange positions. You are free to choose any two blocks on the grid; they do not need to be next to each other.



As you progress, the grid size increases and the puzzles become more demanding. Larger grids require closer observation, memory, and planning as you compare image details, identify misplaced blocks, and decide which swaps will solve the puzzle efficiently.


The game includes a hint system to help when you get stuck. Hints are designed to support the puzzle flow without turning the game into a speed challenge. The focus is on relaxed puzzle solving, gradual progression, and completing each image at your own pace.


By completing stages, you progress through the level list and unlock more artwork. The planned full version will expand the game from 10 puzzle levels to 20 puzzle levels, with the remaining levels shaped around puzzle difficulty, grid progression, and player feedback during Early Access.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gospel Snowtown is an AI-driven post-apocalyptic survival simulation game.

In the year 2147, an extreme cold storm sweeps across the Northern Hemisphere. Temperatures drop to a deadly −60∘C-60^\circ C−60∘C, and civilization is buried beneath ice and snow. In the forgotten frontier town of Gospel Snowtown, eight survivors must endure the endless winter with limited firewood, food, electricity, and medicine.

You are not an all-powerful god.
Instead, you act as an observer and assistant, helping the residents discuss, assign tasks, make decisions, and intervene at critical moments. Each resident has their own personality, condition, and judgment. They may accept your advice — or refuse it.

Your goal is simple:

Keep all eight residents alive.

Features

🧠 AI-Driven Survivors

Eight residents have different personalities, roles, and decision-making styles. They act, talk, argue, and vote based on resources, weather, physical condition, and relationships.

  • Old Qian: The mayor, leads meetings and prioritizes collective survival.

  • Auntie Li: The quartermaster, manages food distribution.

  • Zhao Tiezhu: The lumberjack, chops wood and maintains heat.

  • Wang Ce: The technician, repairs equipment and analyzes risks.

  • Su Yan: The medic, treats injuries and provides mental support.

  • Lu Chen: The gatherer, hardworking but impulsive.

  • Xinyue: The scout, skilled at exploring ruins and handling emergencies.

  • Qingxuan: The pharmacist apprentice, crafts first-aid kits and sets traps.

🔄 Loop-Based Survival

Death is not the end. After each failure, a new loop begins.

Residents inherit fragments of memory from previous lives, learn from their mistakes, and gradually improve their task assignments and survival strategies. As the loops progress, Sanity and affinity bonuses increase.

When all eight residents survive the winter, the perfect ending is unlocked.

📦 Resource Management

Manage the key resources needed to keep the town alive:

  • 🪵 Firewood: Keeps the furnace burning and prevents hypothermia.

  • 🍖 Food: Obtained through fishing, scavenging ruins, and traps.

  • ⚡ Electricity: Powers lights, generators, and medical equipment.

  • 🏥 First-Aid Kits: Treat injuries and save lives in critical moments.

  • 🔥 Furnace: The town’s lifeline. If the fire goes out, everyone is in danger.

Poor resource management can lead to death.

🗳️ Camp Meetings and Voting

You can pause the game to call a camp meeting.

Residents discuss key issues based on their personalities and current situation, such as whether to search outside, how to distribute food, who should rest, or whether to repair equipment.

In the end, they vote on the action plan.
You can influence them, but you cannot fully control them.

🧭 Command and Observation

You can give orders or suggestions, such as assigning someone to chop wood, fish, scout, rest, or receive treatment.

However, residents decide whether to accept based on their condition, personality, and risk assessment. You can also follow individual residents and observe their actions and status changes.

❤️ Character Status System

Each resident has several survival attributes:

  • 🧠 Sanity: Affects mental stability.

  • 💪 Stamina: Consumed by work and outdoor activity.

  • ❤️ Health: Reduced by injury, frostbite, and hunger.

  • 🌡️ Body Temperature: If it drops too low, hypothermia or death may occur.

  • 😊 Affinity: Affects cooperation and attitudes during meetings.

🌦️ Dynamic Weather and Day-Night Cycle

Weather changes between clear skies, light snow, heavy snow, blizzards, and thick fog. Different weather conditions affect outdoor risk, resource gathering, and body temperature loss.

Daytime is best for work and exploration.
Night is for rest, warmth, and recovery.

⚔️ Difficulty Options

The game offers different difficulty levels.
Easy mode is suitable for learning the systems, while Extreme mode increases resource consumption, reduces starting supplies, lowers gathering efficiency, and makes the cold much more dangerous.

store_data.about_the_game:
Eastern Europe, 1999. Inside the fractured psyche of a teenager, a quiet war is being waged for control of his future. The world he inhabits is a fading, black-and-white landscape that barely holds its own weight, torn apart by two conflicting inner voices.

The Director: Cold, precise, and unyielding, this voice demands perfect posture, suppressed emotions, and absolute efficiency. She is a driving force to become something clean, predictable, and functional.
The TV-Headed: A surreal entity that flickers in the corners of dusty mirrors and the white noise of an old monitor, mocking the Director's rules with ironic laughter.


You are stepping directly into the ruins of this psychological crossfire, guided only by a battered notebook the boy left behind.

The Mask and the Cypher 
The environment around you is covered in strange, painted symbols and carvings that look like meaningless noise to the naked eye. However, by equipping a specialized mask, the world shifts into focus, revealing an invented alphabet hidden in plain sight. To progress deeper into the boy's forgotten trauma, you must locate hidden letter cubes scattered across the shifting environments, decode the cipher, and piece together the words that unlock the doors blocking your path.

"Maybe you can go where I no longer can." - From the final page of the notebook.

Reconstructing the Past

Every room you clear grants you another letter of the boy's custom alphabet, gradually unlocking the encrypted entries of his diary. Through these pages, you glimpse his isolating reality - the endless days spent in an empty apartment with nothing but a rattling refrigerator and the growing certainty that his mother is never coming home. As the boundaries between the Director's order and the TV-Headed's chaos begin to blur, you are left to discover whether you are merely uncovering the boy's tragic memories, or actively writing the final chapter of his story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter a dark fantasy RPG set in the year 127c, twelve years after the underworld tore open and unleashed Remus, a tyrant of shadow and flame. His demonic legions shattered kingdoms and brought the world to the edge of extinction until three heroes made their final stand.

Follow the legacy of Darren the archer, Sully the shieldbearer, and Eric, your father, a spell sword who gave his life to seal Remus beyond the veil. Their sacrifice bought the world twelve years of fragile peace. Now that seal is breaking.

As Eric’s heir, you step into a realm once again drowning in fire and corruption. Build your party, master turn based combat, and push back against the rising demonic horde. Explore ruined cities, haunted battlegrounds, and ancient sites tied to the Spirit Seal ritual.

Shape your hero through weapons, relics, and magical cores that define your combat style. Strengthen your allies, unlock new abilities, and face powerful enemies that demand strategy and precision.

The world is falling for a second time. Whether it rises again depends on how you carry the weight of your father’s sacrifice. You are the last hope standing between Remus and eternal darkness.

Experience a story driven, turn based RPG inspired by the classics. Build a party of distinct heroes, master strategic combat, and take on challenging encounters that reward planning and smart ability use.

Explore a world filled with towns, ruins, hidden quests, and memorable characters. Your choices shape relationships, unlock special scenes, and influence how the story unfolds.

Customize your team with weapons, armor and relics that open new builds and playstyles. Upgrade gear, craft rare items, and summon powerful spells to shift the momentum in battle.

Enjoy cinematic cutscenes, dramatic encounters that elevates every moment. Optional superbosses and end game challenges ensure there is always something to strive for.
