store_data.about_the_game:
Requires internet connection (for DeepSeek API calls)

Users need to obtain and configure their own DeepSeek API Key

GAL-Chat is not a traditional visual novel, but a living, growing AI interactive storytelling world.

There are no pre-written dialogue trees, no "A/B/C" options. On your desktop, you will engage in real-time voice or text conversations with AI characters who possess their own personalities and memories.

Core Features

True AI-Driven Dialogue

Powered by the DeepSeek API's advanced natural language capabilities, characters no longer repeat pre-written lines. You are free to type anything - from casual small talk to profound questions - and the character will respond with unique, emotionally rich replies based on its personality, memories, and current scene.

Immersive Visual Novel Experience

Dynamic character sprites with expression changes: Character sprites change their emotions based on the conversation.

Scene switching: A right-side drawer-style background list lets you change the scene at any time to match your story's atmosphere.

Visual novel-style text box: Classic line-by-line display and auto-read mode preserve the authentic Galgame interaction feel.

Long-Term Memory System

The game features a structured memory system. The AI not only remembers your conversation from five minutes ago but also stores key events, relationship changes, and your personal preferences over the long term. This means every word you say truly shapes this relationship.

Multi-Character Ensemble and Interaction

Left-side drawer-style character list: Load multiple characters simultaneously and switch who you are talking to at any time.

Character-to-character interaction: AI characters can talk to, argue with, or cooperate with each other. You become the witness or director of this ensemble drama.

Deep Customization System

Character setting editing: Freely modify a character's personality, backstory, and speaking style in the settings interface.

User setting editing: Define your own identity and experiences so AI characters interact with you in a more fitting way.

History and memory review: Access the complete conversation history at any time, along with automatically generated memory summaries, giving you a clear picture of the story you are building together.

For players who:

Enjoy Galgames / visual novels but are tired of fixed options and repetitive content.

Want to experience true AI companion-style storytelling and seek unique conversations every time.

Desire multi-character interactions and want to build their own AI ensemble drama.

GAL-Chat has no ending - because your story with her will never see its final chapter.

Controls

Type text and press Enter to send

Toggle fullscreen with F11 or right-click menu

Switch characters by selecting character card folders on the home screen

Add characters by hovering over the left-side drawer-style character list

Switch backgrounds by hovering over the right-side drawer-style background list

BGM player is accessed by hovering over the top drawer-style player

View history via the right-click menu

Apply settings via the right-click menu (configure API Key)

Enable the character's proactive dialogue feature in the settings interface at the bottom of the settings panel, set the interval time. Triggered after the user initiates a conversation

Adjust volume using the mouse wheel while hovering over the center of the window (hold Ctrl + scroll wheel to zoom up to 500%)

【Game Overview】

鐵血霸業傳奇 is a Three Kingdoms-themed legendary role-playing game. You begin as an unknown warrior and explore war-torn lands, challenge monsters and bosses, collect equipment and materials, and grow stronger through character progression, equipment upgrades, and warrior development.

【World Background】

In the final years of the Eastern Han dynasty, the empire falls into chaos as warlords rise across the land. As battles spread through the realm, you will rise from an ordinary fighter into a powerful leader, fighting through different battlefields and factions to build your own empire.

Explore maps inspired by the Three Kingdoms era and challenge monsters, bosses, and higher-level battle areas.

Gain equipment, materials, and progression resources through combat, exploration, and boss challenges.

Upgrade equipment, forge powerful weapons, and steadily improve your combat strength.

Recruit and develop warriors, build different progression paths, and prepare for harder challenges.

Take part in faction, siege, and guild-related content as you pursue long-term growth and greater goals.

Equipment is a key part of character growth. Players can obtain gear through combat and exploration, then improve it through enhancement, upgrading, and forging. As your strength increases, you will unlock more challenging maps, bosses, and gameplay content.

【Long-Term Content】

The game will continue to expand around dungeon challenges, boss battles, equipment progression, warrior development, faction gameplay, and siege content. We will continue improving combat, progression, and long-term goals based on version updates and player feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game where you drop fruits with a crane, merge matching Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit merging arcade game where you control a crane, drop fruits into a parfait cup, and aim for the highest score through efficient merges.

The goal is not simply to build a tall tower. Your objective is to combine fruits through 11 stages, create larger fruits, trigger explosive chain reactions, and push your score as high as possible before the parfait collapses.

Each fruit drop changes the entire situation. Fruits roll, slide, collide, bounce, and settle through physics. A careful drop can create a stable setup, while one unexpected movement can trigger a massive merge chain.

Merge two matching fruits to create the next fruit stage and earn points. The higher the fruit stage, the greater the reward. Plan your drops, manage the limited space, and look for opportunities to set up satisfying chain reactions.

Key Features

11-Stage Fruit Merging

Combine matching fruits through 11 fruit stages and aim for higher-scoring merges.

Explosive Chain Reactions

One good drop can trigger a burst of consecutive merges, creating the most satisfying moments in the game.

Score Attack Gameplay

The main goal is to earn the highest score possible through efficient placement, smart timing, and lucky physics.

Crane-Based Controls

Move the crane, choose your drop position, and release each fruit at the right moment.

Signalman Shake

Use the Signalman role to shake the fruits and create unexpected movement. A well-timed shake can rescue a bad situation, disturb the stack, or help trigger a powerful chain reaction.

Physics-Based Uncertainty

Fruits do not always behave exactly as planned. They roll, collide, settle, and sometimes betray your expectations.

Cute but Dangerous

The game looks sweet, but one unstable drop or one risky shake can turn your parfait into a collapsing mess.

Steam Leaderboards

Compete for high scores and see how your best run compares with other players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Overview
PegPigeon is a casual physics peg game built for short sessions: you launch balls through a colorful peg board, rack up score on impacts, and settle into bottom slots for big payoffs. Between rounds you draft upgrades and relics to shape each run, while hub progression unlocks new stages, pigeons, skins, and long‑term meta upgrades.

Worldbuilding
A light, cartoon‑fiction setting—no historical tie‑ins. Pigeons are the playful mascots of a “peg arena”: bright boards, bouncy walls, and trick slots that change mood from stage to stage (meadow, barn, snowfield, and more). Tone is relaxed, family‑friendly, and built for quick fun rather than story cutscenes.

Core Gameplay
Each round gives you a limited number of launches. Aim and fire; the ball cascades through pegs, triggers special peg rules, and finally drops into a slot lane where multipliers and scoring rules apply. When the round resolves, you open the in‑run shop, pick one of several random offers (an upgrade or a relic), and push deeper into the run. Clear the stage’s round target to finish a session and move on to settlement, gold, and unlock checks.

Features

  • Multi‑stage boards with different layouts and gimmicks per stage.

  • In‑run shop: random draft cards; rerolls tied to meta progression.

  • Relics (Jokers) with passive or trigger effects; slot count can grow via meta.

  • Meta upgrades (balls per round, salvo cap, end‑run gold, shop rerolls, wall score, slot multipliers, and more).

  • Gold economy from runs and achievements; spend on meta upgrades and pigeon skins.

  • Achievements with manual claim rewards.

  • Per‑stage leaderboard snapshots for bragging rights against your own bests.

  • Settings for audio (and related comfort options as shipped).

How to Play

  • From the hub, pick an unlocked stage and tap Start.

  • During a round, aim and launch the ball; try to chain peg hits and steer toward high‑value slots.

  • When the shop appears, tap one card to add that upgrade or relic to your run; use Refresh if you still have rerolls.

  • Repeat rounds until you hit the stage’s configured limit or fail state—then review score and gold, return to hub, and spend gold on meta upgrades, pigeons/skins, or chase achievements.

  • Use Pause for a breather and Settings to tune sound to taste.

Each round gives you a limited number of launches. Aim and fire; the ball cascades through pegs, triggers special peg rules, and finally drops into a slot lane where multipliers and scoring rules apply. When the round resolves, you open the in‑run shop, pick one of several random offers (an upgrade or a relic), and push deeper into the run. Clear the stage’s round target to finish a session and move on to settlement, gold, and unlock checks.

Features

  • Multi‑stage boards with different layouts and gimmicks per stage.

  • In‑run shop: random draft cards; rerolls tied to meta progression.

  • Relics (Jokers) with passive or trigger effects; slot count can grow via meta.

  • Meta upgrades (balls per round, salvo cap, end‑run gold, shop rerolls, wall score, slot multipliers, and more).

  • Gold economy from runs and achievements; spend on meta upgrades and pigeon skins.

  • Achievements with manual claim rewards.

  • Per‑stage leaderboard snapshots for bragging rights against your own bests.

  • Settings for audio (and related comfort options as shipped).

How to Play

  • From the hub, pick an unlocked stage and tap Start.

  • During a round, aim and launch the ball; try to chain peg hits and steer toward high‑value slots.

  • When the shop appears, tap one card to add that upgrade or relic to your run; use Refresh if you still have rerolls.

  • Repeat rounds until you hit the stage’s configured limit or fail state—then review score and gold, return to hub, and spend gold on meta upgrades, pigeons/skins, or chase achievements.

  • Use Pause for a breather and Settings to tune sound to taste.
store_data.short_description: PegPigeon: casual physics peg action—launch through bright boards, chain hits, settle in slots. Limited shots; between rounds draft one upgrade or relic. Varied stages; gold funds meta upgrades, pigeons, skins; achievements and per‑stage bests add goals. Cute, snack‑sized, easy to replay.

To the Test Subject:

Thank you for passing initial screening. Please read the following test briefing.

【What You Will Face】

• Deduction Challenge: 7 patients, 1 doppelganger — find out who is no longer themselves

• Atmospheric Horror: Eerie environments, bizarre reality

• Moral Choice: Eliminate the doppelganger, or mistakenly kill an innocent patient?

【Test Purpose】

Providence Special Care Facility is dedicated to providing professional care

services for special patients. To ensure care safety, the Facility needs to

regularly replenish frontline nursing staff with crisis management capabilities.

We are now conducting an onboarding test program to screen individuals possessing

the following qualities:

• Ability to maintain rational judgment under extreme stress

• Acuity in promptly detecting patient identity anomalies

• Psychological fortitude to decisively execute safety measures

【Test Scenario】

You will enter our closed care facility, which houses seven special patients.

Among them is one doppelganger. The doppelganger is a dangerous invasive entity

with mimicry capabilities, able to perfectly replicate the appearance, memory,

and behavioral patterns of the replaced individual.

The Danger of the Doppelganger:

• The doppelganger will continuously replace real patients, causing the original

patients to disappear permanently

• If not eliminated promptly, the doppelganger will replace more patients and

eventually seize control of the entire facility

• The existence of the doppelganger poses a serious threat to all patients and

nursing staff

Your mission: Using the single issued bullet, identify the doppelganger and

eliminate them, thereby protecting the safety of the remaining patients.

【Test Procedure】

Phase 1: Information Gathering

Enter each care room, converse with patients, investigate room items, and collect

clues regarding the doppelganger's identity. Note: Some care rooms have special

entry conditions requiring specific items to be obtained first.

Phase 2: Deductive Analysis

Compare patient testimonies, observe environmental change signs, and verify

item reactions. Consolidate all information to identify the room where the

doppelganger is hiding.

Phase 3: Elimination Execution

Proceed to Care Room 2 to retrieve your issued weapon. After loading the bullet,

enter the room you have identified and execute elimination on the target.

【Test Rules】

• You are issued only one bullet. Accidental termination of a real patient

constitutes test failure.

• Failure to complete elimination within the designated time constitutes test

abandonment.

• The doppelganger may mimic any patient, or even room items themselves.

• Some care rooms have special rules; violations will result in immediate test

termination.

【Test Description】

• This test involves special medical cases and high-stress simulations

• Environmental changes may occur during testing: lighting abnormalities,

whispering sounds, temperature fluctuations

• Some patients possess special properties; please maintain rationality

• If you experience severe psychological discomfort, you may terminate the

test at any time

【Special Notice】

The Company assumes no liability for any consequences resulting from test failure.

Any physiological or psychological injuries sustained during the test period

are considered risks you voluntarily assume.

For those who pass the test, the Company will fulfill the commitments outlined in

the "Onboarding Test Employment Agreement."

We look forward to working with you.

Providence Special Care Facility

Human Resources Department · Personnel Screening Unit

store_data.about_the_game:
Pour Decisions is a physics-based café management game where every mistake impacts your bottom line.

Balance the precision of drink-crafting with the logistics of running a business under pressure. As you grow, you will face direct competition from BeanBucks, a corporate mega-chain aggressive enough to undercut your prices and muscle into your locations. Serve quality drinks, maintain your efficiency, and drive the corporate competition out of town.

Precision Physics

Drag cups under dispensers and pour to order. Real-time physics mean that clumsy movements lead to spills and wasted inventory. Keep the queue moving without sacrificing accuracy, as slow service and poor builds will damage your rating.

Reputation and Revenue

Your reputation directly dictates customer flow and pricing power. High ratings bring a steady stream of high-paying customers, while a dropping score will empty your shop. If the revenue stops, the business goes under.

Upgrades and Automation

Between rushes, reinvest your profits into the business. Buy and place new equipment and upgrades, expand your menu offerings, and hire staff to handle daily tasks so you can focus on expansion.

District-by-District Competition

Expand across town by securing new storefronts. BeanBucks operates on the same map, actively competing for the same real estate. Out-perform them in each neighbourhood to reclaim the city\'s coffee culture one location at a time.

Key Features

  • Physics-Based Crafting: Master fluid dynamics and cup mechanics where spills directly reduce your daily profit.

  • Reputation Economy: A dynamic star system that scales your customer volume and pricing limits.

  • Corporate Rivalry: A persistent competitor that challenges you for specific storefronts across the city map.

  • Café Management: Complete control over layout design, equipment purchasing, and staff hiring.

  • Campaign Progression: A multi-location structure focused on expanding your footprint and retiring the competition.

  • Endless Mode: Test your efficiency in a sandbox environment designed to push your workflow and management skills to the limit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Title: Cold Spring – Liminal Space

Tagline:
A procedurally generated 2D psychological horror survival game.

Short Description:
You are an ordinary urban woman. One night, deep in your apartment building, you fall into an endless, looping liminal space. No weapons. No allies. Only ever-rearranging corridors, lurking entities, and the ice axe in your hand.

Core Gameplay

  • Procedurally Generated Maps
    Every run restructures the apartment floor plan. No two explorations are the same.

  • Environmental Alteration – Carve Your Own Path
    Use your ice axe to break through walls, turning dead ends into new passages. Real‑time terrain destruction updates both the game world and your minimap.

  • Audio‑Driven Threat Detection
    Rely on footstep cues (distance attenuation) to locate invisible entities in the dark. Decide whether to hide or flee based on what you hear.

  • Sanity Management
    Sanity constantly depletes due to terrifying events and darkness. Restore it slowly with light sources such as a flashlight. If sanity hits zero, you begin to deteriorate – your health will steadily drop until death.

  • Health Recovery – Homecoming Is the Only Anchor
    No health pickups exist inside the liminal space. The only way to heal is to escape back to your real‑world apartment. Returning home offers slow, passive health regeneration.

  • Branching Narrative & Replayability
    Key obstacles offer multiple solutions (e.g., opening a metal door in different ways). Your choices affect the distribution of anomalies and exploration routes, encouraging multiple playthroughs.

Story & World

A mysterious “404 Forum” appears on your apartment computer. Inside, other people trapped in the same loop leave fragmented posts and hidden clues. Read their accounts, observe environmental details, and piece together the truth behind the liminal space.

Source of Horror
Psychological terror rooted in the abnormality of everyday objects. No gore, no jump scares.

Content Notes

  • Length
    Full game includes 6–8 main chapters. Main story: 3–5 hours. Complete exploration and replays: 8+ hours. Each new run generates a different spatial layout and anomaly distribution.

  • Player Mode
    Single‑player only. No multiplayer planned.

Full Story Blurb

An ordinary urban routine – shattered the moment you push open your own apartment door.

You are just a worn‑out city worker. Walking out of your apartment corridor late at night, you unexpectedly fall into an infinite, looping liminal space. The familiar residential hallway becomes a bizarre, ever‑rearranging maze. Every time you go up or down a floor, the spatial layout changes. Paths you just walked become alien and sinister moments later.

In this space soaked with an eerie substance, nameless entities wander. Silent phantoms drift.

The mysterious 404 Forum that appears on your apartment computer holds broken records and obscure clues left by others trapped like you – along with the truth of what it means to sink and be lost.

Are you trapped in the corridor… or has the liminal space already swallowed you forever?

Summer in Xichuan is always hot and humid.

Liu Lan and Chen Sijia are two high school students who often run into each other at illegal internet cafés late at night.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game


Velvet Emergency is a tense, choice-driven visual novel set during one disastrous night inside an elite riverfront restaurant.

You play as Lera, a waitress working a closed political dinner at Velvet. The guests are powerful, the phones are confiscated, the cameras are off, and private security has locked the room while a hidden USB recording becomes the center of a scandal.

Then the service phone vibrates.

An upstream dam has failed. A surge wave and chemical plume are moving toward the district. The people in the dining room cannot leave, and the people who can open the doors care more about the scandal than the water outside.

Choose Under Pressure


Every decision changes the room. Warn the kitchen quietly, tell the guests directly, find the journalist posing as a sommelier, or keep the lie alive long enough to buy time.

Your choices affect panic, trust, supplies, evidence, leverage, and the minutes left before impact.

What Will You Carry?


The kitchen becomes a survival pantry. You cannot take everything.

Will you carry water, medicine, radios, keys, an axe, blankets, or evidence that could bring powerful people down?

A Disaster Movie In One Room


Velvet Emergency focuses on the human pressure of a catastrophe contained inside a beautiful place: red emergency lights on crystal, a phone drawer full of desperate calls, a service corridor standoff, a triage table, a wine cellar shelter, a rooftop rescue, and a black wave rising behind panoramic glass.

Features


  • A compact cinematic visual novel built in Ren'Py.
  • A chamber disaster-thriller premise set entirely around one luxury restaurant.
  • Visible pressure stats: time, panic, staff trust, guest trust, supplies, evidence, and leverage.
  • Moral choices about truth, lies, class, power, and who gets saved first.
  • Multiple routes: rooftop evacuation, wine cellar shelter, dining room barricade, staff exit, political bargain, truth release, and failure.
  • 15 hand-curated 1920x1080 visual scenes.

Content Note


Velvet Emergency contains disaster themes, political coercion, life-or-death choices, panic, and references to injury. It does not contain graphic gore.

store_data.about_the_game:
RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship. Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself! In the end, having fun is all that matters.

It all starts when a mysterious entity attacks the ship, leaving MAIhelp, the onboard AI, without control over the rooms and data. Progress through the story by repairing each room and help the friendly robot Roberto and the clumsy alien Julien uncover the secrets behind this attack, all while enjoying the situation with plenty of humor and top-quality jokes (well, most of the time...).

Master every room’s challenges

Repair everything needed to regain control and safety of the room, from Room Controllers (RC) to broken pipes. Use each character's unique skills to grow fruits faster with Julien or craft gears more quickly with Roberto, or just use whoever is closest, the important thing is using these items to repair the RC and finish the level as fast as possible to earn those 3 stars and make MAIhelp proud.

Face the chaos with a friend

Team up with your best partner to go crazy together in space. Perform tasks simultaneously and sync your thoughts to make the most of the swap mechanic, whether for movement, efficiency, or just because you felt like controlling the other character. Warning: we are not responsible for lost friendships, heated arguments, or physical kicks.

Enjoy your own company in space

Whether you like playing solo or simply don't have any friends, don't worry: RePair in the Space was designed with you in mind too. Tackle every level alone, planning the exact moment to swap characters and keep efficiency at its peak. Warning: In this mode, you don't have a friend to blame, so every mistake is on you! (Or you’ll just end up blaming the game).

Breathe, focus, and have fun

From hitting the buttons in the right order on the RC to making sure the fruit doesn't burn in the refinery, the secret is calm and strategy, or just getting stressed and trying all over again until you get that third star or challenge you want so badly. RePair in the Space is also about choosing your own journey: grabbing every star, collectible, and challenge, or simply enjoying the levels and the story. The most important thing is to create moments of fun.

Rebel Wraith is a fast-paced action game where you can instantly switch between three different characters. Each character has their own abilities, weaknesses, and parkour mechanics. Switch between characters based on the flow of combat, create short strategies, and use your reflexes to defeat your enemies.

It’s “Time To Love.” Time is fracturing and the very integrity of the multiverse is in peril. Play as Orange and Purple, two temporal wanderers exploring the fracturing strands of time.

Time to love is a co-op rogue-light experience spanning across three distinct timelines featuring over thirty unique power ups, remnants of leftover time, six different unlockable weapon options, and a unique tether mechanic to help you navigate the multiverse with your other half.

Find remnants of knowledge scattered throughout time to piece together how this calamitous event happened...and how it can be fixed.

Fight liches and Slimes, spellcasters and archers throughout the Medieval timeline. Learn various branches of magic, and BURN your enemies to death before they can stop you.

Traverse the wild, wild canyons of the Western Timeline, dodging bullets and sniping scorpions, seeking the bandit leader stopping you from saving this timeline.

Sneak through the abandoned factories of the sci-fi timeline, slipping into cyberspace to avoid the patrolling robots. Battle your way to the center of this time branch, finding a decision that may have caused everything to unravel in the first place

Start each run with limited time, break rocks, collect XP, gold, resources and rare shards, then return to your base camp to grow stronger. Upgrade your skills, buy new pickaxes, activate powerful artifacts and prepare for the next descent.

Each zone introduces new rocks, new resources and new challenges. The deeper you dig, the stronger your tools become, the more your progression expands — and the closer you get to the mysterious core.

Features:

• Run-based mining gameplay with permanent progression

• 33 unlockable zones

• A skill tree with many upgrades and specializations

• Artifacts with powerful passive effects

• Unlockable and upgradeable pickaxes

• Resource trading, backpack items and mystical conversion

• Quests, archive systems and many Steam achievements

• Support for 13 languages

Dig into the Core combines clicker, idle and incremental mechanics with a clear mining focus. Every run takes you further. Every rock matters. And somewhere deep below the surface, the core is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Who said turtles are slow?
You are that turtle. You have a skateboard — and it’s your main tool. But you can’t jump, there’s no magic here, and the path ahead is full of danger. Your goal is to get as high as possible while exploring this treacherous vertical world.

The world of this game is a constant climb upward, where gravity is your harshest judge. No quick jumps, no teleports — just an old skateboard and your shell, which constantly pulls you back down to earth.

Main objective:
Keep climbing upward. It doesn’t matter how many times you fall — what matters is that you keep going to reach greater heights.

Game features:

  • Explore a dangerous vertical world — gravity is your strictest judge.

  • Interact with objects — explosive crates, spinning logs, and moving platforms help you ascend higher.

  • Various obstacles — steep slopes, pits, and rotating mechanisms require agility and patience.

  • Falling  — you fall, but you still continue your journey upward.

  • Skill and reaction — quick decisions and precise movements are key to success.

  • Use your environment — objects, mechanisms, and clever tricks let you create your own routes.

  • Forge your own path — discover new ways to overcome obstacles and improve your skills.

  • Never give up — even if you fall, always keep moving and strive to go higher!

store_data.about_the_game:
REDLINE is a sci-fi romance visual novel set in a near-future coastal city in southern Japan where gifted individuals can perceive, interpret, and influence human emotions — abilities now at the center of scientific research and corporate ambition.

You play as a university student with the rare ability to perceive emotional connections as red threads. As you become entangled in a secretive research program and drawn toward five distinct love interests, your choices will shape not only your relationships, but the fate of society itself.

Souta Aihara

CA: Kieran Regan

Souta used to look out for you long before either of you knew where life would lead. After years spent apart, that hasn’t really changed. He has always been a constant in your life, even when distance turned him into an edge case and timing pushed him out of context. Now that the parameters have changed, you’re stepping into the next chapter together. Almost like before…

Rei Minzuki

CA: Corey Wilder

As a martial arts ace with a laid-back demeanor, Rei has earned his place as Redhaven University’s campus favorite without ever appearing to try. Considering how little effort he seems to invest in his studies, one can’t help but wonder how he ended up at RHU at all. Then again, it hardly matters.

Leiv Kazama

CA: Jimmie Yamaguchi

Whether in academic circles or within the boardrooms of the country’s leading tech corporations, the name Leiv Kazama is hard to overlook. At twenty-seven, he stands at the intersection of research, power, and responsibility. A junior professor by title, a CEO by profession, and a man whose decisions tend to shape more than just his own future.

Takuma Shinonome

CA: Brian Timothy Anderson

Fresh out of medical school yet already deeply embedded in the research halls of SYNEVIS, Takuma is far more at home in the quiet solitude of his laboratory than in crowded rooms. Between the infimum and supremum of light, human emotion registers as chromatic outliers — patterns he can observe with precision, though not always interpret.

Aziel Viré

CA: John Patneaude

Following in the footsteps of his uncle who once led SYNEVIS, Aziel now stands at the helm of the institute’s future. Where his predecessor earned loyalty through trust, Aziel, it seems, prefers something more reliable. After all, when you understand the thread that moves a heart, guiding it becomes almost effortless.

Planned for the full release:

  • Five routes with 9 endings in total

  • Additional CG illustrations, backgrounds, and original music

  • Character editor with selectable skin tones and hair colors

  • Integrated mini-game

  • In-game chat system

  • Character diaries and unlockable insights for each love interest

  • CG Gallery and wiki

  • Sprite variations (outfits, poses and expressions)

  • Voice acting

Note:

The full scope of REDLINE, including voice acting, additional features and content such as backgrounds and music, as well as further possibilities like an animated opening and localization, will depend on the success of a Kickstarter campaign following the demo release.

REDLINE is developed by a small independent team based in Germany, led by Marleen gollan (Moteru Games). Character art, additional game design input, and voice direction are created and provided by Moona and Amalia, forming the core team. The project is further supported by contributors across background art, music, and voice acting.

store_data.about_the_game:
A small planet of your own, floating in space. SpaceCasino is a simulation game where you earn funds (chips) at the casino to purchase a variety of buildings, decorating the surface of your planet with colorful neon lights.

Decorate Your Own Planet By selecting "Land on the Planet" from the main menu, you will travel to your base spherical planet. The "Store" on the left side of the screen offers a variety of buildings that you can purchase with your chips. You can select the items you've acquired from "Building Objects" at the bottom of the screen and freely place them anywhere on the planet. You can also switch to an overhead camera view to admire your entire planet as it develops to your liking.

Casino Games in a Dedicated Area The chips needed for building are earned in a dedicated area separate from your planet. Click the "Go to the casino" button in the upper right corner of the planet screen to travel to the casino and play the following 5 types of games:

  • Poker

  • Baccarat

  • Blackjack

  • Slots

  • Roulette

A Reliable Way to Earn Chips Even if you lose your chips at the casino, you can use the "Work Room" feature on the right side of the screen to reliably earn a small amount of chips. You can always recover and resume your activities in the game at any time.

*Disclaimer (Please Read) This title is a casino-themed simulation game and contains absolutely no real-money gambling elements. The chips earned and used in the game are a fictional currency valid only within the game; it is impossible to wager real money or exchange them for cash, cryptocurrency, or any other real-world value.

Decorate Your Own Planet By selecting "Land on the Planet" from the main menu, you will travel to your base spherical planet. The "Store" on the left side of the screen offers a variety of buildings that you can purchase with your chips. You can select the items you've acquired from "Building Objects" at the bottom of the screen and freely place them anywhere on the planet. You can also switch to an overhead camera view to admire your entire planet as it develops to your liking.

Casino Games in a Dedicated Area The chips needed for building are earned in a dedicated area separate from your planet. Click the "Go to the casino" button in the upper right corner of the planet screen to travel to the casino and play the following 5 types of games:

  • Poker

  • Baccarat

  • Blackjack

  • Slots

  • Roulette

A Reliable Way to Earn Chips Even if you lose your chips at the casino, you can use the "Work Room" feature on the right side of the screen to reliably earn a small amount of chips. You can always recover and resume your activities in the game at any time.

*Disclaimer (Please Read) This title is a casino-themed simulation game and contains absolutely no real-money gambling elements. The chips earned and used in the game are a fictional currency valid only within the game; it is impossible to wager real money or exchange them for cash, cryptocurrency, or any other real-world value.
store_data.short_description: SpaceCasino is a simulation game where you freely customize your very own spherical planet. Earn chips at an authentic casino located in a dedicated area, purchase neon-lit buildings, and decorate your empty planet into a space of your own.
store_data.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean

store_data.about_the_game:
🎮 Multi Brick Breaker: The Breakout Challenge You Can't Resist!

Can you outplay your opponent? In Multi Brick Breaker, you’re not alone—face off against opponent in a frantic race to destroy all the bricks before they do! Pamboo, the hungry panda, is counting on you to clear all the bamboo with your ball and paddle. But beware—your opponent has the same goal… and they won’t go easy on you!

🔥 A Classic Game with a Modern Twist
Inspired by legendary brick-breaking games, Multi Brick Breaker delivers an ultra-dynamic and competitive experience. Each level is a challenge: use your paddle to bounce the ball, smash every brick, and stop your opponent from winning first.

✨ Features That Make Every Match Unique:

  • PVE Mode: Battle an AI opponent in intense head-to-head matches.

  • Challenging and Varied Levels: Tougher challenges await, with new levels coming soon!

  • Powerful Power-Ups: Multi-ball, smoke, freeze, giant ball, fireball—use them to your advantage and dominate the game!

  • Star Rating System: Easy to pick up, hard to master. Can you earn 3 stars on every level?

  • Vibrant and Smooth Graphics: A modern art style for an immersive gaming experience.

🎯 Ready to Take on the Challenge?
Whether you’re a fan of classic brick-breakers or looking for a fast, fun, and competitive experience, Multi Brick Breaker is the game for you. Will it bring you hours of joy… or frustration as you face relentless opponents?

📢 Coming Soon:
New features, additional levels, and even more power-ups to spice up your matches!

Join the community now and prove you’re the best!

store_data.about_the_game:
Aislebound is a first-person retail simulator that puts you at the forefront of all aspects of managing a retail store. Start with a small shop in your neighborhood plaza and grow into a massive mega-store!

Own Your Store!

You get to decide how your products are merchandised. With custom modular shelving, put your products on display any way you'd like!

Own Your Backroom!

Manage deliveries, and utilize multiple different tools to quickly and efficiently get your products to the shelves!

Own Your Customer Experience!

From the moment a customer enters your store, everything affects their experience. The easier it is to find like products, and the better the prices are, the more popular your store will get!

Own Your Pricing

Set prices to whatever you'd like! Higher prices may bring in more money, but less customer interest. Lower prices may bring in lots of customers, but you may not make enough profit. Experiment with what prices give the best results!

Own Your Brand!

Customize your store's brand to make it yours! Give it any name, logo, and appearance you'd like!

store_data.about_the_game:
“It's Hunting Time” is a first-person shooter with stylized graphics that blend 2D and 3D elements. You play as a hunter named Jonathan, who decided to make some good money during hunting season by taking on a difficult job from a mysterious merchant named Yuri, though everyone calls him Yurets.

You’ll travel through the mysterious lands of the Sankolandia Empire in search of your mission’s objective — the heart of a stone golem. On your path to riches, you’ll be hindered by the so-called Brales — remnants of biological weapons the empire used during its expansion. They aren’t particularly smart, but in a crowd they can be very dangerous.

Good luck on your adventure, and try not to disappoint Yurets. He has plenty more tasks in store for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
---Story---

A strange person has been born... a person with no biological sex, no defining traits, and a face made of smoke. This person was named Eve.

Eve was the first, but they were not the last. Shortly after their birth, more started to appear. Identical, hollow, and void of self. It was as if humanity had entered a state of mass production, churning out shells of people without identity.

As these faceless beings multiplied, the essence of what it meant to be human began to dissolve. One by one, the unique traits of mankind were replaced by a cold, uniform void. The cycle continued until the human race became extinct.

Now, in the silence of a lost world, the journey begins to discover if anything remains of the self, or if we have truly become none.

This is a game that explores the themes of identity loss and homogenization from a philosophical perspective, examining how they affect individuals as we cast aside our unique traits to become part of a social machine.

The story can be experienced at your own pace through collectible memories that may be viewed at any time, allowing the narrative to unfold without interrupting gameplay.

---Gameplay---

Master a turn-based system where every decision carries weight. Becoming None offers multiple layers of tactical depth:

-Dynamic Class System: Build your ideal party by transferring active and passive skills between party members. Experiment with unique synergies, but choose carefully. Active and passive skills are a limited resource.

-Meaningful Gear: Equipment is about more than just raising stats. Trade raw attributes for powerful, game-changing effects.

-The Flow of Battle: Exploit elemental weaknesses to earn TP, which can be spent on Instant Abilities that don’t consume a turn. Combined with instant mid-battle party swapping, this makes for a highly dynamic combat system.

-Critical Everything: Why should only attacks have all the fun? Every action in the game, from healing to buffs and status effects, can trigger a Critical Effect.

Whether you are a genre veteran or a newcomer, the experience adapts to you:

-Random Party Mode: For the ultimate strategic test, take on the game with a completely randomized team and prove your mastery of the system.

-Accessible Difficulty: Choose the challenge that fits your pace, from story-focused settings to hardcore modes designed to push your strategies to the limit.

---Collectables---

Becoming None is as much a collectathon as it is an RPG. Every corner of the world holds something to discover:

-Story through Memories: Find every memory and piece together the narrative. The story itself is a puzzle: you can arrange the events chronologically based on what you’ve learned to unlock even more content.

-The Completionist’s Fantasy: Find everything in a dungeon to earn instant level-ups and the most overpowered abilities in the game.

-Environmental Cues: If something feels suspicious or out of place, there’s probably a secret nearby. Explore carefully to uncover hidden paths, secrets, and valuable treasures.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run, jump, dodge, and collect your way through a chaotic parody of modern America in Go Trump GO! A fast-paced arcade runner where every run becomes more absurd than the last.

Collect powerful upgrades, avoid devastating curses, and survive long enough to bank your winnings before the chasing mob catches up. Procedurally generated runs, risky power-ups, and ‘Press Your Luck’ slot machines keep every attempt feeling fresh while satirical billboards, social posts, and over-the-top humor fuel the madness.

FEATURES
• Fast-paced arcade runner gameplay
• Roguelike progression and unlocks
• Risk vs reward banking mechanics
• ‘Press Your Luck’ slot machine events
• Powerful upgrades and brutal curses
• Procedurally generated runs
• Satirical social media and world design
• High score chasing and replayability

How long can you outrun accountability?

store_data.about_the_game:
TEXTORIO


You crash-land on Kepler-442b — a planet that wants you dead. 50,000 colonists sleep in cryo-pods deep below the
surface. Wake them, or die trying.

In Textorio, you build a factory in pure ASCII. Raw ore becomes circuits. Circuits become machines. Machines become a
self-sustaining production empire — and that empire is the only thing standing between humanity and extinction on an
alien world.

This is factory automation stripped to its bones. No textures. No 3D models. Just glyphs, logic, and consequences.

MINE. SMELT. AUTOMATE. SURVIVE.


Start with a single terminal and a busted escape pod. By hour four you'll have power grids, fluid networks, steam
pressure, and conveyors carrying ore from underground veins to refineries you designed yourself. By hour twelve you'll
be drilling through bedrock toward the colonists, fighting wildlife that evolves to counter your factory.

Every machine is rendered as an ASCII character. Every system is a real system — electricity flows along wires, fluids
flow through pipes, logic gates fire on signals. If you understand it, you can break it. If you can break it, you can
optimize it.

THE DESCENT


You don't conquer one biome. You conquer four, and each one is a different problem.

Surface — forests, river systems, ore veins, and hostile fauna that emerges at night. Your first factory is
built here, exposed to weather, predators, and the slow rotation of the day/night cycle.

Caves — pierced by your Tunnel Bore. Crystal seams in five color families. Geothermal vents. Glowcap mushrooms
that light their own caverns. The wildlife is older, larger, and lit by minerals you'll learn to harvest.

Deep Caves — magma-warm air that overheats your machinery until you research thermal management. Heavy metals
you can't find anywhere else. And the fossilized remnants of structures that weren't yours.

Core Chamber — the reactor. The reason for everything. Restart it and the colony lives. Fail and the cryo-pods
go cold one by one.

KEY FEATURES


  • Pure ASCII rendering — every machine, ore, conveyor, and creature is a glyph. Runs on anything. Reads like a
    system schematic.
  • Real engineering systems — electricity networks, fluid dynamics with real pressure, steam-driven
    contraptions, and hydraulic logic gates (AND/OR/NOT/XOR/DELAY/MEMORY). No abstractions. No magic.
  • Four interconnected world layers — Surface, Caves, Deep Caves, Core Chamber. Each has unique resources,
    threats, and engineering puzzles. A vertical lift system carries you and your goods between them.
  • Silicon-based hostile wildlife — biters feed on electromagnetic energy. They don't attack you — they're
    trying to eat your factory. Build walls and they evolve stronger. Use turrets and they swarm in larger packs. Static
    defense fails over time. Adaptation is the only strategy.
  • The Mote — your autonomous companion drone — an AI sidekick with three modes (FOLLOW, GUARD, SCOUT) and its
    own mood system. It repairs your machines, scouts ahead, defends your base, and reacts to how you play.
  • BASTION uplink — the ship's surviving AI narrates your descent in fragmented transmissions. You'll recover
    crew logs from the previous mission as you go deeper. The story they tell is not the one BASTION is telling you.
  • Self-designed factories — no preset blueprints, no templates, no auto-solver. The factory that saves 50,000
    lives is the one YOU figure out, from a blank Surface to the Core.
  • 1v1 LAN Factory Wars — host a match against a friend, build symmetric bases, train Raiders, and try to
    destroy the enemy's Cryo-Vault before they destroy yours. Currently in closed testing.
  • Your name in the manifest — beat the game and your username goes into the colony ship's permanent crew log.

THE WORLD


Kepler-442b orbits a K-type star 1,206 light years from Earth. The colony ship Wreckborn was supposed to land
it gently. It didn't. Your cryo-pod ejected. The rest are still down there.

You wake on a continent of black soil and pale grass, with a wrist terminal that still works, three days of rations,
and the silhouettes of broken alien architecture on the horizon. The wildlife is patient. The colonists' pods are
running out of power.

Somebody tried this before you. They left logs. They didn't leave bodies.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY


Textorio respects your intelligence. No tutorial popups holding your hand. No glowing arrows pointing at "the
next thing." A 30-second briefing on the controls, then you're alone with a wrist terminal and a planet. Read, decide,
build.

Every glyph is a real entity. No background art. No decorative tiles. If you can see it on the map, you can
interact with it — inspect it, build over it, route a belt past it, destroy it. The map is the world.

Every system simulates. Electricity actually flows along wires. Fluids actually have pressure. Steam condenses
back to water. Logic gates fire on real signal thresholds. The depth isn't decorative, it's structural. You can short
a circuit, deadlock a pipe, or design a memory cell.

ASCII isn't a limitation — it's a clarity tool. A 50,000-tile factory in ASCII reads at a glance the way a 3D
version never could. Bottlenecks jump out. Optimization opportunities reveal themselves. Your factory becomes legible
the same way a circuit diagram is.

ABOUT THE STUDIO


Textorio is built by one developer at Hyena Studios in Anykščiai, Lithuania. No publisher. No marketing budget.
No focus groups. Just code, ASCII, and obsession.

Your factory is your survival. Make it beautiful.

  • BASTION uplink — the ship's surviving AI narrates your descent in fragmented transmissions. You'll recover
    crew logs from the previous mission as you go deeper. The story they tell is not the one BASTION is telling you.
  • Self-designed factories — no preset blueprints, no templates, no auto-solver. The factory that saves 50,000
    lives is the one YOU figure out, from a blank Surface to the Core.
  • 1v1 LAN Factory Wars — host a match against a friend, build symmetric bases, train Raiders, and try to
    destroy the enemy's Cryo-Vault before they destroy yours. Currently in closed testing.
  • Your name in the manifest — beat the game and your username goes into the colony ship's permanent crew log.

THE WORLD


Kepler-442b orbits a K-type star 1,206 light years from Earth. The colony ship Wreckborn was supposed to land
it gently. It didn't. Your cryo-pod ejected. The rest are still down there.

You wake on a continent of black soil and pale grass, with a wrist terminal that still works, three days of rations,
and the silhouettes of broken alien architecture on the horizon. The wildlife is patient. The colonists' pods are
running out of power.

Somebody tried this before you. They left logs. They didn't leave bodies.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY


Textorio respects your intelligence. No tutorial popups holding your hand. No glowing arrows pointing at "the
next thing." A 30-second briefing on the controls, then you're alone with a wrist terminal and a planet. Read, decide,
build.

Every glyph is a real entity. No background art. No decorative tiles. If you can see it on the map, you can
interact with it — inspect it, build over it, route a belt past it, destroy it. The map is the world.

Every system simulates. Electricity actually flows along wires. Fluids actually have pressure. Steam condenses
back to water. Logic gates fire on real signal thresholds. The depth isn't decorative, it's structural. You can short
a circuit, deadlock a pipe, or design a memory cell.

ASCII isn't a limitation — it's a clarity tool. A 50,000-tile factory in ASCII reads at a glance the way a 3D
version never could. Bottlenecks jump out. Optimization opportunities reveal themselves. Your factory becomes legible
the same way a circuit diagram is.

ABOUT THE STUDIO


Textorio is built by one developer at Hyena Studios in Anykščiai, Lithuania. No publisher. No marketing budget.
No focus groups. Just code, ASCII, and obsession.

Your factory is your survival. Make it beautiful.
store_data.short_description: Crash-land on Kepler-442b. With nothing but a terminal, build automated factories from raw ore. Power them. Fight back the wildlife. Descend 4 world layers to save 50,000 colonists in cryo-sleep. ASCII factory automation, deep and brutal. Pure text. Pure systems.

Something dark awakens in the abyss. An overwhelming purple magic is transforming the ocean into a living nightmare. As a mage of the Veneficus Order, only you possess the power to purify these waters and find the source of this evil. Prepare for a one-way descent into the darkest depths.

POWER-UPS!

No two descents are the same.

Gain experience by purifying species to level up and choose from dozens of potent upgrades.

Grow your way!

Firepower

From multiple shots to devastating blasts.

Mobility

Master the Dash system with invincibility frames to escape ambushes.

Defense and Utility

Activate bubble shields, increase your fire rate, or turn your dash into an offensive weapon.

How far can you make it before the dark magic turns you into fish bait?

store_data.about_the_game:
Spell to survive.

Words are Hard is a tile-laying roguelite deckbuilder. Draw tiles, lay words across a procedurally-generated board, and chain the right tomes, enchantments, and lexicon levels to detonate your score.

Five pillars of compounding chaos Every run, you stack five overlapping scoring systems that interlock in beautiful, broken ways:

  • Lexicon Levels — every word you play levels up its category, permanently boosting your score

  • Tile Values — upgrade the raw chip values of letters in your bag

  • Board Modifiers — change the rules of the board itself

  • Tile Enchantments — bolt effects onto specific tiles

  • Tomes — 181 unique passive abilities that fire on the right conditions

The fun isn't picking the best one — it's stitching all five into one absurd engine.

Twelve characters, twelve ways to break the game

Each character ships with a unique tile bag, a different fight cadence, and a twist mechanic that rewires how you play.

Eight chapters. Twenty-four fights. Infinite mode if you survive.

Each chapter ends with an Act — a boss fight that wants you dead. Push past chapter 8 and the gloves come off.

Features

  • Seeded runs for sharing wild victories

  • Per-character mastery levels (0–10) with skins, bags, and challenges

  • Procedurally-generated boards with random star positions and power squares

  • Codex tracking everything you've discovered

  • Single-player. No mics. No microtransactions. Just words.

Hey People 👋

Do you like rocks, mining and grinding? Of course you do. Rocks... rock, duh. Everybody likes them. That’s why I made a game entirely about clicking on rocks. I hope it's gonna rock your world....

Collect and sell precious minerals on the market

Hire workers to do the clicking for you while you relax comfortably in your chair.

Unlock powerful upgrades with your hard-earned cash

 This game will satisfy your deepest, darkest desires for some rock-smashing action.

Ten-Meter Explosive Fortune Overdrive is a casual business simulation game centered on the thrill of striking it rich. Experience the rush of getting rich overnight and embark on a high-energy money-making journey!

Core Gameplay: Buy Low, Sell High — Wealth Surge

  • Overdrive Market Trading System: Trade garlic, drones, calligraphy, crypto and more in a fast-fluctuating market. Buy low, sell high for huge margins. With rapid price swings and massive multipliers, one good deal can double your wealth instantly — enjoy that ten-meter fortune surge.

  • Life Simulation & Management: Start small, grow your capital, unlock new trades and business opportunities. Plan your life within an age limit; level up via trading, entrepreneurship and spending. Balance health and reputation to climb the rich list.

  • Family Talents & Achievements: Unlock family talents for passive buffs like trading boosts and market foresight. Complete achievements for rewards and perks to speed your way to wealth freedom.

  • Multiple Life Paths: Beyond trading, run businesses, splurge to raise status, or go on dates to trigger special events. Every choice shapes your wealth and story — craft your own rags-to-riches tale.

  • High-Yield Overdrive Mechanics: Built-in overdrive multipliers turn key decisions into windfalls. No slow grind — just nonstop wealth growth, true to the “Ten-Meter Explosive” name.

  • Vibrant Cartoon Art Style: Playful, exaggerated cartoon visuals with quirky characters and silly scenarios. Lighthearted, rewarding money gameplay that’s fun, relaxing and hard to put down.

store_data.about_the_game:
Autobus is a competitive card game built around one simple goal: be the first player to empty your main pile. Getting there is anything but simple.

Every turn you're racing to play as many cards as possible onto the shared build piles in the center of the table — but the moment you place a card from your hand onto one of your own piles, your turn is over and the next player takes their shot. Timing your plays, reading the table, and knowing when to hold back separates good players from great ones.

How to Play

Each player manages three areas:

  • Main Pile — your target. The top card is always visible and playable. Empty it and you win.

  • Laying Piles — four personal slots. Cards of the same value stack here; build them up to unlock plays.

  • Hand — five cards you draw and play from each turn.

In the center of the table are four shared build piles. On your turn, play cards from your hand, laying piles, or main pile onto them in ascending order — Ace through King, any suit. You can chain as many legal plays as you can find. When you're done (or stuck), your last move is placing a card from your hand onto one of your laying piles or back onto your main pile — that ends your turn.

Jokers are wildcards. They can be played onto any build pile at any time, giving you a lifeline when nothing else fits.

Features

  • 2–4 Players — solo against AI or online via Steam

  • Steam Multiplayer — join public lobbies or invite friends directly; bots fill in if someone leaves mid-game

  • Smart AI — strategic opponent that plans ahead and knows when to go for the win

  • Autopilot Mode — hand your turn to the AI at any time and watch it play for you

  • 3 Visual Themes — Classic, Dark, and Vintage card styles, switchable mid-game with two types of cards (hand drawn/low resolution)

  • Gamepad & Keyboard Support — full controller navigation, no mouse required

  • 11 Languages — English, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, Italian, Polish, Japanese

  • Fast games — most matches wrap up in 15–25 minutes

Multiplayer

Host a lobby and up to three others can join via Steam. The host processes all moves and keeps everyone in sync — if a player drops out, their slot is handed to a bot so the game never stalls. You can also enable autopilot on your own slot and let the AI cover for you while you watch.

Play Your Way

New to the game? Jump in solo and learn the rhythm against the AI. Comfortable? Crank up the competition with three human opponents and see who cracks under pressure first. Autobus rewards players who can think a few moves ahead without losing track of what everyone else is doing.

You'll have access to six hero classes and six start primary weapons, reflecting who you were on Earth before your abduction. Each class has distinct stats and a unique special ability, offering a completely different gameplay experience.

THE PARASITE IS INSIDE YOU

You were infected with a parasite that was supposed to control you, but something went wrong and you retained control of your body. Now the parasite gives you access to dozens of different active abilities. Combine ability types and damage types to assemble ultimate builds.

META PROGRESSION

Collect white essence, complete quests, and earn loot by killing ancient aliens to level up your character and challenge the aliens on higher difficulties.

META PROGRESSION

Collect white essence, complete quests, and earn loot by killing ancient aliens to level up your character and challenge the aliens on higher difficulties.

In this adventure game, you play as a mother pangolin trying to save her son from humans. To find him, she must leave the forest and travel into the city. Along the way, you sneak past dangers, face enemies, and discover the clash between nature and human life. It’s a story about love, courage, and survival.

Pangolin

Pangolins are endangered unique mammals often called "scaly anteaters." They are the only mammals in the world covered in hard, overlapping scales made of keratin—the same material as your fingernails.

Master of Defense

When threatened, the pangolin rolls into a ball. Creating an armor that even lions find difficult to bite through.

Expert Excavator

Pangolins are built for digging. They use their powerful front claws to dig deep underground burrows for sleeping.

Precision Feeding

Since they have no teeth, pangolins rely on a specialized sticky tongue that can be longer than their entire body.

The animals are still smiling.

Maybe they always have been.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a corner of a quiet village stands a small forge, where a single cat lives and works as the blacksmith.

When, one wonders, will this blacksmith forge a legendary blade?

Strike the anvil to enhance your swords, or sell them as they are to earn gold. Train your craft with the coin you gather, and your blades will grow stronger. A fine sword brings reputation — and reputation, in time, brings more gold.

The Cat God watches over this family, always. Perhaps, one day, a special power will be bestowed upon you.

But each cat is given only ten chances. Will you, generation after generation, reach the ultimate blade known as Myo-geom, the Cat Sword?

🎮 What kind of game is this?

Forge Cat is a cozy sword-enhancement simulation built around hammering a single blade higher and higher. It plays entirely with simple clicks, and a full playthrough takes roughly 1–3 hours — easy to pick up in short, relaxing sessions.

🔨 Enhance — to shine, or to shatter

Swords are enhanced one level at a time, from +1 upward. The higher you climb, the lower your success rate, and a failure can knock the level back down. That tension is the heart of the game. Every level cleared is a small victory on the road to the +30 Myo-geom.

💰 The loop of gold and renown

Sell enhanced swords for gold, then spend that gold across three shops:
  • Blacksmith Guild: learn techniques for success rate, cost savings, and failure protection
  • Trading House: sell swords for more and build your renown
  • The Cat God: receive special blessings woven into your enhancements
Fine swords become renown, and renown circles back as greater rewards.

🐾 Ten chances, then the next generation

Each cat blacksmith hands the hammer to the next generation after ten actions. With over 100 possible cat names, you never know who will carry on the line. Every strike is recorded in your family chronicle.

⚔ Collect 14 special sword types

As you keep enhancing, 14 special sword families reveal themselves — flame, ice, angel, cat-king, and more. Complete each set, fill your display rack, and uncover the hidden gems within.

📜 The Sword Archive

Swords forged to high levels can be archived forever in your family Sword Archive. Archived swords grant gold, renown, and blessing bonuses, plus a permanent enhancement success rate boost for the whole family.

🧭 Adventure — forging charms

Selling high-level swords yields Forged Iron Fragments. Gather them to craft a Blacksmith's Charm, which softens the sting of failed enhancements. Push onward into uncharted territory.

🐱 The visitors to your forge

Along the way, a few warm and quirky neighbors stop by the forge — the blacksmith guild, a traveling trading house, the watchful Cat God, and a would-be hero. Not grand story arcs, just small, friendly encounters that add warmth between your enhancements.

🎨 One game, four moods

  • Standard: a gently illustrated view
  • Retro: a softly nostalgic color palette
  • Sheet: a forge disguised as a spreadsheet
  • Motion: a clean note-app style

Game at a glance

  • Genre: Sword-enhancement sim, cozy casual, clicker
  • Play: Simple click-based controls, ~1–3 hours per playthrough
  • Content: 14 special sword types to collect, Sword Archive, charm crafting, small NPC encounters
  • Sound: Gentle background music with the warmth of a forge
  • More: 4 screen skins, multiple save slots, multi-language support

Small strikes become legends. Light the forge once more. 🐾🔥

store_data.about_the_game:
A predatory contract forces a fragmented band composed of irreparable broken friendships to get together for a final show, and a coming-of-age story about shoegaze punk, playing the bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

WHAT IS THIS THING ABOUT:

The story occurs during the rehearsals where the band has to remember how to play all of their songs. As the bassist of the group, the journey to remember your parts will force you to enter your own mind, and search them between all the memories that made you love and hate those who once were such a big part of yourself.

HOW THE MUSIC WORKS :

4MECHEROS is a rythm game about truly playing music.

A game where the controls don't simulate playing an instrument, but are an musical instrument by itself (this means you can play Megalovania or something idk).

There will be moments of playing and practicing fixed songs, but you'll also have the chance to jam alone or with company, as a way to connect through music both with your friends and with yourself.

THE ASHEN HEIR is a dark medieval strategy game where you inherit the throne after the king’s death.

The king left behind a starving people, unpaid soldiers, an empty treasury and nobles waiting for the right moment to take power.

The throne is yours now.

Hold the kingdom together. Silence your enemies. Expand your borders. Turn a broken realm into the greatest power on the continent.

WIN THE PEOPLE’S TRUST

Hunger and fear are spreading through the streets. The people no longer want promises. They want results. You can protect them, crush them or leave them to survive on their own.

STRENGTHEN THE ARMY

The borders are under threat. Soldiers want payment. Commanders want victory. Enemy kingdoms are waiting for the first sign of weakness.

PROTECT THE TREASURY

No command survives for long without gold. Armies do not march. Cities do not recover. Loyalty does not last.

CONTROL THE NOBLES

Everyone in the court looks loyal. But power hates an empty throne. A weak ruler becomes a guest in his own palace.

EXPAND YOUR KINGDOM

Restore order at home. Spread fear beyond your borders.

Make alliances. Declare wars. Crush rebellions. Expose betrayals. Let every kingdom on the continent know your name.

Every reign can lead to a different end.

You can become a king loved by the people.

A conqueror followed by the army.

A weak ruler controlled by the nobles.

Or the last heir who destroyed his own kingdom through his own decisions.

You have taken the throne.

Save your kingdom, expand your borders and rule the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your first day. Their last day.

You're the newest hire at Exterminator Inc., a small but proud pest control company with a big problem: every single client property is crawling with something. Roaches in the kitchen. Dustbunnies in the bathroom. Things you don't have names for yet in the attic.

Lucky for you, the company hands out a broom, a stopwatch, and exactly zero training. The rest is up to your clicking finger.

A Clicker That Actually Hits Back

Exterminator Inc. is a time-survival clicker built around one simple idea: the more bugs you smash, the more time you buy. No auto-battle, no idle waiting — every kill is something you earn with a click. Crit, combo, and chain your way through swarms until the timer runs out... or you do.

Five Tools, Five Ways to Crush

Start with the trusty Broom, then unlock the Spray, Vacuum, Mop, and Bleach Gun as you climb the corporate ladder. Each weapon completely changes how you play — from rapid hold-to-fire sprays to auto-targeting mops that clear the whole room while you focus on the big ones.

Build the Ultimate Exterminator

Spend your hard-earned gold on a 5-branch pentagon skill tree packed with damage boosts, crit chances, time bonuses, auto-attack drones, and 7 powerful synergies that reward bold builds. Maxed out everything? You've officially become Employee of the Month.

Four Rooms. One Promotion.

Work your way from the humble Kitchen to the dreaded Attic, each with its own bugs, bosses, and survival timer. Every cleared room unlocks the next — and every failed shift teaches you a little more about what's hiding behind the wallpaper.
store_data.detailed_description:
Your first day. Their last day.

You're the newest hire at Exterminator Inc., a small but proud pest control company with a big problem: every single client property is crawling with something. Roaches in the kitchen. Dustbunnies in the bathroom. Things you don't have names for yet in the attic.

Lucky for you, the company hands out a broom, a stopwatch, and exactly zero training. The rest is up to your clicking finger.

A Clicker That Actually Hits Back

Exterminator Inc. is a time-survival clicker built around one simple idea: the more bugs you smash, the more time you buy. No auto-battle, no idle waiting — every kill is something you earn with a click. Crit, combo, and chain your way through swarms until the timer runs out... or you do.

Five Tools, Five Ways to Crush

Start with the trusty Broom, then unlock the Spray, Vacuum, Mop, and Bleach Gun as you climb the corporate ladder. Each weapon completely changes how you play — from rapid hold-to-fire sprays to auto-targeting mops that clear the whole room while you focus on the big ones.

Build the Ultimate Exterminator

Spend your hard-earned gold on a 5-branch pentagon skill tree packed with damage boosts, crit chances, time bonuses, auto-attack drones, and 7 powerful synergies that reward bold builds. Maxed out everything? You've officially become Employee of the Month.

Four Rooms. One Promotion.

Work your way from the humble Kitchen to the dreaded Attic, each with its own bugs, bosses, and survival timer. Every cleared room unlocks the next — and every failed shift teaches you a little more about what's hiding behind the wallpaper.
store_data.short_description: Welcome to Exterminator Inc. The kitchen is infested, your shift just started, and the only thing between you and a paycheck is a swarm of cookieroaches. Click, crit, and crush your way through four nasty rooms in this cozy-chaotic survival clicker.

4742550.name: Road to Omaha: College Baseball Dynasty

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a college baseball program from the ground up.

Road to Omaha is a college baseball dynasty management sim built for fans who love recruiting battles, roster decisions, pitch-by-pitch games, deep stats, and the long arc of turning a program into a national contender.



Take over a school, shape your roster, build your staff, set your strategy, and guide your team through season after season of college baseball.

Run the Program


Every season is about more than the games on the schedule. Recruit high school prospects, chase transfers, manage scholarships, upgrade facilities, hire assistants, and decide how your program should grow.

Build around power bats, elite defense, deep pitching, speed, or whatever identity fits the roster you create.

  • Recruit high school players and transfers
  • Manage roster needs, player development, and offseason progression
  • Hire and develop coaching staff
  • Upgrade facilities and build program prestige
  • Navigate draft decisions, transfers, injuries, and long-term roster turnover

Shape Every Season


Build your schedule, play weekend series and midweek games, chase conference titles, and fight for postseason seeding. Sim ahead when you want speed, or slow down and manage the moments that matter.

The dynasty keeps moving across unlimited seasons, with history, records, awards, rankings, and program expectations following you year after year.

Play or Sim Pitch by Pitch


Games are presented as a sports-app-style simulation, not an arcade action game. Follow every pitch through live play-by-play, box scores, win probability, fatigue, leverage, pitch counts, and batter/pitcher matchups.

Jump in for key innings, manage every pitch, or instantly sim the result.

  • Pitch-by-pitch game simulation
  • Live box scores and play-by-play
  • Bullpen management, fatigue, and pitching changes
  • Lineup, rotation, and strategy control
  • Traditional and advanced baseball stats

Dig Into the Details


Road to Omaha is built for players who like the spreadsheet side of sports. Player ratings, handedness, pitch repertoires, fatigue, injury status, development, season logs, career stats, team history, and advanced metrics are always close by.

Set lineups, depth charts, rotations, bullpen roles, travel squads, and player development priorities.

Customize Your World


Play in a fictional college baseball universe, or customize the experience with team names, colors, logos, conferences, stadiums, and more. Sandbox tools let you edit players and shape your save the way you want.

Key Features


  • College baseball dynasty management across unlimited seasons
  • Recruiting, transfer portal, coaching staff, facilities, and player development
  • 56-game regular seasons with weekend series, midweek games, conference tournaments, and a national postseason
  • Pitch-by-pitch simulation with live stats, fatigue, win probability, and box scores
  • Deep roster tools for lineups, rotations, bullpen roles, depth charts, and travel squads
  • Advanced stats, awards, records, rankings, history pages, and player career tracking
  • Sandbox customization and editable team/player data

store_data.about_the_game:
DungDung, a martial arts dung beetle, sets out to defend the kingdom from Princess Petunia's creeping corruption...only to discover that he's inside a glitching videogame!

He must MASTER POOJITSU to stop the Princess.

He’ll HARNESS GLITCH POWERS and the code holding everything together.

Can DungDung save the realm AND the game?

WHY GIVE A CRAP ABOUT DUNGDUNG?

  • Martial arts action-platforming. With dung!

    • Master the arts of Poojitsu and Dung Fu!

    • ...and ride a Dung Ball!

    • Meet new allies along the way (and play as them as well)!

  • Glitch powers & abilities imported from other "games!"

    • See the other side of the screen in Gray Box mode.

    • Fight corrupted creatures from other games in NullShrines.

    • Gain abilities that change how you interact with the game world.

DEVELOPER’S NOTE: The glitchy, inspired-by-videogames world we created started as a book, written by a nerd (and his kid!) during COVID. Since then, a small squad of devs have been inspired to turn this into a proper game. The Stinky Adventures of DungDung is a love-letter to many of the classic platformers we’ve played over the years. We draw inspiration from the likes of Jak & Daxter, Ratchet & Clank, and Sly Cooper. But we also asked ourselves, “What if we could mess with the world in small ways, inspired by greats such as Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom? (Or when we’d just enter console cheat codes.)” 

We've still got a long way to go, but hope you'll join us on the adventure. This won't stink!

store_data.about_the_game:
Wolfbane is a dark fantasy werewolf action RPG set in a brutal medieval world cursed by blood, superstition, and the hunt.


Play as a werewolf wandering through forests, ruined villages and ancient wilderness while uncovering the secrets behind the curse. Hunt enemies, explore the world, and grow stronger as both man and beast.

Inspired by dark fantasy worlds and werewolf folklore, Wolfbane focuses on atmosphere, immersion, exploration, and the feeling of becoming a powerful predator.

Features

  • Play as a werewolf in both human and beast forms

  • Explore forests, ruined villages, castles and wilderness

  • Dark fantasy action RPG combat with light/heavy attacks, dodging, blocking, and parrying

  • Fight medieval soldiers, hunters, monsters, and powerful boss enemies

  • Unlock new abilities and grow stronger over time

  • Climbing and traversal mechanics inspired by open world adventure games

  • Discover lore through journals, books, and hidden fragments scattered across the world

  • Atmospheric medieval world inspired by werewolf legends and folklore

  • Blood, gore, dismemberment, and brutal melee combat

store_data.about_the_game:
Cell #31 is a twin-stick shooter bullet hell game where you play as a lone cell fighting for survival. The game is fast-paced and intense from the start, with runs lasting from seconds to minutes. It features a single score attack game mode for high score and a local leaderboard. The game supports both gamepad and keyboard controls. 

The goal of the game is to achieve a high score by avoiding bullet hell patterns and destroying enemies for points and gems. Collecting gems increases a score multiplier which resets to one on player death. The player has three lives. Achieving a high score thus requires staying alive and accumulating a high multiplier.

Key Features

  • A single score attack mode with fast runs and high replayability

  • Avoid bullet hell patterns and destroy enemies for points and gems

  • Collect gems to increase score multiplier for even more points

  • Local leaderboard for tracking scores

  • Support for both gamepad and keyboard controls
